name: Prešovská hodinovka na tartane
organizer: BK ZasRun, Olympijský klub Prešov, AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita
description: The Prešov Tartan Track Hour is a running race held at the Prešov University athletics stadium in Prešov. The competition is open to men and women in various age categories and offers a unique opportunity to test your endurance and speed on a tartan track. It is organized by BK ZasRun Šarišské Bohdanovce, Olympijský klub Prešov and AK TJ Slávia Prešovská univerzita. The race is suited to runners looking to experience a high-quality athletics atmosphere and compete in the pleasant surroundings of a university stadium.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the tartan track at the Prešov University athletics stadium
Categories are divided by age and gender (Men A, Men B, Women F, Women G)
The start and finish are on a high-quality athletics surface in Prešov
additional: The event also offers online registration and takes place on 15 October 2026 at the university athletics stadium in Prešov.

name: Stovka Považím - Považie ultra trail
description: Stovka Považím is a challenging long-distance hike and ultra trail in the beautiful Považie region, intended for experienced ultrarunners and walkers. Each year, it offers an original and extremely demanding course. Course A is part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and the first stage of the Extreme Ultra Trail Combination. The event takes place in Trenčín and the surrounding area, with several course options and luggage transport between the start and finish. Participants can stay overnight in the gym at ZŠ Predmier, adding to their comfort.
course_highlights: An extremely demanding and original course through the Považie region
Course A is part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup (CSUT)
Luggage transport between the start and finish is available for all courses
additional: Participant check-in takes place on Friday evening in Trenčín and on Saturday morning in Ladce and Považská Bystrica. The finish-area facilities close on Sunday at 18:00 in Predmier. Participants on the shorter courses can stay overnight in the gym at ZŠ Predmier from Friday evening. Luggage must be securely closed; the organizer is not responsible for valuables. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 16–18 October, with a start at 23:00. Course A is part of the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and the first stage of the Extreme Ultra Trail Combination.

name: Podvihorlatský kros
location: Futbalové ihrisko (amfiteáter), Poruba pod Vihorlatom, Slovakia
description: Podvihorlatský Cross-Country Run is a running event held at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The race offers starts for children’s categories and the main category. The course runs mainly along field and forest roads, with 30% asphalt. It is organized by Mgr. Ján Podstavský with the support of the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom. The event is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025 and offers categories for various age groups, as well as Nordic walking.
course_highlights: 70% field and forest roads, 30% asphalt
The course passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Start and finish at the football field (amphitheatre) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom
additional: The children’s categories start at 9:00, and the main category starts at 11:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking. The event is supported by the Municipality of Poruba pod Vihorlatom and is part of the Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2025. Course: forest and asphalt roads; online registration until 16.10.2025; start times at 9:00 and 11:00; categories for different age groups and ability levels; registration also includes a charitable contribution.

name: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica
organizer: Obec Oščadnica, Klub turistov Oščadnica, extremmaraton.sk
description: Extrém Maratón Oščadnica is a mountain marathon through the picturesque Kysuce countryside, mainly along mountain ridges with beautiful views of Veľká Rača. The 42-kilometre course, with nearly 1,700 metres of elevation gain, tests endurance, strength and a love of the mountains. This is not a race but a recreational running experience that celebrates the joy of movement, friendship and determination. The organisers provide full support, including refreshments, a T-shirt and a get-together after the run.
course_highlights: 42 km course with nearly 1,700 m of elevation gain
Mainly mountain ridges with views of Veľká Rača (1,236 m above sea level)
Refreshment stations approximately every 8 km
additional: Runner check-in is on 17.10.2026 from 06:30 to 08:30 at the Oščadnica Cultural Centre. The marathon time limit is 7 hours, with a 5-hour cut-off for reaching Veľká Rača; after that, the organisers do not guarantee refreshments. Registration is available online only, or on site if the start list is not full. Registration closes once the limit of 200 participants is reached. The entry fee includes a T-shirt, baggage storage, showers, refreshments on the course and at the finish, a medal and an after-party. Registration is available online, and the number of participants is limited to 200. The entry fee includes a T-shirt, refreshments, a medal and an after-party.

organizer: Obec Rozhanovce, Občianske združenie KŠK Rozhanovce

description: Rozhanovská Dvanástka is a running race held in the amphitheatre grounds in Rozhanovce. It offers two main categories—a 6 km short course and a 12 km long course—for both men and women. The race is organised by the Municipality of Rozhanovce and the KŠK Rozhanovce civic association, and is suitable for runners of various abilities. The race is scheduled for 17 October 2026, with the children’s races starting at 10:45 and the main races at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Rozhanovce amphitheatre grounds
Two categories: a 6 km short course and a 12 km long course
Races for men and women, with children’s races also available
additional: Children’s races start at 10:45. The entry fee can be paid online or on site. Organisers: Municipality of Rozhanovce and KŠK Rozhanovce civic association. Contact: Ing. Matúš Adamčík, tel.: +421 908 909 779. The event also includes a children’s race, starting at 10:45, and the course is probably outdoors in the area around Rozhanovce.

name: Šurianska desiatka
description: Šurianska desiatka is a running event held in the town of Šurany, with the start and finish in front of the Municipal Office. The course runs along the town’s streets and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok on asphalt roads. The event is open to the general public, including pupils, junior runners, recreational runners and Nordic Walking participants. It is organised by Gymnázium Bernolákova 37, Šurany, and has a limited number of participants in categories A to J. Refreshments and drinks are provided for runners. Winners receive diplomas, prizes and cash awards.
course_highlights: The course runs along the streets of Šurany and through part of Nitriansky Hrádok
The course surface is asphalt
The start and finish are in front of the Municipal Office in Šurany
additional: On-site registration is available from 9:00 in front of the Municipal Office in Šurany. The race is limited to 400 participants in categories A to J. Secondary school pupils at schools established by the Nitra Self-Governing Region (NSK) pay no entry fee when registering online; on-site registration costs €2. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal. Winners in men’s category A and women’s category D receive cash prizes of up to €100. The main races start at 13:00. Online registration closes on 15 October 2026 at 23:59 or when the capacity of 400 participants in categories A to J is reached. Entry is free for youth categories when registering online (€2 on site); adults and recreational runners pay €18 online or €24 when registering on site.

name: Psotkov memorial
description: Psotkov Memorial is a traditional mountain running race in the heart of the High Tatras, held near Štrbské Pleso. Runners can choose between two challenging routes: BASIC, 25.3 km long with 1,540 m of elevation gain, and EXTREME, 37.9 km long with 2,490 m of elevation gain. The route passes through picturesque mountain scenery, including a climb to just below the summit of Kriváň, a descent to Tri studničky, a stretch past Jamské pleso and through Furkotská dolina, and a finish at Chata pod Soliskom. The race is part of the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia and offers a unique running experience in challenging mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Climb to just below the summit of the prominent Kriváň
Long descent to Tri studničky with a refreshment station
Pass by Jamské pleso and through the demanding Furkotská dolina
additional: Registration is limited to 400 participants (200 for BASIC and 200 for EXTREME). Members of the Slovak Mountaineering Association James are entitled to a discounted entry fee. The EXTREME route is run as a time trial. The start and finish are at the SNOW - Štrba cross-country skiing area, Štrbské Pleso. The time limit is 6 hours for BASIC and 8 hours for EXTREME. The event is limited to 400 participants.

The race takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava and is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. The start is traditionally at 10:00, and the event also includes children’s races of approximately 200 metres. The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is part of a series of races held throughout the year, offering runners of different ages and ability levels an opportunity to take part.

Children run approximately 200 metres
The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Kuchajda in Bratislava

name: Challenge Airport Run
location: Vojenská letecká základňa v Prešove, Prešov, Slovakia

price_range: 22 € až 25 € v závislosti od termínu registrácie, 12 € pre detský beh
description: Challenge Airport Run is a unique running experience at the Prešov Military Air Base, combining sport with the atmosphere of military training. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km courses, with each participant carrying a symbolic weighted backpack to highlight courage and endurance. The event offers an unforgettable atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment, areas rarely accessible to the public. Alongside the athletic challenge, it is also a tribute to discipline and strength, with a varied programme and original race packs.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of the Prešov Military Air Base
Runners carry a weighted backpack symbolising tradition and endurance
An army-style atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment
additional: Race bib with chip, dog-tag-shaped medal, military-design T-shirts, side programme with a raffle, children’s races available, refreshments provided, army-style race packs. The event includes asphalt and concrete-slab roads, categories with military equipment, a start window from 9:00 to 9:15, and the option to participate with military equipment or as a civilian runner.

The league offers several rounds with different distances, suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts. Participants can expect high-quality organization and a pleasant atmosphere in the amphitheater and surrounding area. The league is part of the region’s active sporting life and promotes a healthy lifestyle.

The start and finish are in the amphitheater, creating a great atmosphere for spectators
The league’s various rounds offer different distances, such as 1500 m, 3 miles, 5 km, and 10 km
additional: The league consists of several rounds throughout the year, held at different locations around Šamorín. 3klub Šamorín also organizes running and cycling training sessions for the public. Check-in takes place from 9:00 to 10:00. The course is paved; toilets and a changing room are available. The adult entry fee includes a race number, timing, refreshments, and entry into a raffle.

description: Slaňaki CUP - Dubník Uphill Run is a traditional uphill race held in Zámutov, in the Vranov nad Topľou district. The course is 11.2 km long with 600 metres of elevation gain, and the finish is by Slovakia’s tallest structure, the Dubník transmitter, at an elevation of 318 metres. The race is part of the Slovak Uphill Running Cup and is open to a wide range of male and female runners of different ages. It is organized by Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race challenges runners to test their endurance and strength on demanding mountain terrain.
course_highlights: 11.2 km course with 600 m of elevation gain
Finish by Slovakia’s tallest structure, the Dubník transmitter (318 m)
Demanding mountain terrain suited to uphill running
additional: Runners are divided into categories by age and gender, including juniors and men’s and women’s age groups. The start is in front of the Zámutov Municipal Office. The organizers are Klub otužilcov Vranovské Vydry, Obecný úrad Zámutov and Penzión Kondor Zámutov. The race takes place in October 2026; online registration is available. Refreshments and a memorial run are also included.

name: Beh hrebeňom Čergova
description: The Run along the Čergov Ridge is the longest mountain race in the Čergov Mountains, intended for nature-running enthusiasts and trained runners. The course starts in the village of Kamenica and passes over the range’s highest peaks, including Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná. It is 32 km long, with 1,413 metres of elevation gain. Runners can enjoy stunning panoramic views and challenging terrain on hiking trails. The race takes place on 24 October 2026, starting at 9:00 at Farma Kamenica and finishing at Sedlo Besná, near Hotel Šport Lysá.
course_highlights: 32 km mountain race with 1,413 m of elevation gain
Crosses the highest peaks of the Čergov Mountains: Minčol, Dvoriská, Solisko, Veľká Javorina, Čergov, Lysá and Sedlo Besná
The route follows hiking trails marked blue and green
additional: A large bus will be provided for all participants, taking them in the morning from the village of Drienica to Kamenica (departing at 7:15 from the car park by Hotel JAVORNÁ). The organisers will also transport participants’ personal belongings from the start to the finish. Race-day registration is open from 7:00 to 8:30 at Farma Kamenica. The awards ceremony and lunch will be held at Hotel Šport Lysá. The race takes place on 24 October 2026 and is open to men and women in various age categories, offering the chance to take part in a mountain trail race amid the beautiful scenery of the Čergov Mountains.

The event is part of the region’s running tradition and offers a pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community. The organizers ensure the course is well prepared and provide a welcoming environment for all participants.

Pleasant atmosphere with support from the local community

The main race starts at 1:00 p.m., while the children’s categories begin at 11:00 a.m. The race is divided into several age categories for men, women, and children, welcoming runners of all ages. The organizers welcome everyone who wants to enjoy a day of sport in the pleasant surroundings of the municipality.

The pleasant surroundings of the municipality of Košická Polianka

This sporting celebration attracts runners of different age groups, including youth and adults, who compete over various distances. The event is organized by the City of Strážske in cooperation with the MBO Strážske running club and is known for its long history and strong community spirit. Runners can enjoy the city’s atmosphere while testing their abilities in a friendly yet competitive environment.

The race offers a unique experience in the museum’s cultural setting and the surrounding countryside. It is part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events in the region. Runners can look forward to an interesting course with an autumn atmosphere and a sense of local history.
course_highlights: The course runs through the grounds of the Zemplín Museum in Michalovce
An autumn setting with a cultural touch
Part of the Zemplínsky extrém series, which includes several events

name: Beh na Minčol
description: The Minčol Run is a challenging uphill mountain race in the beautiful surroundings of the Višňovská Valley. The route follows a marked hiking trail with steep climbs all the way to the summit of Minčol at an elevation of 1,363 m, where runners can enjoy beautiful views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra. The race is for bold runners who want to test their abilities on a demanding course with little room to rest. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.
course_highlights: Marked hiking trail with blue blazes
Steep climbs from the start to the finish
Finish at the summit of Minčol, with views of the Krivánska and Lúčanská parts of the Malá Fatra
additional: Race check-in is from 8:30 to 9:30. Results will be announced shortly after the last runner finishes, at approximately 12:30. There are refreshments on the course at approximately 2 km and at the finish; after the race, lunch is served (homemade kapustnica and a drink). Runners can use a drop bag, which will be transported to the facilities below the ski slope, where the prizes will be presented. The organizers arrange transport of runners’ belongings to the results ceremony venue. Refreshments are provided after the finish, followed by an awards ceremony with prizes for the best runners in each category.

description: The Run through the Jastrabie Hills is the 3rd edition of the Ján Dobák Memorial, held in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie. The race offers categories for children and adults across various age groups and disciplines, including 10 km and 5 km runs for men and women, as well as Nordic walking. The children’s race starts at 12:30 and the adults’ race at 14:00. The organizers, the Municipality of Šarišské Jastrabie and the Šarišské Jastrabie Primary School and Kindergarten, welcome runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Jastrabie Hills in the village of Šarišské Jastrabie
Categories for various age groups and disciplines, including Nordic walking
Start at the Šarišské Jastrabie Municipal Office grounds
additional: On-site registration is possible only in exceptional cases, by arrangement with the organizer. Children’s categories, residents of Šarišské Jastrabie, men over 70, and women over 60 can enter for free. A discounted race bundle is available for Z Ľubotína na Hrad Plaveč + Run through the Jastrabie Hills. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses; registration is available online and on-site, and prices vary by category and registration method. Categories are also offered for children, seniors, and Nordic walking.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race held at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. It is organised by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team and is part of a race series with points awarded by men’s and women’s categories. Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, with the race starting at 10:00. The categories are children, juniors, women, men and veterans. Runners can also earn points for improving their times during the year.
course_highlights: 2-mile (3.218 km) course
Registration and start by the volleyball court at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. Competitors vie for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with points calculated using coefficients based on year of birth. In the event of a tie, the best time decides, followed by shoe size. At the end of the year, the two months with the fewest points are removed (amnesty). Registration is available on site; the event is held in several rounds throughout the year, with each race covering approximately 2 miles (3.218 km).

name: Beh na Husárik
location: Horské hoteli Husárik, Čadca, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The Beh na Husárik is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucký Marathon Club Čadca, the City of Čadca, and the Husárik Mountain Hotel. Held in honor of Students’ Day, the race gives runners the chance to test themselves in beautiful mountain surroundings. The start is always at 11:00, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and the Mayor of Čadca’s Cup awarded to the winners. The Beh na Husárik is suitable for the general public interested in sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain surroundings around the Husárik Mountain Hotel
Race held in honor of Students’ Day
Mayor of Čadca’s Cup for the winners
additional: Online registration is closed. You can also register on race day for the increased entry fee of 8 EUR. The race takes place on 15 November 2026, with a start at 11:00. Online registration is available; the course is hilly and trail-based. The race is held in Čadca near the Husárik Mountain Hotel.

name: Hermanovská desiatka
location: Hermanovce nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Hermanovce nad Topľou a Hermanovský bežecký oddiel

description: Hermanovská desiatka is a running race organized by the Municipality of Hermanovce nad Topľou and the Hermanovce Running Club. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office in Hermanovce nad Topľou and offers categories for children, youth, and adults. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00, and the adults’ race at 14:00. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Competition for different age groups, including children, youth, and adults
Organized in the picturesque surroundings of Hermanovce nad Topľou
Registration available via QR code; low entry fee of €10
additional: The children’s and youth races start at 12:00, and the adults’ race at 14:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including local categories. Registration is required by 10.11.2025 via QR code. The race is open to runners of all levels, with categories for children, youth, and adults. The event takes place on 15 November 2026, with the children’s race starting at 12:00 and the adults’ race at 14:00.

name: Ferčekovská desiatka
price_range: 10 € pre dospelých, 5 € pre seniorov a podujatie 'Prebehni sa s nami', zadarmo pre deti a mládež

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: muži nad 60 rokov a ženy nad 50 rokov 6 €

description: Ferčekovská desiatka is a running race held in the village of Ferčekovce near Spišská Nová Ves, offering courses for children, teenagers and adults. The race takes place on forest roads and undulating grassy terrain, creating a pleasant natural setting for runners of all ages. It is organised by Športový klub Ferčekovce in cooperation with the city of Spišská Nová Ves. The race is suitable for the general public, including families and running enthusiasts, who can choose from several categories and distances.
course_highlights: Surface: forest road and grass
Undulating terrain in a natural setting
Multiple categories by age and gender
additional: The children’s and teenagers’ races start at 11:00, the Prebehni sa s nami race starts at 12:15, and the adult 5 km and 10 km races start at 13:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including special categories for seniors. The entry fee is lower with online registration; the on-site fee is a flat €15. The event includes refreshments, medals for all finishers, online registration, and various categories for all age groups.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, ZŠ Pavla Horova Michalovce
description: The Michalovce Liberation Run is a traditional evening race held in the city center of Michalovce. Runners follow city streets over a course of approximately 5.8 km made up of several laps. After finishing, they receive refreshments and a participant medal. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with the option to register in person on race day.
course_highlights: Evening run through the center of Michalovce
5.8 km course made up of 1,450 m laps
Refreshments and a participant medal after the finish
additional: In-person registration takes place in the lobby of the Town Hall from 16:30 to 17:45. Headlamps are recommended for safety. After finishing, runners return their race number and receive a medal. The results ceremony is at 19:30 in the gymnasium of P. Horov Elementary School No. 8. The course has been shortened to 5.8 km and runs on asphalt and stone surfaces. Registration is available online or in person. The entry fee is €20; a reduced fee applies to online registration by 19.11.2025.

name: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše
price_range: 12-18 € v závislosti od dĺžky trate a spôsobu registrácie
description: The Lesný beh priateľov Šemše is a running event in the municipality of Šemša, in the Košice-okolie District, offering three distances: 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km. The course runs along paved forest roads and trails, country roads and asphalt, creating a pleasant and varied running environment. The race is open to all ages, with no age-group divisions, and is organised by the Šemša v pohybe civic association. The start is split into two waves: the longer distance starts at 10:00, and the shorter distances at 11:00. The event is suitable for runners looking for a forest run with a choice of distances and difficulty levels.
course_highlights: The course follows paved forest roads and trails
Includes country roads and asphalt sections
Three distances: 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km
additional: The start is split into two waves: the 22 km race starts at 10:00, and the 5.5 km and 11 km races start at 11:00. Categories have no age restrictions and are intended for children, men and women. The event is organised by the Šemša v pohybe civic association. The course surface is varied, including forest roads, country roads and asphalt. The race takes place on terrain featuring forest roads, country roads and asphalt. Registration is available online or on site. Categories are available for children, men and women, with a choice of short and long distances.

name: Beh na Kysacký hrad
organizer: Klub orientačného behu Kysak, Obec Kysak

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 8,00 € - dorastenci, dorastenky, juniori, juniorky a pretekári nad 60 rokov, pri prihlásení cez prihlasovací formulár a platbe prevodom do 18.11.2024.

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Run to Kysacký Castle is a running event organized by the Kysak Orienteering Club and the municipality of Kysak. It takes place at the Cultural House in Kysak. The course runs mainly on forest roads (85%), with a smaller proportion on asphalt (15%). The race is open to various age groups, from youth to veterans, divided by age and gender. Entry fees vary by category and are paid during registration, with payment by bank transfer available until a specified deadline. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere and the chance to compete in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: 85% forest roads, 15% asphalt
Start at the Cultural House in Kysak
Several age categories, from youth to veterans
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender: youth, juniors, men and women in various age groups. The start is at the Cultural House in Kysak. The race is held in the surroundings of historic Kysacký Castle. Registration is available through an online form, with payment by bank transfer until 18.11.2024. The event includes categories for various age groups and genders.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile (3.218 km) running race organized by Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool grounds in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the race starts at 10:00. The event is part of a series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Challenge Cup, with finishing times adjusted using age coefficients based on year of birth.
course_highlights: Course length: 2 miles (3.218 km); children: approx. 200 m
Venue: Kuchajda swimming pool grounds, Bratislava
Check-in beside the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place on site beside the volleyball court from 9:30. Categories are children (13 and under), juniors, women, men, female veterans, and male veterans. Competitors are awarded points based on the number of participants in their categories; junior men and junior women are scored separately. In the event of a tie, year of birth and the best time that year determine the result. An amnesty is granted for two participations, in which the two months with the lowest point totals are discarded. Races take place in several rounds throughout the year, including the 12th round in December. On-site registration is available; pricing details are not specified, and the course is mostly asphalt in an urban setting.

name: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke
location: Základná škola Hviezdoslavova, Lipany, Prešov, Slovakia

description: The Mikuláš Night Run to the Balážka Lookout Tower is an adrenaline-filled night race for participants over 15 years old. The event takes place on 6 December 2025, starting at 19:00 from Hviezdoslavova Elementary School in Lipany. Runners can look forward to a unique nighttime experience with views from the lookout tower. The entry fee is a minimum of €7, and participants must register by 5 December 2025.
course_highlights: A night run with an adrenaline-filled atmosphere
The route leads to the Balážka Lookout Tower
The event is for participants over 15 years old
additional: This is a unique nighttime event with a minimum entry fee of €7. Participants must be over 15 years old. Registration is open until 5 December 2025. The start is at Hviezdoslavova Elementary School in Lipany. Night run, start at Hviezdoslavova Elementary School, registration by 5 December 2025, discounted entry for groups and costumes, refreshments and showers provided.

name: Horovská desiatka
description: Horovská desiatka is a traditional New Year’s Eve race, now being held for the 40th time. It starts by the Cultural Centre in Horovce. Runners compete on a 10 km course from Horovce to Tušice and back. The event is suitable for the general public and offers categories for different age groups, including children. The atmosphere is friendly, making it an ideal way to end the year with a sporting achievement.
course_highlights: 10 km course from Horovce to Tušice and back
Start and finish by the Cultural Centre in Horovce
Traditional New Year’s Eve race with a long history
additional: There are categories for adults and children based on age. The course is one 10 km lap. The event takes place on 31 December as a New Year’s Eve race. Date: 31.12.2026; terrain: probably road; registration is available via websites; adults start at 11:00 and children at 9:30; several categories for different age groups.

name: Silvestrovský beh
location: Humenné, Mestský atletický štadión, Humenné, Slovakia

description: The Silvester Run in Humenné is a traditional running race held at the Municipal Athletics Stadium. This 43rd edition features a main 5.7 km event, with categories for juniors, men, and women across different age groups. The race starts on December 31 at 11:00. Online registration is open until 11:00 on race day, or you can register in person at the venue from 8:30. Runners can download a GPX course map and view a route animation to help them prepare for the race.
course_highlights: A 5.7 km route at the Humenné Municipal Athletics Stadium
Categories for juniors, men, and women across different age groups
Option to download a GPX course map and view a route animation
additional: On-site registration is available from 8:30 on race day. Categories are divided by age and gender. The number of registered participants is limited; currently, 253 people have registered, with 207 payments made. terrain: municipal stadium, registration: online or on-site, categories for different age groups

name: Ľudova 50
description: Ľudova 50 is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hiking event through the beautiful Strážov Mountains. The 51 km route with 2,600 metres of elevation gain starts and finishes in the village of Uhrovec, birthplace of Ľudovít Štúr, after whom the race is named. The race is demanding, and experience with similar long-distance routes is recommended. There are three aid stations along the course, which follows marked hiking trails throughout, offering beautiful views and historical sites.
course_highlights: 51 km route with 2,600 m of elevation gain
Follows marked hiking trails in the Strážov Mountains
Checkpoints at Uhrovec Castle, Chata pod Čiernym vrchom and Kajtárov
additional: The participant limit is 200 runners/hikers. Participant check-in takes place the day before the race and on race morning. There are three aid stations along the route. The organiser recommends having completed at least one event with a 50 km route before the start. The course passes through areas inhabited by brown bears and other wildlife. The organiser monitors the weather and may adjust the route or programme in case of danger. The start and finish are at Ľudovít Štúr Square in Uhrovec. Information about mandatory equipment, rules and registration is available on the official website.

name: Račiansky kros ZIMA
distance_verbose: Maratón, 16 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3.2 km

name: Letecká stovka
description: Letecká stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike covering 106 km with +3,590 m of elevation gain in the Považský Inovec and Strážovské vrchy mountain ranges. The start and finish are in Trenčín. The route runs mostly along marked hiking trails and is ITRA-certified. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and is also a qualifying race for the 2028 Western States Endurance Run. It is organized by o.z. SLOVAK ULTRA TRAIL, an ITRA member since 2015. The race is open to individuals aged 18 and over, with participation also permitted from age 17 when accompanied by a legal guardian.
course_highlights: A 106 km route with +3,590 m of elevation gain in the Považský Inovec and Strážovské vrchy mountain ranges
Start and finish in Trenčín; the route runs mostly along marked hiking trails
ITRA-certified, part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, and a qualifying race for the Western States Endurance Run
additional: Participant check-in takes place on Friday, March 5, from 18:00 to 22:00 and on Saturday, March 6, from 05:00 to 05:40 in the Arena Ostrov building in Trenčín. The time limit to complete the race is 25 hours, with several checkpoints subject to specific time limits. The winners’ announcement and prize-giving will take place at the finish in the Arena Ostrov building, according to the finish times of the first three participants in each category. Both the start and finish are in Trenčín. According to information for the 2027 edition, the main race takes place on March 6–7; the available date information therefore does not match the stated date of March 13.

name: Nitrianska 24 hodinovka – Memoriál Alexandra Bögiho
location: Nitra, Okres Nitra, Nitriansky kraj, Slovakia

name: ALS charitatívny beh
description: The ALS Charity Run – Ján Svočák Memorial is a mountain trail run in Svit, offering a challenging 21 km course with 950 metres of elevation gain. The course runs mainly through forest (80%) and meadows (20%), with two refreshment stations at kilometres 8 and 16. Alongside the main race, the event also includes children’s races, relays, Nordic walking and a special trail run with a dog. The event is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with high-quality organisation and a certified course.
course_highlights: 21 km trail with 950 m of elevation gain
80% of the route is through forest and 20% through meadows
Two refreshment stations at kilometres 8 and 16
additional: Individual start times for the trail run with a dog are between 09:30 and 09:40, at 10-second intervals, with each runner’s exact start time printed on their race number. Relays are 3 × 1.7 km with 140 m of elevation gain; the course surface includes forest trail, meadow, asphalt and gravel. Nordic walking takes place on a route that is 90% forest and 10% asphalt. All children’s categories are awarded and results are announced immediately at the finish. ITRA-certified course, 1 qualifying point for ALS 21 km. The event supports people with neuromuscular diseases. Sources differ on the 2027 event date: the listed date is 27 March, while the event website gives 20 March.

name: Beh Galantou – Beh oslobodenia
price_range: 15 € online, 12 € s GALAkartou; štafeta 40 € online, 32 € s GALAkartou; Samsung Run 10 €, 8 € s GALAkartou
description: Beh Galantou - Beh oslobodenia is the 40th anniversary edition of a traditional running event in Galanta, offering a range of disciplines for all age groups. The event is intended not only for athletes, but also for everyone who wants to experience an atmosphere full of emotion, the joy of movement and the challenge of surpassing themselves. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, refreshments and drinks; children also receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners receive cash prizes and valuable prizes, including televisions in special categories. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre in Galanta.
course_highlights: Courses for beginner and advanced runners
A commemorative medal for every participant, including children
More than 40 valuable prizes in the final raffle
additional: Registration opens at 8:00 on the day of the event and closes 20 minutes before the start of each category. Children receive a ticket to the Galandia Water World and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners do not receive cups, but valuable cut glass. Winners in the special categories must hold a GalaKARTA. After the race, a cultural programme is planned at the Municipal Cultural Centre. The event includes various disciplines, prizes, refreshments and a cultural programme. Registration is online, and road closures are expected during the races.

name: Jarný beh Bojničky
price_range: 10 € online, 12 € na mieste, deti a dorast zdarma

description: The Bojničky Village Spring Run is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub Bojničky and the municipality of Bojničky. The race takes place in Bojničky in front of the Cultural Centre and is part of the Nitra Running League 2026. Children, juniors, adults and Nordic Walking participants can compete, with categories based on age and gender. A new feature is a competition for three-person men’s and women’s teams in the 5000 m Nordic Walking event. Starts are scheduled by category from 9:45 to 12:15.
course_highlights: The race takes place in front of the Cultural Centre in Bojničky
Competition for three-person teams in the 5000 m Nordic Walking event (5.2 km)
Categories for children, juniors, adults and Nordic Walking
additional: Race starts are divided among several categories: 9:45 — Bojničky residents’ run; 10:10 — children’s categories; 11:20 — Nordic Walking; from 12:15 — adults. The races are part of the Nitra Running League 2026. The course is on asphalt. Online registration is available until 9 April 2026. Maps and details about the categories are available on the official website.

name: Timravine Ostrôžky Trail
description: Timrava’s Ostrôžky Trail is a mountain running race in Divín, offering two challenging courses with beautiful views and significant elevation gain. The race is organized by OZ Ostrôžky and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in nature. The Ostrôšky Ultra course is 47 km long with 2,000 m of elevation gain, while the shorter Langoš Trail is 27 km long with 950 m of elevation gain. The race starts in two waves: the longer course starts at 7:30 and the shorter one at 9:00.
course_highlights: Ostrôšky Ultra: 47 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain
Langoš Trail: 27 km with 950 m of elevation gain
Mountain trails with beautiful views around Divín
additional: The race starts in two waves: the 47 km course starts at 7:30, and the 27 km course at 9:00. The organizers are Lukáš Krnáč and OZ Ostrôžky. Entry fees depend on the registration period, with the highest price charged on site. Trail races with various categories, online registration, and start times at 07:30 and 09:00. The 2026 event will be held for the second time, following its first edition in 2025.

name: Beh oslobodenia Kálnice
description: The Kálnica Liberation Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Kálnica in honor of the Romanian soldiers who fell during the liberation of the village. The race follows a route from Kálnica to Rakoľuby and back, with different distances for different age categories. The course is paved, flat, with a slight elevation gain and some turns. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who may run accompanied by an adult. The race starts by the Cultural Center in Kálnica.
course_highlights: Route: Kálnica – Rakoľuby – Kálnica
Race distances: 1,500 m, 5,500 m, and 11,000 m
Paved course with a slight elevation gain of 36 m
additional: Online registration closes on 10.4.2025 at 23:55 or when the participant limit is reached. After this deadline, on-site registration is possible on race day if the limit has not been reached. Entry fees are non-refundable, but can be transferred to another person through an account on vysledkovyservis.sk or, for a handling fee of €4, without an account. The course is paved and flat, with a slight elevation gain; online registration is available until 10.4.2025; the entry fee includes refreshments and a raffle; the race takes place on 11 April 2026.

name: Zvolenská Corrida
location: Námestie SNP, Zvolen, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Zvolen, Mišo s. r. o.
description: Zvolenská Corrida is a running event held in the pedestrian zone of SNP Square in Zvolen. Runners complete five flat 1 km laps, for a total distance of 5 km. The event also includes children’s races and a fun run for parents and children, both free of charge. It is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers professional event organization and timing.
course_highlights: A 1,000 m lap in the pedestrian zone of SNP Square
Flat course, suitable for all age groups
Five laps in total, or 5 km for the main race
additional: Children’s races are free of charge, with age-group categories over distances of 50 m, 250 m and 500 m. Mama/Oco Corrida is a free 1 km run for parents and children. Registration for the main race is online and limited to 200 participants. Registration for the children’s races and Mama/Oco Corrida is available on site from 9:00. The schedule includes check-in, children’s races at 10:00, Mama/Oco Corrida at 10:30, the main race at 11:00 and the awards ceremony with a raffle at 12:00. The event features the 5 km main race, children’s races and family races. Registration is online or on site. Medals are awarded to the first 170 participants. The main race starts at around 11:00.

name: Furčiansky maratón – Memoriál Štefana Semana
description: The Furčiansky Marathon - Štefan Seman Memorial is a traditional running marathon organized by O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. This 23rd edition will take place on April 11, 2026, in Košice, offering runners the opportunity to test themselves on a certified course. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere and support for running activities in the region. The organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a high-quality, well-organized marathon.
course_highlights: marathon and relay categories
a traditional event with a long history
location in Košice with a great atmosphere
additional: Online results will be available from 10:00 on race day. Registration for the Furčiansky Marathon 2026 is closed. The organizer is O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. The event includes a marathon, an extreme marathon, and relay races, with various age categories and registration fees. It also commemorates Štefan Seman and supports the running community.

name: Jarný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Stredná odborná škola technická
price_range: 2 € dospelí, 1 € mládež do 18 rokov, 0 € muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov
description: The Jarný beh Michalovčanov is a traditional running race taking place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, in Michalovce, at the V. ZŠ on Školská Street. Competitors can look forward to races in various age categories, including a 400-metre race for children under 9. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant spring sports-day atmosphere, with results announced and medalists awarded.
course_highlights: Start and finish at V. ZŠ, Školská 2, Michalovce
Running courses for various age categories
Short 400 m race for children under 9
additional: The event programme includes the 400 m race start at 9:30 for boys’ and girls’ categories under 9, followed by the announcement of results and awards for medalists at 10:30. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the main race at 10:15; the entry fee covers various age categories. Venue: Michalovce, V. ZŠ, ŠKOLSKÁ 2.

name: ČSOB Bratislava marathon – desiatka, Minimaratón, deti, lezúni
description: The ČSOB Bratislava Marathon is a family-friendly running event with a long-standing tradition, held in Bratislava and attracting runners from Slovakia and abroad. It offers a range of disciplines, from the marathon, half marathon and relay races to the 10K, minimarathon, children’s races and crawling races. The atmosphere is full of emotion, fair play and camaraderie, where everyone who takes the start and pushes their own limits is a winner. The event also supports charitable activities and highlights the importance of helping one another and solidarity.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km marathon course through central Bratislava
The Mattoni 10K and Garmin Run Series Minimarathon as shorter events
Children’s races and crawling races for the youngest participants
additional: The Mattoni 10K starts on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 16:00; the Garmin Run Series Minimarathon starts on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 14:00; children’s races begin on Saturday, 11.04.2026 from 10:00, according to age categories. Relay races have special bib numbers with timing chips. Participant limits are set for individual events (for example, 2,000 for the 10K, 1,500 for the minimarathon and children’s races). The races take place in Bratislava. Registration is open, with various prices. The course includes city streets and the attractive surroundings of Eurovea Galleria.

name: Kysucká desiatka
organizer: Mestské kulturno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto
description: Kysucká desiatka is a running race in Kysucké Nové Mesto, offering courses for various age groups, including children and adults. The race starts in the western part of Murgašova Street. Participants can compete in a 1 km race for children or a 10 km race for adults and juniors. The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre of Kysucké Nové Mesto and offers categories by age and gender. The children’s race starts at 10:05 and the other categories at 10:30. The race is suitable for a broad running community and supports sport in the region.
course_highlights: The course runs through the western part of Murgašova Street in Kysucké Nové Mesto
Categories include a 1 km race for children and a 10 km race for adults
Categories are divided by age and gender, including junior men and junior women
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:05, and the men’s, women’s, junior men’s and junior women’s races start at 10:30. The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Centre of Kysucké Nové Mesto. Contact: Renáta Kováčiková, tel.: 0902 405 190. The 10 km race starts in the western part of Murgašova Street. The event includes categories for children, juniors, men and women, with starts from 10:05 to 10:30. The course runs along the streets of Kysucké Nové Mesto; registration is available online or on site.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok (ČSOB Bratislava maratón 2026) (4.kolo BP SAZ)
description: The Slovak Republic Championships in the men’s and women’s marathon, including masters, are a major athletics event taking place in Bratislava. Competitors can look forward to a well-prepared course and professional organization under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation. The event is part of a race series and offers the opportunity to compete in various categories, including masters. Registration is online and open to the wider running community.
course_highlights: A city-style marathon course in Bratislava
Races for men, women and masters in various categories
Organized under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation
additional: Registration is online and must be completed by 12:00 on 7 April 2026. Team leaders will collect race bibs at check-in at the race office. Warm-ups are permitted outside the competition course. Changing facilities are available for boys and girls. Official results will be published on the Slovak Athletic Federation website. The event is part of the ČSOB Bratislava Marathon 2026 and is open to all age groups, including masters.
sources: http://statistika.atletika.sk/admin/media/propozice/MAJSTROVSTVA SR v maratone - propozicie_12.4.2026, Bratislava akt..pdf

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 2. kolo
description: The Trenčín Running League is a series of nine running events organized around Trenčín since 2015, open to the general public, including competitive runners and enthusiasts. One race takes place each month from March to November on a different, varied and interesting course. The races offer a friendly atmosphere, motivation, and the chance to meet people who support a healthy lifestyle. The results and points awarded after each race provide motivation for further training and improving performance.
course_highlights: An 8.95 km course with 130 m of elevation gain in Trenčianske Stankovce, mostly off-road, with 20% asphalt
The routes follow dirt roads, the embankment around a pond, village roads, and hills
Start and finish at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce
additional: Check-in and registration take place on site from 9:00. The entry fee is paid on site. Runners can make a voluntary contribution to the Joint Boarding School in Trenčín. Running with a dog is allowed, but a runner with a dog receives 1 participation point, with no points awarded according to finishing place. The league race takes place at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce. The event supports the community and a healthy lifestyle and is suitable for all ages and running levels.

name: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom
organizer: Technická univerzita vo Zvolene, WoodenWorld, Cyklo Zvolen o.z., Mesto Zvolen
description: Šrégom Night Run in Zvolen is a night race organized by the Woodenworld student organization at the Technical University in Zvolen and the City of Zvolen. Runners complete a 7 km course with 40 meters of elevation gain through the city of Zvolen, passing notable places such as Zvolen Castle, SNP Square, and the Hron River. The event offers electronic timekeeping, refreshments, prizes for place winners, and a commemorative item. The race starts at 20:30 in front of the Technical University and is suitable for the general public, including university students and staff.
course_highlights: A 7 km course with 40 m of elevation gain through the city of Zvolen
Passes Zvolen Castle and SNP Square
The route runs along the Hron River and finishes at the Technical University
additional: Online registration until 13.4.2026 costs €12; registration on race day from 18:30 to 20:00 costs €15. The entry fee includes a race bib, electronic timekeeping, refreshments, prizes, and a commemorative item. Competitors under 18 may take part with the consent of a legal guardian. Staff and students of TU Zvolen can enter the club name "Technical University" to be included in the ranking of the best TU runners. The race takes place at night, with a route passing notable landmarks in Zvolen. Registration is available online or on site. Men’s and women’s categories compete across different age groups.

name: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov
location: Základná škola Sídlisko II., Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia
description: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov is a traditional running event in Vranov nad Topľou, offering a nighttime running experience through the city. The race takes place on the grounds of Sídlisko II Primary School and is open to men, women, and children. The main race starts at 19:30, and the children’s race begins at 17:00. The organizers are OZ S rukou v ruke, Sídlisko II Primary School, the City of Vranov nad Topľou, and OZ Vranovské Vydry, who warmly invite all runners to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Night run through the city of Vranov
Start and finish at Sídlisko II Primary School
Categories for men, women, and children
additional: The children’s race starts at 17:00. On-site entry fee: €20. Night course, online and on-site registration, children’s race, relay races

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a demanding international ultrarunning race taking place on April 18, 2026. The route runs from the center of Košice to Miskolc, challenging runners with a long course across varied terrain. The event is part of a series of running events organized by Maratónsky klub Košice and is intended for endurance runners seeking a unique experience that pushes them to their limits. The start is on Hlavná Street in Košice, giving the race a historic atmosphere and support from local spectators.
course_highlights: The route runs from Košice to Miskolc across varied terrain
Start and finish in Košice’s historic center on Hlavná Street
An international race crossing the border
additional: The race starts on Hlavná Street in Košice, between the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel and the Dargov department store. The event is part of the Košice Marathon events series and is organized by Maratónsky klub Košice. Specific information about start waves, capacity, or fees is not provided. The race starts at 6:00 and 7:00; registration deadlines and fees are specified. The races take place on Hlavná Street and at Dolná brána in Košice. The event is for runners aged 16 and over, with individual, pairs, and relay categories.

name: Ultramaratón Miškolc - Košice
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice–Miskolc Ultramarathon is a prestigious running event taking place on April 18, 2026. Runners travel from Košice to Miskolc on a challenging ultramarathon route. The event is part of the region’s rich running calendar and offers a unique experience for endurance runners. It is organized by Maratónsky klub Košice, which provides professional preparation and organization.
course_highlights: An ultramarathon route from Košice to Miskolc
Challenging terrain requiring endurance and fitness
Crosses two countries—Slovakia and Hungary
additional: The event is part of a series of running events in Košice, including the International Peace Marathon and other accompanying events. Organizers offer opportunities to participate as a volunteer, driver, or pacer. Runners receive comprehensive organizational support and benefits associated with the entry fee. The course follows cycle paths and has low traffic, with categories for individuals and two-, five-, and ten-person relay teams; start times are 6:00 and 7:00.

name: BoleRuN
location: areál TJ Slavoj Boleráz, Boleráz, Slovakia
description: BoleRuN is a running event held at the TJ Slavoj Boleráz grounds, offering courses for different age groups, including children, teenagers, and adults. Runners can compete over distances from 50 metres to 10 km, with the children’s start at 13:00 and the adults’ start at 14:00. The event is organised by the Municipality of Boleráz in cooperation with the Boleráz – Hýb sa initiative. It is suitable for runners aged 9 and over who want to enjoy a day of sport in a pleasant setting.
course_highlights: Adult courses: 10 km and 5 km
Course for teenagers aged 10 to 14: 2 km
Course for children under 9: from 50 metres to 1 km
additional: Children’s start at 13:00; adults’ start at 14:00. Categories are divided by age and course distance. The event is organised by the Municipality of Boleráz and the Boleráz – Hýb sa initiative. Registration is likely closed as of April 2024; the event includes categories for children and adults, electronic timekeeping, and a participant medal.

name: Šarišská míľa
description: Šarišská míľa is a running event organized by BK ZasRun in Šarišské Bohdanovce at the football pitch. The race is open to various age groups, including children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking participants. The starts are divided into the children’s mile, running and Nordic Walking for women, and running and Nordic Walking for men. Entry is free, with the option to make a voluntary contribution at registration. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all levels and ages.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football pitch in Šarišské Bohdanovce
Categories for children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking participants
Starts are divided into the children’s mile, running and Nordic Walking for women, and running and Nordic Walking for men
additional: Entry is free, with the option to make a voluntary contribution at registration. The children’s mile starts at 16:00, the women’s running and Nordic Walking events at 16:20, and the men’s running and Nordic Walking events at 16:45. Categories are divided by age and gender, including overall rankings for Nordic Walking. The race starts at 16:00, is open to the general public, and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Chlieb náš….
description: Chlieb Náš is an artisan bakery in Hronský Beňadik that makes sourdough bread using traditional methods and quality ingredients. It takes pride in honest baking, reflected in the bread’s crisp crust, lively sourdough starter and soft interior. The bakery offers an authentic experience where you can choose fresh bread straight from the oven. In addition to the quality of its bread, the bakery is also known for its unique Baroque ceiling, one of the most original in Trnava.
course_highlights: Traditional sourdough bread baking using quality ingredients
Crisp crust and soft bread interior
Unique Baroque ceiling in the bakery
additional: The bakery is open Tuesday to Friday from 7:00 to 16:00 and Saturday from 7:00 to 11:30, or until sold out. The business emphasizes honest artisan production and the family character of Trnka Gastronomy. The event is associated with traditional bread baking and is held at Dumas bakery in Hronský Beňadik. It is suitable for anyone interested in the baking craft.

name: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička
description: The Turčianska Štiavnička Liberation Run is a traditional race with a rich history, held to mark the anniversary of the village’s liberation by the Soviet Army. The 32nd edition will take place on April 18, 2026, at the football field in Turčianska Štiavnička. The approximately 10 km course runs mainly through mountainous terrain and offers runners a challenging but beautiful experience. Competitors are divided into age categories, with awards also given in the children’s categories and to the top runners from Štiavnička. The organizers welcome all runners and look forward to their participation.
course_highlights: The course runs mainly through mountainous terrain, along forest roads and through the local park
Approximately 10 km long, known as the “Štiavnická desiatka”
Start and finish by the cultural center and football field in the village
additional: Online registration is open from 1.4.2026 to 16.4.2026. The race is divided into men’s age categories, women’s categories and children’s categories. The race bibs are traditionally sewn and printed according to the original design from Ružomberok and are still used today. A ceremonial wreath-laying at the memorial to fallen heroes takes place before the race. Races start at 10:00 and 13:15; registration is available from April 1 to 16, 2026. The event has historical significance and is part of the local calendar of sporting events.

name: Banská Bystrica - Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici
location: Park pod pamätníkom SNP, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Bežíme spolu in Banská Bystrica is a running event held in the park below the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica. It offers four distances, including a children’s run, and is suitable for the general public, including children under 6. The course is flat, with no elevation gain, making for an enjoyable run for all age groups. The event supports people with disabilities: €2 from each entry fee goes towards motivating them to be physically active.
course_highlights: Flat courses with no elevation gain
Four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 3 km and a 500 m children’s run
Start and finish in the park below the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica
additional: Support: €2 from each paid entry fee goes towards supporting people with disabilities. The children’s run is for children under 6 (born 2020–2026) and requires the presence of a legal guardian. Entry fees are valid from 7 April 2026. The course has no elevation gain, making the race easy to run. The course is flat; registration is online; the event supports people with disabilities; information about consent to the use of data is included.

name: Polus Tower Run
location: Polus Tower 2, Bratislava-Nové Mesto, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Polus Tower Run is a unique stair-climbing event taking place on April 18, 2026, at the Polus Tower 2 office building in Bratislava. Competitors climb the elevation under their own power on two courses: a children’s course with 4 floors and 116 steps, and the main adult course with 19 floors and 416 steps. Participants start individually at 30-second intervals, and times are recorded electronically. The event is organized by the KOTRMELEC Sports Foundation and is conducted under the applicable TWA rules.
course_highlights: Adults: 19 floors / 416 steps, distance 400 m, elevation gain +80 m
PHZ (police officers, firefighters, paramedics): 416 steps / 19 floors, distance 400 m, elevation gain +80 m
Children: 4 floors / 116 steps, distance 200 m, elevation gain +21 m
additional: The children’s start is at 11:00, and the adults’ start is at 11:30. The awards ceremony is at 13:00. The course surface is 100% tile. Participants start individually at 30-second intervals, with electronic timekeeping. Awards are given by age category for men and women. Stair race, multiple categories, online registration, limited to 300 participants, race for children and adults, various age groups and medals

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
description: TIPOS National Run Devín–Bratislava is Slovakia’s oldest sporting event, with a tradition spanning more than 100 years, and will be held for the 78th time. Runners will follow the iconic route from historic Devín Castle to the centre of Bratislava, creating a unique atmosphere that brings history and sport together. The event is suitable for recreational athletes as well as more demanding runners, and attracts thousands of participants of different ages every year. It is organised by STaRZ of the City of Bratislava, which provides all organisational information and registration.
course_highlights: The route runs from Devín Castle to the centre of Bratislava
Road race with more than 5,000 participants
Historic, iconic running tradition dating back to 1921
additional: Online registration is open until 15 April 2026 at 20:00. Group registration is available by emailing hromadne_prihlasky@starz.sk with billing details. A limited-edition T-shirt is available for EUR 13. The start list is available online. The event is organised by STaRZ of the City of Bratislava. The event includes various courses in Devín, registration is available online, and it is part of the Slovak Athletics Association running series. Results and statistics can also be followed on the official websites.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
organizer: Obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ Sačurov, MŠ Sačurov
description: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20th Helena Sluková Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Sačurov in Vranov nad Topľou District. The race starts in front of the primary school in Sačurov and offers categories for different age groups, including children, juniors and adults. The main category starts at 13:00, and the children’s race at 12:00. The organizers are the Municipality of Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, and Sačurov Primary and Nursery School. The race is suitable for local runners and beginners alike.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Sačurov, in front of the primary school
Categories range from preschool age to seniors over 70
Awards for the top runners from Vranov District
additional: The entry fee must be paid online only. Men over 70 and women over 60 do not pay an entry fee. The children’s race starts at 12:00, and the main categories start at 13:00. Awards for the top runners from Vranov District are part of the event. The race is part of a community-support event, with online registration and various categories for all age groups.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča
location: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, Slovenská Kajňa, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, Bežecká akadémia Marcela Matanina
description: Kajňanská Desiatka – Ján Oslovič Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Slovenská Kajňa. The event offers three disciplines: a 10 km long race, a 3.66 km short race, and a 3.66 km short Nordic walking event. All start together at 13:00. The competition is divided into several age categories for men and women, welcoming participants of different ages and abilities. The organizer is MATORE s.r.o., which provides race organization and timing.
course_highlights: A 10 km long race in the pleasant surroundings of Slovenská Kajňa
A 3.66 km short race and Nordic walking event with the same start time
Several age categories for men and women
additional: On-site registration is available from 9:30 on race day. The participant limit for adults is 130. All disciplines start together at 13:00. The event includes several categories and age groups, with registration available online and on-site. The start is scheduled for 13:00, and the event also includes children’s races and accompanying activities.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča

Runners can choose from 10 km and 4 km races, Nordic Walking with no age limit, or children’s categories. The main race starts at 13:00, and the children’s races begin at 12:00. The organizers are the Municipality of Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, and the Marcel Matanin Running Academy. The event is part of the POWERGRAF Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km and 4 km races, plus Nordic Walking, in the municipality of Slovenská Kajňa
Start in front of the Municipal Office building
Part of the POWERGRAF Michalovce–Sobrance Running League 2026
additional: The children’s races start at 12:00. The participant limit is 150. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic Walking. The organizers are the Municipality of Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, and the Marcel Matanin Running Academy. Details about registration and entry fees have not yet been published, but this is an important running event in the region.

name: Oslobodenie Likavka - Beh oslobodenia o Putovný pohár starostu obce Likavka
location: Futbalový štadión Obecného športového klubu v Likavke, Likavka, Ružomberok, Slovakia
description: The Run for Liberation for the Likavka Mayor’s Traveling Cup is a traditional running race organized by the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Primary School with Kindergarten. The race takes place at the Municipal Sports Club’s football stadium in Likavka and is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. Children, pupils, juniors, women, and men can compete in various age categories. According to the race regulations, the pupils’ start is at 10:05 and the adults’ start is at 11:40. The race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to test your strength in the pleasant surroundings of Likavka.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Municipal Sports Club’s football stadium in Likavka
Part of the 2025 Liptov Running League
Categories for children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age groups
additional: According to the race regulations, the pupils’ start is at 10:05 and the adults’ start is at 11:40. Categories include children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age groups. The organizers are the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Primary School with Kindergarten. The race is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. The race takes place at the football stadium; registration is available online and on-site, the event includes various categories, and it is part of a regional running series.

name: Čadčianska desiatka
description: The Čadca Ten is a traditional running race organized by the Kysuce Marathon Club Čadca, the town of Čadca, and the Čadca Žarec Social Services Centre. The 30th edition will take place on 19 April 2026, starting at 10:00 in the Žarec housing estate in Čadca. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and a welcoming atmosphere at an event popular with the region’s running community. Online registration is open until 17 April 2026. You can also register on race day for a higher entry fee.
course_highlights: A traditional running race with a long history
Start and finish at the Žarec housing estate in Čadca
Race for the Mayor of Čadca Cup
additional: Registration is also available on race day for the higher entry fee of €10. Organizers ask participants to register even if they are unsure whether they can attend, to speed up check-in and minimize errors when recording names. If you do not attend, your name will not appear in the results. The race takes place on 19 April 2026 at 10:00. Registration is open until 17 April 2026. The start and finish are at the Žarec housing estate. The race is part of a traditional sporting event with a rich history.

name: UCM Night Run
description: UCM Night Run is a charity evening run taking place on 21 April 2026 at 20:00 at Trojičné námestie in Trnava. Runners will complete a 5-kilometre route through the historic streets of Trnava’s centre, offering the unique atmosphere of the “Little Rome.” The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability, and brings the community together through movement and support for those in need. Proceeds from the run will go towards rehabilitation and treatment for a child with a disability. The organisers are the City of Trnava, FMK UCM students and main partner CUKROVAR.
course_highlights: 5 km route through the historic streets of Trnava’s centre
Evening atmosphere at Trojičné námestie
Charity event supporting people with disabilities
additional: Programme: 16:00–19:15 registration, 19:00 guest appearances, 19:30 warm-up and route presentation, 20:00 start. Timing is provided by Terminovka. The event is partnering with the APPkA.app app to support people with disabilities. Registration via terminovka.sk. The event includes a charity collection, discussions about the CUKROVAR project, refreshments and a chill zone with a DJ.

name: Ultra Kras
location: Národný park Slovenský kras, Turni nad Bodvou, Slovakia
description: Ultra Kras is a mountain ultramarathon covering 57 km with 2,400 m of elevation gain, running through Slovak Karst National Park. The start and finish are in Turňa nad Bodvou, and the race has a 12-hour time limit. It is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and offers a challenging course with several refreshment and checkpoint stations. Race-pack collection takes place the day before the start and on race day, with a mass start at 7:00 a.m.
course_highlights: The course runs through Slovak Karst National Park
57 km with +2,400 m of elevation gain
Live checkpoints at refreshment stations
additional: Participant registration takes place on Friday, 24 April 2026, from 18:00 to 22:00, and on Saturday, 25 April 2026, from 5:00 to 6:30. The time limit is 12 hours from the start, meaning runners must finish by 19:00. Checkpoint K3 Hačava (30 km) has a cutoff of 7.5 hours after the start (by 14:30). The start and finish are at the parking lot next to Hviezda cinema in Turňa nad Bodvou. Electronic timing records arrivals at checkpoints and the finish. 57 km course, 12-hour time limit, registration on 24–25 April, refreshment stations, mandatory equipment, men’s and women’s categories, part of the Slovak Ultratrail League.

name: Demänovský Štvanec
location: Demänová rezort, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia
organizer: WinTeam o.z. a Agentúra 8P v spolupráci s Demänová rezort
description: Demänovský Štvanec is a running event for both recreational runners and competitive athletes, held amid the beautiful scenery of Demänovská Valley in Liptovský Mikuláš. The event offers three disciplines: the 5 km Malý Štvanec, the 10 km Veľký Štvanec with TUI, and the children’s Štvanček races. Alongside the sporting experience, participants can enjoy a family-friendly atmosphere and additional activities at Demänová Resort. The event is part of a weekend full of movement, games and fun, organized by WinTeam o.z. and Agentúra 8P in cooperation with Demänová Resort.
course_highlights: The courses pass through the beautiful scenery of Demänovská Valley
The 5 km Malý Štvanec and 10 km Veľký Štvanec have time limits of 1:30 and 2:00 hours, respectively
Children’s Štvanček races have staggered starts by age category
additional: Registration and race-number pickup are available on Friday, 24.04.2026, from 17:00 to 19:00, and on Saturday, 25.04.2026, from 8:00 to 10:00 for children and adults. Timing for adults is provided by VOS-TPK using chips, with results published live at www.sportsofttiming.sk. When booking a stay at Demänová Resort, the entry fee is included in the accommodation price. Children’s categories start in stages from 11:00 according to age. The event includes online and on-site registration, categories for different age groups, family activities, and accommodation packages at Demänová Resort.

name: Račiansky polmaratón, Račianska desiatka
location: Športový areál Tbiliská 4, Bratislava-Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The Rača Half Marathon and Rača Ten are traditional running events in the Bratislava-Rača borough, offering participants the choice of a half marathon or a 10K. Runners can enjoy a course through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex and the surrounding parts of Rača. The event is suitable for the general public, including recreational runners and more competitive athletes. It is organised by the Bratislava-Rača borough, which provides quality facilities and services for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tbiliská 4 sports complex in Bratislava-Rača
Choose between the half-marathon and 10K courses
The route passes through the Rača borough in a pleasant urban setting

name: Prešov Running Series 1. kolo
price_range: 10 eur (detský štart), zľava 2 eurá pre poistencov Dôvery
description: Prešov Running, o.z. warmly invites you to Prešov Stars Run 2026, taking place on April 25 in the centre of Prešov. This running evening will take you back to the atmosphere of the 1990s, with music, retro sportswear and fun. Runners can choose from children’s races and 5 km and 10 km courses, accompanied along the way by DJs and a performance by MC Erik. Prešov Stars Run is the first event in the Prešov Running Series 2026, which consists of three separate runs in different parts of the city and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Running courses in the centre of Prešov
Music from DJs during the run
Retro atmosphere with 1990s hits and a performance by MC Erik
additional: Dôvera policyholders can get a €2 discount on the entry fee (excluding children’s races). The discount is non-transferable, and if you are unable to attend, cancellation is possible only by the date specified in the race information. After a warm-up to Cvičme v Rytme with Omnis Vitality, the 5 km and 10 km runners will start. The Prešov Running Series 2026 consists of three separate runs held in April, June and September. The course includes city streets. Online registration is available, and the event features an accompanying programme of music and performances.

name: Gavurky run 2026 + Backyard ultra
description: Gavurky Run 2026 is a running event in Dobrá Niva offering several distances, including the main race, a hobby run, Nordic walking and a Backyard ultra. The races take place on 25 April 2026, with registration and starts at SNP Square. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, recreational runners and ultramarathoners, with capacity limited to 400 participants. The organizer, ŠPORTKLUB Dobrá Niva, o.z., provides professional event management and timekeeping.
course_highlights: Main race: 10.4 km with 190 m of elevation gain
