organizer: Občianske združenie Bežecko Triatlonový klub Veľký Biel
description: BTK RUN FEST 2026 is a running event for everyone, taking place on May 9 in the grounds of the manor house in Veľký Biel. It offers various disciplines, including 5 km and 10 km road races, children’s races, a parent + child relay, and an adrenaline-filled obstacle race for children and adults. The routes run mainly on asphalt and paved surfaces around a lake in scenic surroundings. The event is suitable for recreational runners, families, and experienced athletes, with awards and medals for the top finishers and all finishers.
course_highlights: 85% asphalt and 15% paved surfaces
Flat route around the lake, with the start and finish at the manor house
Two laps for the 10 km race will test runners’ fitness
additional: The children’s races are 350 m, 600 m, and 1,000 m long. The parent + child relay is 2 × 350 m. The obstacle race is for children and adults and is 1 km long. The entry fee includes a race number, refreshments, photos, and awards. On-site registration is available if the participant limit has not been reached. Start times are scheduled by discipline from 09:00 to 13:10, with results announced between races. The event takes place on a surface consisting of 85% asphalt and 15% paved areas; registration is open with different deadlines and fees; races include various distances and categories for adults and children.

name: Fiľakovský cross
description: The Fiľakovo Cross is a running event organized by OZ FTC Fiľakovo and the Sports and Physical Education Commission of the Municipal Council in Fiľakovo. The races take place at the FTC stadium in Fiľakovo and offer various categories, including children’s, hobby and Nordic walking. The course combines dirt roads, asphalt and grass, making the run varied and interesting. The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 12:30. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a welcoming sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course surface: dirt roads, asphalt and grass
Start and finish: FTC stadium in Fiľakovo
Various categories, including children’s, hobby and Nordic walking
additional: The children’s race starts at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 12:30. Categories include children’s, hobby and Nordic walking. The organizers are OZ FTC Fiľakovo and the Sports and Physical Education Commission of the Municipal Council in Fiľakovo. Contact persons: Mgr. Attila Visnyai (0915 163 310), Mgr. Gabriel Nagy (0908 948 429). The event includes various courses ranging from approximately 3 to 14 km. Registration is open from 1.4.2024 to 10.5.2024, and the event is intended for all age groups, including children and hobby runners.

name: EuroPainClinics Horský beh Bardejov
location: Reštaurácia Kúpeľná dvorana, Bardejovské Kúpele, Bardejov, Slovakia
organizer: EPC Pro Health Team a BarRan Team

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Online registrácia a úhrada štartovného do 27. 04. 2026 s garanciou všetkých benefitov

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Úhrada štartovného do 05. 05. 2026 bez garancie niektorých benefitov (napr. tričko)

description: EuroPainClinics Bardejov Mountain Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque setting of Bardejovské Kúpele. Runners can choose from three courses: a cross-country half marathon with more than 1,000 metres of elevation gain, a seven-kilometre spa course, and accompanying children’s and youth categories. The event is suitable for all runners who enjoy challenging terrain and mountain running. The organizers provide on-course refreshments, medals, T-shirts and other benefits for participants who register early.
course_highlights: Course A: 22 km cross-country half marathon with 1,000+ m of elevation gain
Course A refreshments at the 8 km mark near Zborov Castle and at the 15 km mark on Stebnícka Magura (899 m above sea level)
Course B: Spa Seven, 7 km with 180+ m of elevation gain
additional: Registration for Course C (children and youth) takes place at the event venue; the number of starters is limited to 80. Runners in Courses A and B receive free parking in Bardejovské Kúpele, a race bib with a chip, a T-shirt, on-course refreshments, a medal, trophies, prizes, lunch and a post-race drink. Times are not recorded for Course C; all participants receive a medal and a sweet treat. The course runs through mountain terrain. Registration is available online or on-site. There are several categories, including children and youth, a race-day programme, and detailed instructions for participants.

name: Beh pre Labky
organizer: Únia vzájomnej pomoci ľudí a psov
description: Beh pre labky 2026 is a charity run organized by the Union of Mutual Aid for People and Dogs (UVP), taking place in Košice, in the Kavečany area near Chata Hrešná. The event’s 10th edition gives runners the opportunity to support a good cause while enjoying a pleasant run in nature. The course is 5 km long and suitable for all age groups, including children and runners with dogs. The event is open to the general public and offers various categories by age and participant type.
course_highlights: The route runs through the natural surroundings of Kavečany near Chata Hrešná
The course is 5 km long and consists of one lap
Participants can run with their own dog or a dog from a shelter
additional: The event is a charity run organized by the Union of Mutual Aid for People and Dogs (UVP). Categories include men, women, boys and girls under 15, as well as categories for participants with a dog and with a shelter dog. Registration is through pretekaj.sk, where users can create an account to manage their entries. The event supports people and dogs in need. Registration is available online, and results are posted on the organizer’s website.

name: DOBRObeh
organizer: KERIC Čadca, Centrum voľného času Čadca, Terminovka.sk, Červený kríž, Detské oddelenie KNsP Čadca, Mesto Čadca
description: DOBRObeh is a charity run in Čadca offering five different courses, including the main Mária Marcibálová Run, which is 21.5 km long with 600 m of elevation gain. The course runs mainly through forest, on asphalt and across meadows, and is clearly marked and supported by event organizers. The event is for all runners who want to support a good cause, and everyone who takes part is a winner. The start is on Palárikova Street by the Rybka fountain in the pedestrian zone in Čadca. Alongside the main run, shorter courses are also available, including 10 km, 4.5 km and children’s runs.
course_highlights: Mária Marcibálová Run: 21.5 km with +600 m elevation gain; 70% forest, 10% asphalt, 20% meadow
KERICross 10 km: 65% asphalt, 25% meadow, 10% gravel; +180 m elevation gain
Run Through the City 4.5 km: 90% asphalt, 10% forest; +42 m elevation gain
additional: Mandatory equipment: your own drinking cup, trail shoes, a mobile phone with the organizer’s number, a watch or mobile phone with the route, and folding running or hiking poles. Refreshment stations at 3.8 km and 13.8 km. The course is clearly marked with arrows and ribbons, and organizers guide runners at ambiguous points. Awards ceremony at 12:30. A charity run with no winners’ awards, where everyone who supports DOBRO is a winner. Participants can contribute food or money. The event offers various courses, including a 21.5 km run, and supports people in need.

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Bratislava
description: The Wings for Life World Run Bratislava is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants start at the same time and race against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up with them. There is no finish line; runners keep going until the car passes them. The course runs through Sad Janka Kráľa, one of the oldest parks in Europe, and combines different settings. The event supports spinal cord injury research, with 100% of registration fees going to this cause. The race starts at exactly 1:00 p.m.
course_highlights: The course runs through Sad Janka Kráľa, one of the oldest parks in Europe
A mix of different settings on a 2 km course
The virtual Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed
additional: The race is open to runners and wheelchair participants, who take part together. The virtual Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the race begins at 14 km/h and gradually speeds up until it passes all participants. Participation is only possible through the Wings for Life World Run mobile app. 100% of all registration fees go to spinal cord injury research. Registration is online, the run is supported by the Wings for Life World Run app, and all proceeds go to spinal cord injury research.

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Nižná Myšľa
description: Wings for Life World Run in Nižná Myšľa is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants race against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up with them. The route starts at the Nižná Myšľa archaeological open-air museum, a well-known archaeological site, and passes along forest trails and unpaved roads, through meadows and the village, combining paved and natural surfaces. The race starts on May 10, 2026, at 13:00, and all registration fees go towards spinal cord injury research. Join runners around the world and challenge yourself in this global race with no finish line.
course_highlights: The route is 20% paved and 80% forest trails and unpaved roads
Start and finish at the Nižná Myšľa archaeological open-air museum, with full facilities and refreshments
The route passes archaeological sites and the scenic natural landscapes of the Košice Basin and Slanské Mountains
additional: The virtual Catcher Car sets off 30 minutes after the start at 14 km/h and gradually speeds up until it catches all the runners. Nordic walking is welcome. Parking, changing rooms and bag storage are available at the archaeological open-air museum. 100% of registration fees go towards spinal cord injury research. The route includes paved roads, forest trails and unpaved roads; the start is at the archaeological open-air museum, parking is on site, and registration is via the app.

name: Benefičný beh PRO AUTIS
description: The PRO AUTIS Charity Run is a charitable running event whose proceeds go to the PRO AUTIS autism centre in Trenčín. The race takes place in Soblahov near Trenčín and offers various courses, including children’s races and distances of 5 km, 10 km and 13.3 km. The event is open to all runners with no age limit, and the organisers emphasise personal performance and pushing your own limits. Online registration is available until 8 May 2026, with on-site registration also available on race day.
course_highlights: 5 km, 10 km and 13.3 km courses with elevation gain of up to 482 m
Electronic timing at the start and finish
Children’s races of 300 m and 800 m for different age groups
additional: Registration closes 20 minutes before the race starts. Participants are considered confirmed only after paying the entry fee. On-site registration is available from 8:00 at the former forester’s lodge. The organiser provides refreshments at the start and finish. Parking is available along the road towards the village if the car park is full. Live results are available online at VysledkovyServis.sk. The first three places will be announced during the race. Course distances: 5 km, 10 km, 13.3 km; children’s races: 300 m and 800 m; online registration; race number with a chip; medical information on the race number; parking along the road towards the village.

name: Beh do Strečnianských hradných schodov
description: The Run up the Strečno Castle Stairs is a challenging race in Strečno near Žilina, testing your fitness on a course with 151 steps and an elevation gain of 144 metres. The race is open to all youth categories, university students, women and men. The start is at the car park below Strečno Castle, with youth starting at 10:15 and students and adults at 11:45. The event is organised by the Institute of Physical Education of the University of Žilina and OK Žilina, who ensure the event runs smoothly. The entry deadline is 10 May 2026; late entries are possible only in exceptional cases.
course_highlights: The course follows 151 steps with an elevation gain of 144 metres
Start at the car park below Strečno Castle
Categories for youth, university students, women and men
additional: Youth start at 10:15; university students and adults start at 11:45. Late entries are possible only in exceptional cases. The race takes place in May, with registration open until 10 May 2023. It includes several categories and different start times for youth and adults.

name: Memoriál Františka Daniša – cezpoľný beh
description: The František Daniš Memorial Cross-Country Run is a running event held at the football field in the village of Trstín, Trnava District. The course runs mainly along field and grassy paths, with a short section on an asphalt footpath. Men, women, juniors and residents of Trstín compete in different age categories, with some categories running two laps. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy natural surfaces and cross-country running in the pleasant surroundings of Trstín.
course_highlights: Three quarters of the course is on field and grassy paths
One quarter of the course is on an asphalt footpath
The race takes place at the football field in Trstín
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender; some categories run two laps, and residents of Trstín have their own category. Local contacts: Trstín Municipality, tel. 033/558 92 62, email outrstin@slovanet.sk; Mayor Peter Hlávek, tel. 0918 775 109, email starosta@trstin.sk. The event includes several categories and is part of the Spring Health Run. On-site registration is also possible. Registration is available by contacting the organizers.

name: Turčiansky beh
description: Turčiansky Beh is a charity race taking place on May 23, 2026, at the football stadium in Belá-Dulice. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km routes through gently undulating terrain on dirt roads and gravel, with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain. The event supports a good cause: all funds raised will go towards treatment for a 4-year-old boy with autism and the “Children of My Heart” project. Participants will receive gifts, raffle tickets and commemorative medals, and there will be entertainment for children, so parents can run while their children are looked after. Refreshments and parking are available at the start and finish.
course_highlights: The route follows dirt roads and gravel
Gently undulating terrain with 40 to 80 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Belá-Dulice football stadium
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 8:00 to 11:00. Before the start, each participant will receive a drink, a fitness bar and a gift from the partners. The entry fee includes one raffle ticket, with additional tickets available to purchase. Every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. Professional entertainers and attractions will be available for children. Parking is available by the start/finish area. Refreshments and drinks can be purchased on site. Virtual runners will be sent a gift and medal to their address after the event. The terrain consists of dirt roads and asphalt. Changing rooms, showers and refreshments are available on site. Registration is available online, with a virtual participation option.

name: Beh Gáňom
price_range: 10 € pre hlavný beh, 5 € pre beh zdravia, 2 € pre obyvateľov Gáňa
description: Beh Gáňom is a running event held in the village of Gáň, Galanta District, in front of the Cultural Centre. The race offers categories for children, adults and seniors, including a main race and a health run. Starts are staggered: children’s categories at 9:00, the health run at 9:45 and the main race at 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public, including village residents, who receive a discounted entry fee. The organiser is Tomáš Mrva, who also provides contact information for those interested.
course_highlights: The race takes place in front of the Cultural Centre in Gáň
Several categories, including children, adults and seniors
Staggered starts for children’s categories, the health run and the main race
additional: Categories include men and women in various age groups, girls and boys grouped by year of birth, and a kindergarten category for the health run (boys and girls). The course is on asphalt and runs through an urban area and possibly a park. On-site registration is available. The event is open to all age groups, including children.

name: VEREDA Night Run
organizer: VEREDA sport a OZ Dobrý pohyb

description: VEREDA Night Run is a night race in Považská Bystrica, offering an 8 km course and the option to compete in relays (2 x 4 km). The race is open to individuals, pairs, children, and corporate teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The event is organised by VEREDA sport and OZ Dobrý pohyb with the support of the city of Považská Bystrica, and is known for its atmosphere and community spirit. The start is by the fountain near Kino Mier, with the children’s race beginning at 17:00 and the main starts at 20:30.
course_highlights: Night race with an 8 km course
Relay option: 2 x 4 km
The course is in Považská Bystrica, starting by the fountain near Kino Mier
additional: The children’s race starts at 17:00, and the main start for individuals and pairs is at 20:30. The corporate race is only on the 8 km course, with the times of each company’s three fastest runners added together. Registration will not be available at the venue on race day. The number of child runners is limited to 350. The event takes place on 16 May 2026; registration is required. The course is unspecified, and the race is open to various categories, including relays and children.

name: Strachan run
location: Ski centre Strednica, Ždiar, Prešov, Slovakia
description: Strachan Run 2026 at Strednica is the second edition of a trail race held in the picturesque Goral village of Ždiar, beneath the Belianske Tatras. Runners can look forward to an unforgettable sporting experience at Strachankovo Family Park and the Strednica Ski Centre. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts who want to enjoy nature and sport in one. The organizers invite all runners to this attractive event with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail courses in the Goral village of Ždiar, beneath the Belianske Tatras
The setting of Strachankovo Family Park and the Strednica Ski Centre
Natural scenery and forest trails suitable for trail running
additional: Race registration and pricing are not published on the website. Strachankovo is scheduled to open on May 1, 2026. Free parking is available by the Medvedí brloh Strachan restaurant and directly above the park. The chairlift is not in operation during the summer season. Race categories for children, three different routes, a sporting event in nature in the area around Ždiar at Strednica, ski passes and wellness discounts included, registration online and on site.

name: O putovný pohár starostu obce Vlachy
location: Kultúrny dom Vlachy, Vlachy, Liptovský Mikuláš, Slovakia
description: The Race for the Mayor of Vlachy’s Challenge Cup is a 6,900-metre running race with 150 metres of elevation gain. The race takes place at the cultural centre in Vlachy, in the Liptovský Mikuláš District. It is a traditional running event that attracts runners from the surrounding area and offers a challenge in the form of a gentle climb along the course. The organizers warmly welcome all runners who want to test themselves in the beautiful surroundings of the village of Vlachy.
course_highlights: 6,900-metre course
150 metres of elevation gain
Race in the village of Vlachy, Liptovský Mikuláš
additional: The race takes place at the Vlachy Cultural Centre. Start times are 10:15 and 11:00; registration is available online or on site.

name: RETRO Night Run
organizer: Športové centrum RETRO sport & wellness, SPORT RETRO, s.r.o.
price_range: 5€ pre deti, 7€ až 17€ pre dospelých v závislosti od registračného termínu
description: RETRO Night Run is a running event in Bratislava featuring a night race with various categories for children and adults. The race takes place at OC RETRO on Nevädzová Street and is organised by RETRO sport & wellness sports centre. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km courses, with children’s races starting at 16:00 and the main races at 20:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for a night run in the city.
course_highlights: Night run in central Bratislava
Two main courses: 5 km and 10 km
Categories for children from age 3 through to veterans
additional: Children’s races start at 16:00, the 10 km main race at 20:00, and the 5 km race at 20:05. Categories are available for children aged 3 to 15, based on year of birth, and for adults in age groups from 18 years to 60+. The organiser is Športové centrum RETRO sport & wellness, SPORT RETRO, s.r.o. Contact person: Lucia Škultétiová, tel.: 0905 480 700. The event takes place at night, with online registration available, and is suitable for families and anyone who enjoys nighttime sporting experiences.

name: Detva behá, tak sa pridaj!
price_range: 13€ (pre registráciu do 13.5.2026), 20€ na mieste, 10€ pre obyvateľov Detvy a členov klubu

description: Detva Runs, So Join In! is a traditional running race in Detva, offering courses for children and adults. The race takes place on May 16, 2026, near 4th J.J. Thurzo Primary School and features the Hobby (6.2 km) and Main (10.7 km) courses, on forest roads and asphalt. The event is suitable for the general public, including various age groups, and includes children’s races, which have no entry fee. Organized by ŠK Detva v pohybe, the event offers a friendly atmosphere and welcomes all runners and families.
course_highlights: The 10.7 km Main course runs on forest roads and asphalt
The Hobby course is 6.2 km long
Children’s categories feature different loops ranging from 50 m to 860 m
additional: Children’s races start at 9:00, the Main course at 10:00, and the Hobby course at 10:10. Children’s categories have free entry. The course surface is a combination of forest roads and asphalt. GPX routes for the Hobby and Main courses are available to download. The event includes courses on forest roads, asphalt, and gravel, with the option to register outside the Terminovka.sk portal, medical assistance, refreshments, and sweet rewards for children.

name: Beh Jednoty
description: Beh Jednoty 2026 in Nové Zámky is an event for everyone—from active athletes to families with children. The program includes children’s races divided by age group and a 5-kilometer main race through the city, suitable for recreational and more competitive runners. Throughout the day, there will be a program of activities for children, refreshments, and a raffle. By taking part, you will support the local community and a good cause, combining sport with helping others.
course_highlights: 5 km race through the streets of Nové Zámky
Children’s races tailored to age groups from preschoolers to older schoolchildren
Route suitable for recreational and more competitive runners
additional: Registration and race number collection are from 08:00 to 09:30. Children’s races take place between 09:00 and 09:30. The results will be announced after the last participant finishes. Every child will receive a medal, and the top finishers in each category will receive trophies. There are four categories based on age and gender. A program of activities for children, refreshments, and a raffle will run throughout the day. 5 km main race, children’s races, accompanying program, online registration, proceeds go to charity

name: Behaj lesmi – Beckov
location: Beckov, Okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Trenčiansky kraj, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Beckov is part of a series of seven races set in beautiful Slovak countryside, offering routes mostly on soft surfaces and in the fresh air. Runners can enjoy an unforgettable day beneath Beckov Castle, with support from the castle guard and views of the surrounding countryside. The routes pass through Beckov’s mysterious corners and are accompanied by legends, making the race an energetic adventure. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, enhancing its international significance and appeal to trail runners.
course_highlights: Routes are 80% on soft surfaces and 100% in the fresh air
The 150-metre Conti Speed Section is marked with Continental flags
Support from the castle guard and views of Beckov Castle and the surrounding countryside
additional: You can change or transfer your entry online through your SportID profile. The Conti Speed Section competition offers a valuable voucher and a running shirt. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, with scoring based on performance and placing. The race offers various discounts on group purchases, routes with GPX files, and the option to track the race on Strava. Children’s races and accompanying activities are also included.

name: Babindolský májový kros
description: The Babindol May Cross-Country Run is a sporting event for running enthusiasts of all ages, held amid the beautiful May scenery of the Lower Nitra region in the village of Babindol. The race offers two main courses, 8 km and 16 km long, running mainly along dirt roads and forest trails with moderate elevation gain. The event also includes a children’s course around the football pitch, an accompanying programme, goulash for runners, and prizes for winners in every category. It is organised by the Municipality of Babindol in cooperation with Zdeno Zamboj, and the start is traditionally at 10:00 at the football pitch in Babindol.
course_highlights: The course runs 90% on dirt roads and forest trails and 10% on asphalt
Two main courses: 8 km with 140 m of elevation gain and 16 km with 240 m of elevation gain
The children’s course consists of two laps around the football pitch
additional: The start and finish are at the football pitch in Babindol. There is no entry fee. The event includes an accompanying programme and goulash for runners. Prizes are prepared for winners in every category. The event also includes an accompanying programme with goulash, medals, certificates, and prizes. Registration is available online or free of charge on-site for children.

name: Nočný beh Hlohovcom

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: pre prihlásených bežcov s riadne uhradeným štartovným do 10. 05. 2026

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: pre prihlásených do ukončenia registrácie do 14. 05. 2026 a pri registrácii na mieste v deň pretekov

description: Nočný beh Hlohovcom is a popular night run taking place on 16 May 2026 in the Castle Park in Hlohovec. Runners can enjoy an appealing 6 km loop through the park’s picturesque setting, with its pond and the largest plane-tree grove in Central Europe, along the Váh River, through the town centre and past Hlohovec’s main landmarks. The event offers categories for children, a main race and Nordic walking. The start is in front of the amphitheatre in the Castle Garden. Organisers emphasise safety and recommend reflective accessories and headlamps. Finisher medals are prepared for the first 550 participants.
course_highlights: A 6 km loop in Castle Park, featuring a pond and a plane-tree grove
The route follows the Váh River and passes through Hlohovec town centre
The start and finish are on the paved area in front of the amphitheatre in the Castle Garden
additional: Race-day registration takes place on 16 May 2026 in the Castle Garden, in front of the amphitheatre, from 18:00 to 20:15. Children’s race registration is from 17:30 to 18:30. The races start at different times: children’s races at 19:00, the main race at 21:00 and Nordic walking at 21:10. The first 550 participants displaying a visible race bib will receive a finisher medal. Runners must wear reflective accessories; a headlamp is recommended. The event takes place with traffic closed and under police coordination. The raffle features prizes from regional winemakers and sponsors. Medals for the first 550 finishers, online registration, competition categories for different age groups; the event also includes registration and an awards ceremony.

name: Vertikál Martinky
organizer: Fatra Outdoor Team a Winter Park Martinky

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: MUŽI / ŽENY: 25€, registrácia a platba na mieste v deň preteku

description: Vertikál Martinky is the fourth edition of a challenging uphill race that is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League. Runners have the opportunity to earn ITRA Score points and compare themselves with the best on an extreme course with 944 metres of elevation gain. The event offers a challenge for both professional and recreational runners in the beautiful surroundings of Martinky. Children’s categories are also available, with shorter courses and the option for parents to accompany their children. The organisers provide transport of personal belongings to the finish, refreshments and free parking.
course_highlights: An extreme uphill course with 944 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at the Martinské hole ski resort
Children’s categories with 76 m and 186 m of elevation gain
additional: Race-day registration is from 8:30 to 9:30 at the FATRA SKI rental shop, Hrdinov SNP Martin - Stráne, and from 10:15 to 10:45 at the Nová Ponorka restaurant. Free parking is available above the adult registration venue and at Martinky for children. The entry fee includes transport of personal belongings to the finish, a drink and a meal at the restaurant. Children may start at 11:00, and a parent may accompany them free of charge. Runners take part at their own risk, and participants under 18 need written consent from a legal guardian. The course is 20% asphalt and 80% forest road. Registration is available online and on site. Transport of personal belongings is provided. The event starts at 10:00 and ends at around 14:00. Free parking is available.

name: Beh vďaky – Továrne – memoriál Františka Chmeľa
description: The Thanksgiving Run – Továrne – František Chmeľ Memorial is a running event organized by the municipality of Továrne in the Vranov nad Topľou District. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Office building in Tovarné and is open to a broad range of runners, with categories based on age and gender. The event has a traditional character and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories for men and women. The organizers provide participants with comprehensive information and support.
course_highlights: Categories available for different age groups and genders
Two course distances: 5 km and 10 km
Held in the picturesque setting of the municipality of Tovarné
additional: The race is organized by the municipality of Továrne. The contact person is Mayor Kvetoslava Mižáková. Information about entry-fee payment is sent by email after registration or can be found via the payment status in the list of registered participants. Categories are divided by age and gender, and the race takes place in front of the Municipal Office building in Tovarné. Registration is available online or on site. The event is dedicated to the memory of František Chmeľ and is open to the general public.

name: Orungutan Run
description: The oRUNgutan charity run at Bratislava Zoo is a traditional sporting event that brings runners of all ages together in support of primate conservation. Runners can make their way through the zoo grounds, including areas normally closed to the public. Proceeds from the entry fees go towards improving conditions in the Primate Pavilion, home to Sumatran orangutans and other species, including the zoo’s new residents. The event is suitable for families, companies, and individuals who want to exercise while supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: The run takes place on the grounds of Bratislava Zoo, with access to areas normally closed to the public
Courses are available for children and adults, with various race categories
Supports the revitalization of the primate habitat and improved living conditions, including for Sumatran orangutans
additional: The event is a charity fundraiser and is limited to 800 participants. Runners can take part in teams or individually. Proceeds will be used to renovate and improve the Primate Pavilion, including the installation of bioflooring, new climbing structures, and greenery. The run takes place on Sunday, May 17, 2026, from 10:00. Companies can participate as a team or offer places to their employees and families. Results are available at vysledkovyservis.sk/orungutan. The course probably runs through Bratislava Zoo; online registration is available; proceeds go towards improving conditions for primates.

name: Beh Zabudišovou
location: Zabudišová, okres Nové Mesto nad Váhom, Slovakia
price_range: 8€ online, 10€ na mieste, zadarmo pre deti

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deti štartovné zdarma a prihlasovanie online

description: The Zabudišová Run is a running event held in the village of Zabudišová, Nové Mesto nad Váhom District. It offers a 5,400-metre course with scenic views and 133 metres of elevation gain. The course surface combines asphalt, gravel and a grassy path. The event also includes fun races for children in various age groups. After the finish, participants can enjoy game goulash, a raffle, medals and prizes for the winners. Runners take part at their own risk. Online registration is available, with a limit on the number of participants; children run for free.
course_highlights: 5,400 m course with 133 m of elevation gain (2 hills)
Surface: 25% asphalt, 75% gravel or grassy path
Scenic views along the route
additional: Runner check-in is from 9:00 to 10:30, the children’s races start at 10:30, the main race starts at 11:00, and the awards ceremony is at 12:15. Game goulash, a raffle, medals and prizes for the winners are available at the finish. There are no changing rooms or showers, but two toilets are available (a flush toilet and an outhouse). Parking is limited directly at the start; once full, parking is available at the football pitch 200 m from the start. Timing is provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk electronic timing. Race bibs are compulsory and must be visible on the chest. The course is mostly natural, with hilly terrain. The race is suitable for all age groups, registration is limited to 100 participants, and the event takes place on 17 May 2026.

name: Behá celá rodina
location: Športový areál ZŠ Báhoň, Báhoň, Slovakia
description: Behá celá rodina is the first edition of a charity run taking place on 17 May 2026 at the sports grounds of ZŠ Báhoň. The event is open to all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, with different race distances and accompanying activities for children. Entry is by voluntary donation, and all proceeds will go towards supporting the kindergarten and primary school in Báhoň. Come and get active, have fun, and support a good cause in the welcoming surroundings of the village of Báhoň.
course_highlights: Children’s distances: 200 m, 400 m, 800 m
Adult distances: 2.6 km, 5.2 km, 8.2 km
Nordic walking: 2.6 km
additional: The event offers distances for different age groups, including children and adults, as well as Nordic walking. Games and accompanying activities will be available for children throughout the event. Entry is by voluntary donation, and all proceeds will go towards supporting local schools. Race distances for children and adults; supporting local schools; online registration.

name: Night Run Trenčín
location: Klub Lúč, Mierové námestie, Trenčín, Slovakia
price_range: 12 € až 35 € v závislosti od registrácie a kategórie
description: Night Run Trenčín is a running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in Trenčín, at the Lúč club and, weather permitting, at Mierové Square. Runners can challenge themselves in the pleasant atmosphere of the city in the evening. Registration is available online until May 21, 2026, or on race day at the venue if the participant limit has not been reached. The organizer provides electronic timing and refreshments along the course. The event is suitable for runners aged 12 and over; younger participants need the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Lúč club or, weather permitting, at Mierové Square
Electronic timing at the start, finish, and 4 km point
Option to use municipal parking near Trenčianska Gate
additional: Race check-in is from 17:00 to 20:40 at the Lúč club or, weather permitting, at Mierové Square. Men and women over 60 do not pay an entry fee but must register online. The minimum participant age is 12; participants under 15 must have the consent of a legal guardian. The organizer accepts no responsibility for damage to property or health. Electronic timing is provided by SunBell s.r.o. - VysledkovyServis.sk, and results will be published on an ongoing basis at vysledkovyservis.sk. Night run, online and on-site registration, start from 17:00 to 20:40, option to use municipal facilities, medical information on the race bib

name: Dynasport beh na Vtáčnik
description: Dynasport Run on Vtáčnik is a challenging mountain race around Kamenec pod Vtáčnikom, offering three courses of different lengths and elevation gains. Runners can choose a 50 km course with 2,000 m of elevation gain, a 27 km course with 1,000 m of elevation gain, or an 8.4 km course with 380 m of elevation gain. Each course has a time limit and categories for women and men under and over 40. The race starts at a farm below Vtáčnik, with refreshments provided at several points along the route. The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.
course_highlights: 50 km course with +2,000 m elevation gain and a 10-hour time limit
27 km course with +1,000 m elevation gain and a 5-hour time limit
8.4 km course with +380 m elevation gain and a 2-hour time limit
additional: The 50 km course has three refreshment stations at 9 km, 27 km and 44 km. Mandatory equipment includes identity documents, a charged mobile phone, a map or GPX file, a personal collapsible cup or bottle with a capacity of at least 1.5 dl, a first-aid kit (thermal blanket, elastic bandage), and at least 0.5 l of water. The race bib must be clearly displayed on the front of the body throughout the race. Recommended equipment includes a waterproof jacket in case of rain. Course distances: 50 km, 27 km, 8 km; elevation gains: +2,000 m, +1,000 m, +380 m; mandatory equipment, refreshment stations on the courses, time limits of 10, 5 and 2 hours.

name: Petržalská 10
price_range: 20 € (online pred 1. aprílom 2026), 25 € (po, do uzávierky registrácie); deti 6-8 €
description: Petržalská 10 is a popular running race in Bratislava, held at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka. The event offers various categories, including a children’s run, a 10 km main race, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:30. The organizer, Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, ensures a welcoming atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.
course_highlights: The course is in Bratislava-Petržalka, with the start and finish at Námestie Republiky
10 km main race with categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
1.8 km family run with a dog and 5 km children’s run
additional: Children under 5 and children from Centres for Children and Families (CDR) can enter for free. Categories include men’s and women’s age groups, 5 km Nordic walking, and a 1.8 km family run with a dog. Several categories are available, including 5 km, the family run, and Nordic walking; starts at 10:00 and 11:30; online registration; venue at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka.

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a running relay marathon taking place on May 23, 2026, along a route between Salgótarján, Hungary, and Lučenec, Slovakia. The course is 42.2 km long and is divided into four legs, run by four relay team members. The race is open to men’s, women’s, and mixed teams, with mixed teams required to have at least 50% women and 50% men. Refreshment stations are provided along the course, and goulash, sports trophies, and cash prizes for the top teams await at the finish. The race starts at 10:00. Registration is available online until May 21, 2026, or on site if places remain.
course_highlights: The route passes through Salgótarján, Šiatorská, Rátka, Rapovce, and Lučenec
The relay has four legs: 11 km, 10 km, 10.7 km, and 10.5 km
Refreshments are available at every relay exchange point, with goulash at the finish
additional: Registration is valid once the entry fee has been paid. Capacity is limited to 20 relay teams. Each team consists of four runners, and exchanges are permitted only at designated points. The time limit for the full course is four hours. Accompanying participants on the course by car, bicycle, or scooter is strictly prohibited for safety reasons. Runners aged 15 and over may take part. The race takes place on roads open to traffic, with runners keeping to the left. The event is open to participants aged 15 and over, with an emphasis on safety and following the rules. The event also includes cultural activities and online registration.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
description: Hlbocký Boyard is an extreme individual race taking place on 23 May 2026 in the village of Hlboké nad Váhom. This 6th edition features a single lap with numerous adrenaline-fuelled obstacles and steep hills on a motocross track. There are nine categories by age and gender, including children’s categories. Runners can enjoy the fresh air, challenges along the course and, after the race, awards, refreshments and commemorative items.
course_highlights: A 9–10 km course with many new obstacles compared with previous editions
Steep hills and adrenaline-fuelled obstacles on a motocross track
Drinking water at the start and along the course, plus refreshments and goulash after the race
additional: Race-day check-in is from 07:45 at the venue by the football pitch. Starts are staggered: first the children’s Boyard, followed by groups of 4–5 runners every 5 minutes. The entry fee includes a medal, a commemorative item, a goulash and drink voucher, a sweet, water and refreshments along the course. After the race, showers with hot water are available in the football changing rooms. Spectators have free access to the entire course. Parking is free. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Registration is available by prepayment; medals and refreshments are included. It runs from March to May 2025.

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka is a running race held in Jacovce at the football stadium. It offers two distances—a 22 km main race and an 8 km hobby run—on asphalt and gravel farm roads. The 22 km race starts at 10:00 and the 8 km race at 10:15. The event is open to different age groups and genders and is organized by ATK Javorina Jacovce. Entry fees are affordable, making the event accessible to a wide running community.
course_highlights: 50% asphalt roads and 50% gravel farm roads
Two distances: 22 km and 8 km
Start at the football stadium in Jacovce
additional: The 22 km categories are divided by age: up to 39, 40–49, and 50 and over. The 8 km categories are men and women. Starts are staggered: 10:00 for 22 km and 10:15 for 8 km. The course is 50% asphalt and 50% farm roads. Registration is available by email. Race bibs can be purchased or exchanged. The race takes place on May 23, 2026.

name: Kostolanský májovec
description: Kostolanský májovec is a running event organized by run ForRest run o.z., held at the Michal Podolan Football Stadium in Veľké Kostoľany. Runners can choose between two courses measuring 10.90 km and 5.40 km, both with 64 metres of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt and meadow. The start is scheduled for 11:00, and competitors are divided into age categories, with awards for the fastest man and woman from Veľké Kostoľany. The event offers a refreshment station and is suitable for runners looking for an enjoyable run with gentle elevation in a pleasant setting.
course_highlights: 10.90 km course with +64 m elevation gain
5.40 km course with +64 m elevation gain
Surface: 50% asphalt and 50% meadow
additional: The race awards ceremony is at 12:45. Year of birth determines category placement. To be eligible for the fastest runners from Veľké Kostoľany awards, participants must enter the municipality of Veľké Kostoľany during registration. Number of refreshment stations on the course: 1. The race is run in accordance with traffic regulations. Participants are responsible for their own health insurance. The course is mostly flat, registration is available online and on site, and the event includes categories for different age groups and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: The Snina Trail Half Marathon is a running event in Snina, Slovakia, offering two courses: the main 21 km course and a shorter 7.5 km course. The race is for all trail-running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the challenges of the terrain. The organizers welcome runners of all levels and offer a great sporting-event atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail running in the natural surroundings of Snina
Two course options: 21 km and 7.5 km
A challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race is suitable for runners of all levels, with the option to register online or on-site. It includes various categories, including children and youth.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
description: The Run Around Soviou Poľanou in Podolínec is a forest running race offering quality training and the chance to test your abilities on mountain terrain. It is suitable for runners looking to enjoy an exhilarating day in nature and prepare for important races during the season. The route winds through picturesque forests around Podolínec and offers a challenge even for experienced runners.
course_highlights: Forest trails around Podolínec
Mountain terrain with natural obstacles
Picturesque views in the Poľana area
additional: Children’s races are available, along with several routes, including 11 km and 18 km options. Maps, posters, and race regulations are available to download. Registration takes place online via the official website. The race is part of a series and offers online registration and various categories, including a children’s race. The event promotes trail running in nature and offers attractive prizes for the top finishers in each category.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
description: Mravenčárska Mile is a running event held at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok. The race offers categories for men and women across various age groups, as well as categories for children, school-age runners, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The school-age race starts at 10:10 and the main category at 12:00. The event is organized by the Plavecký Štvrtok Municipal Office, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization for all participants.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok
Multiple age-group and special categories, including Nordic walking and canicross
The main categories start at 12:00, and the school-age race starts at 10:10
additional: Categories include men and women in various age groups, children, school-age runners, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The organizers are Milan Zajíček and Soňa Zajíčková; their contact phone numbers are 0907 467 595 and 0908 423 975. The race offers categories for various age groups, including children, Nordic walking, and canicross; starts are scheduled for 10:10 and 12:00; the venue is the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok.

name: Niže Linča
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 15 € do 15.05.2026 ( online registrácia bude spustená od 13.4. 2026 )

description: Niže Linča is a running event in Zeleneč, organized by volunteers from the village together with local associations and the medical service. The race is open to men, women and juniors under 18, with awards also for the fastest man and woman from Linča. The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban Festivities, giving the event a unique atmosphere and bringing sport and culture together. Online registration opens on 13 April 2026, and the race takes place on 23 May 2026.
course_highlights: Race in Zeleneč, Zeleneč Vineyards
Categories for men, women and juniors under 18
Admission to a wine tasting included in the entry fee
additional: The entry fee includes admission to a wine tasting during the St. Urban Festivities, valued at €5. Online registration from 13 April 2026; location: Zeleneč, Trnava District; start time: 18:30; venue: Jednotka

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: The Martin Off-Road Marathon and Half Marathon is a running event held in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Fatra region, in Tomčany near Martin. Runners can enjoy running across meadows, hills, and the foothills of the Fatra, with wonderful views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges. The route is off-road, with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees, adding to its appeal and challenge. The event is intended for runners of different abilities, who can choose a trail to suit their skills and preferences.
course_highlights: A race through the natural surroundings of the Fatra, across meadows and hills
Wonderful views of the Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra ranges
An off-road route with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees
additional: Mandatory equipment: a cup or bottle with a capacity of at least 0.2 l, and a phone with the organizer’s number (0949 465 006). Location: Tomčany (a district of Martin). This is the first edition of the event. No specific prices or registration dates are listed on the website. Distances range from 4.5 km to the marathon. Registration via MisoSport.sk. Mandatory equipment includes a cup or bottle and a phone with the organizer’s number. Various routes and activities are available for children. Start at 10:00.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Ul. Pod záhradami, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Bratislava, Slovakia

price_tiers.distance: AZ-pneu vertical 10 km a Dôverun 5 km

description: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu is a running event in Bratislava, offering races for both children and adults. The race takes place in the Dúbravka borough, starting on Pod záhradami Street (by Lidl). You can compete in the 10 km AZ-pneu vertical, the 5 km Dôverun, or the children’s races. The event is organized by Beh si ty, o.z., together with the Dúbravka Borough. It is suitable for the general public and offers age- and gender-based categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the Dúbravka borough of Bratislava
The AZ-pneu vertical course is 10 km long
In addition to the main race, there are children’s races and the 5 km Dôverun
additional: Dôvera health insurance policyholders receive a €2 discount when paying the entry fee online. The children’s races start at 10:20, the AZ-pneu vertical 10 km race starts at 11:00, and the Dôverun 5 km race starts at 11:20. The course follows urban roads in Dúbravka. Registration is available online and on site. The event is scheduled for 23 May 2026.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
price_range: od 11 € do 40 € v závislosti od spôsobu registrácie
description: Run with the Wolves for Life is a charitable running event organized by the CHADIM’S CHARITY Foundation, held in the scenic setting of Čierne at the tripoint of Slovakia, Czechia and Poland. It offers six different races, including a half marathon, a 10 km race, a 5 km race, Nordic walking and children’s races. The routes run mainly along paved and forest roads, with beautiful mountain views. Runners can expect well-organized races with marked routes, refreshment stations and a support vehicle carrying water. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and charitable causes.
course_highlights: Half marathon with +500 m elevation gain, running along mountain ridges with beautiful views
Routes run mainly along paved and forest roads
Routes marked with ribbons, with volunteers at key junctions
additional: The half-marathon course has a time limit of 5 hours, and the 10 km race has a limit of 2 hours. Runners must wear their bib numbers on the front and pass through all checkpoints. There is one refreshment station on the course, and drinks are provided at both the start and finish. During the race, a support vehicle will distribute water at accessible points. Required equipment includes personal identification documents. Insurance covering medical expenses is recommended, as the route crosses the territories of several countries. The event includes various categories for adults and children, on-site registration, an accompanying program and refreshments, with an emphasis on supporting charitable activities.

name: Hutňanská šelma
description: Hutňanská šelma is a running event in Novoveská Huta, offering races for children and adults. The event takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou and is divided into several age categories, with prizes for the top three finishers. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the races for adults and older children start at 13:00. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Races in Novoveská Huta, at Remeselný šenk za Holubnicou
Several age categories, from children to adults
Children’s races start at 10:00; races for adults and older children start at 13:00
additional: Race categories include children under 6, children aged 7–9, children aged 10–14, youth, and adults divided by age, with prizes for the top three in each category. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Novoveská Huta. The children’s races start at 10:00 and the adults’ race at 13:00. Participants also receive a medal, and various activities are offered during the event.

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia is the first official Slovak vegan running event, organized by the Slovak Vegan Society. The event brings together sport, health, and compassion, offering more than just a run—it is a shared step toward a healthier body, a cleaner planet, and a better-informed society. The routes start at the iconic Rača Amphitheatre and pass through the meeting point of the Carpathian forest and vineyards, offering forest therapy, varied terrain, and epic views of Bratislava. Runners can choose between the 5 km, 10 km, and Canicross events, which allow them to run with a dog.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the Carpathian forest and flowering vineyards, with fresh air and shade from the trees
Panoramic views of Bratislava from vineyard trails
Varied terrain, from soft forest paths to winding trails in the Little Carpathians
additional: Timing on all courses. Option to run with a dog in the Canicross event. The routes are suitable for beginner and experienced runners alike. Proceeds from the event support animals in shelters and an educational program on plant-based nutrition for doctors. The event is charitable and supports educational programs on plant-based nutrition, with proceeds donated to animal shelters and doctor education.

name: Bytčiansky Kros
organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Kros is a traditional running race in Bytča, offering four courses of varying lengths and difficulty, including the 21 km Super Kros with 500 m of elevation gain. The course runs mostly over terrain such as farm tracks, meadows, and cycle paths, with 80% off-road and 20% paved surfaces. Runners can expect three aid stations on the longer courses and clear course markings. Competitions are divided into age categories for both men and women, with the first three finishers in each category receiving awards.
course_highlights: 21 km Super Kros with +500 m elevation gain
The course is 80% off-road and 20% paved
Three aid stations on the longer courses
additional: Runners on the 21 km Super Kros must download the GPS course file to their phone or watch and carry a charged, working mobile phone. The course is marked with ribbons, arrows, and volunteers. The course has changed from previous years because of the cycle path; runners will run along the left side of the Váh Canal. Registration includes the requirement to download the GPS file and have a mobile phone ready. The race takes place over varied terrain, including asphalt, farm tracks, and cycle paths.

name: Ružindolský víchor

price_tiers.distance: Beh 7 km a Nordic Walking 4 km

description: The Ružindolský Víchor Run is the 12th edition of a road race held at the Ružindol sports complex. The course runs on asphalt and dirt roads through the village and includes a grass loop on the stadium. Runners can choose between a 7 km run and 4 km Nordic Walking. The start is scheduled for 17:30, with categories for men, women, local runners and Nordic Walking. Participants receive a race bib, a timing chip, refreshments and a finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: Course on asphalt and dirt roads through the village
Grass loop on the stadium
Two disciplines: 7 km run and 4 km Nordic Walking
additional: The race package includes a race bib, a timing chip (to be returned at the finish after the race), refreshments along the course and at the finish, and a finisher’s medal. Changing rooms are available at the Ružindol sports complex. Categories are divided by age and gender, including categories for local runners from Ružindol. The course combines asphalt, dirt and a grass loop; the event is open to men, women, local runners and Nordic Walkers. Registration is available online or on site. Refreshments and medals for winners are included.

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
description: Beh v raji is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Dobšinská Ice Cave and the surrounding area. Participants can choose from several distances, including a prologue, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, which run mainly on asphalt roads with partial traffic closures. The prologue is a hilly 1 km run along a forest trail from the car park to the ice cave. The event is suitable for the general public and also offers Nordic walking.
course_highlights: The 1 km prologue is a hilly forest-trail course leading to the ice cave
The half-marathon course follows an asphalt road through the village of Stratená and Stratenská Píla
The 10 km and 5 km courses are flat and follow an asphalt road with partial traffic closures
additional: Race-day registration takes place in the OOCR building. The prologue starts on Friday, 29.5.2026, from 16:00 to 17:15; Saturday’s races take place on 30.5.2026, from 8:00 to 10:40. Participants will receive a functional-material headband featuring the Beh v raji logo (the first 300 registered participants) and refreshments after crossing the finish line. The races take place with partial road closures and one lane reserved for runners. The race time limit is 2 hours 30 minutes. The event includes men’s and women’s categories, starts at 17:30, registration is available on the website, and the race is supported by the Košice Region.

name: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka, Hornosalibská trojka
location: Areál futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby, Horné Saliby, Slovakia
organizer: Obce Horné Saliby a Dolné Saliby
price_range: 13,-€ online do 31.3.2025, 16,-€ online do 28.5.2025, 10,- € pre seniorov nad 60 rokov, deti a nad 60 rokov štartovné neplatia
description: The Salibský Half Marathon, Hornosalibská Ten and Hornosalibská Three are traditional running events organised by RoniRun Club in the village of Horné Saliby. The races offer certified courses of 21.1 km, 10 km and 3 km, running through a picturesque area, with refreshments and chip timing. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special children’s races are held. In addition to the sporting experience, visitors can look forward to a rich accompanying programme featuring music, martial arts demonstrations and a raffle.
course_highlights: Certified courses of 21.1 km, 10 km and 3 km
Refreshment stations with Zlatý bažant non-alcoholic beer and a wide selection of drinks
Picturesque surroundings in the village of Horné Saliby, with the TJ Horné Saliby football ground
additional: The race pack includes a race number, refreshments during the race and at the finish, chip timing, Zlatý bažant non-alcoholic beer, a raffle ticket and an event plastic cup. The race is environmentally friendly, with paper cups and reusable cups subject to a €2 deposit. Children’s races are free, and children receive a medal. A rich accompanying programme is planned, including bouncy castles, horses, horse-drawn carriages, drummers, a DJ, and martial arts and archery demonstrations. The event includes 21 km, 10 km and 3 km courses, with starts scheduled for 10:00, 10:30 and 10:35, and the children’s race starting at 9:15. The event also has a charitable dimension and uses eco-friendly cups.

name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
description: The Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12-hour and 100 km race in Šamorín is a traditional ultrarunning event held on May 30, 2026, in Pomlé City Park. This is the 24th edition of the 6-hour race and the 15th edition of the 12-hour and 100 km races, with categories for individuals and relays. Runners can compete in various age categories, including men’s and women’s veteran categories over 50. Relays consist of up to three runners, who may take turns in any order, with each member required to complete at least one lap after taking over. Results are measured by the actual distance covered, to the nearest meter.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Pomlé City Park in Šamorín.
The course is a loop, and relay runners may take turns in a specially marked section.
The time limit for the 100 km race is 12 hours.
additional: Runners may take a break at any time, but must report it to the lap recorder. After the race ends, runners must place a marker on the left side of the course and remain nearby until their actual distance covered has been recorded. For safety reasons, accompanying runners by bicycle or on skates is not permitted. The course doctor has the right to withdraw a runner from the race at any time. The event includes 6-hour, 12-hour, and 100 km categories, with relay options, and has rules for measuring distance and conduct during the race. Registration is open, with dates and fees provided.

name: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom
location: Športový areál, Veľké Lovce, Nové Zámky, Slovakia
description: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom is the fourth edition of a running event taking place on 30 May 2026 at the sports complex in Veľké Lovce. The races follow the village streets and surrounding countryside along asphalt and dirt roads. The event also includes children’s categories, with different race distances according to age, as well as the main 5 km and 10 km races. It is suitable for the general public and offers awards in age and gender categories. The organizers emphasize convenient online registration and accurate chip timing.
course_highlights: The route follows the streets and surrounding countryside of Veľké Lovce
The course surface is asphalt and dirt road
Children’s categories with race distances from 40 m to 1,000 m
additional: The participant limit for the 5 km and 10 km races is 250. The school races have a limit of 160 participants. Registered runners will receive participation medals. On-site registration is available from 14:00 on race day if the limit has not been reached. Chip timing is provided, except for preschoolers. Registration with diacritics is recommended, as is creating an account on the website to make it easier to edit your entry. The trails include asphalt and dirt roads; registration is available online and on-site; medals are provided for all finishers; T-shirts are optional; health information is printed on race bibs.

name: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka
organizer: Žilinský pluk Jozefa Gabčíka, Klub vojenských výsadkárov Slovenskej republiky, Železničná spoločnosť Slovensko, Ministerstvo obrany SR

description: The Jozef Gabčík Memorial is an annual running race held in honour of paratrooper and hero Jozef Gabčík, a prominent figure in the anti-fascist resistance. This 11 km cross-country run over mixed terrain starts in Žilina-Poluvsie, at Jozef Gabčík’s birthplace, and finishes at the sports complex of the 5th Special Forces Regiment in Žilina. The event brings together civilian and military runners and promotes physical fitness and community spirit. The entry fee includes a race pack, refreshments, a commemorative medal and chip timing.
course_highlights: 11 km cross-country run over mixed terrain
Start at Jozef Gabčík’s birthplace in Poluvsie
Finish at the sports complex of the 5th Special Forces Regiment in Žilina
additional: The event is limited to 500 runners. Registration is valid only once payment has been received by 1 April 2026; otherwise, it will be cancelled. The entry fee covers administration, a race pack, refreshments, prizes for winners, a commemorative medal and HRDOSPORT chip timing with online results. Children’s categories are free to enter; registration is available online and on site before the start. The race takes place in Žilina-Poluvsie. Registration is available online and on site. The entry fee includes a race number with a chip, refreshments, prizes, a medal and timing.

name: Kurimské pobehaňe
description: Kurimské pobehaňe is a running event organized by the Aktívna Kurima civic association, held in the village of Kurima in front of the manor house. The course follows asphalt and dirt roads with clay and gravel surfaces. The race is open to various age groups, from schoolchildren to veterans, with men and women competing in different age categories. Online registration is available, with different price tiers depending on when participants register. A school race for children is also included. The event is suitable for runners looking for a pleasant, community-oriented running experience in nature.
course_highlights: Course surface: asphalt and dirt roads with clay and gravel
Start location: in front of the manor house in Kurima, Bardejov District
Multiple age categories, including a school race
additional: Categories include primary school pupils, juniors up to 17 years old, and men and women in different age groups. The organizer is the Aktívna Kurima civic association. Organizer contact: Ing. Tomáš Bolišinga, tel.: 0910 902 784. The race takes place at the Kurima location, by the manor house, with registration available online or on site. Details about dates and fees are available on the official website.

name: MEA GRATI Ultramaratón vďačnosti
location: Košice, Košice, Hlavná ulica - Dolná brána, Slovakia
organizer: MEA GRATI, Oáza – nádej pre nový život, KETURIST
price_range: 15 eur za dospelého, 8 eur za dieťa

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Výška štartovného je stanovená na 15 eur za dospelého

tiers.label: tier_2

description: MEA GRATI Ultramarathon of Gratitude 2026 is a charity ultramarathon that takes runners on a 64 km route from Košice to Tokaj. This race is about more than physical performance: it is also an expression of humanity and support for people experiencing homelessness through the Oáza organization. Each kilometer symbolizes a journey back to human dignity, and participation raises funds to improve the lives of people in need. Runners can enjoy excellent organization, a world-class atmosphere, and wine as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: 64 km route from Košice to Tokaj
Charity race supporting people experiencing homelessness
Each kilometer symbolizes a journey toward human dignity
additional: Participation in the ultramarathon includes excellent organization, with a world-class atmosphere and wine awaiting runners after their effort. The race passes through Tokaj; registration is via the official website. The route runs from Košice to Tokaj, and the event takes place on May 30, 2026.

name: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso
price_range: 18€ - 42€ v závislosti od termínu a kategórie registrácie
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras, now being held for the 14th year. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km courses that pass around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, Jazierka lásky and through the Snow Cross-Country Skiing Area. The event is part of the Grand Prix series and offers an unforgettable atmosphere, with views of Rysy and a night-time finish in the dark. In addition to the adult races, children’s runs and Nordic walking are also on the programme. Telekom Night Run is a popular annual stop for runners who enjoy beautiful running experiences in a mountain setting.
course_highlights: The course passes around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso and Jazierka lásky
A night run with a finish in the dark and views of Rysy
Passes through the Snow Cross-Country Skiing Area
additional: Start and finish on the main road between Hotel FIS and Hotel Patria. The time limit for the run is 1.5 hours. The participant limit is 1,000 runners with entry fees paid in full. The event also includes children’s runs (300 m, 600 m and 800 m) and 5 km Nordic walking. Registration is available online until 29.05.2026 or in person on race day from 12:00 to 18:00 at Štrbské Pleso, if the limit has not been reached. The event is part of the Grand Prix 2026 series, allows online and in-person registration, has a limited number of participants (1,000), and includes various categories, including a charity run, children’s races and Nordic walking.

name: Turbo TV detské behy Štrbské Pleso
location: Main road between Hotel FIS and Hotel Patria, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Slovakia
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the stunning setting of the High Tatras, taking place for the 14th time. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km courses passing around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, with beautiful views of the Tatra peaks. The event also includes Turbo TV children’s races, with distances for everyone from the youngest children to teenagers, offering unforgettable experiences and medals. The atmosphere is exceptional, with spectators cheering along the course and runners finishing in the dark, making this run a popular stop for runners during the season.
course_highlights: The course passes around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, with magnificent views of Rysy
Refreshment station on the 10 km course and spectators cheering along the route
A night run finishing in the dark, with the unique atmosphere of the High Tatras
additional: Turbo TV children’s races have distances of 300 m, 600 m and 800 m, with a medal for taking part. A 5 km Nordic walking event is also part of the programme. #REŠPEKT run is a non-competitive event with a voluntary entry fee; proceeds go to paediatric oncology. The time limit for the main races is 1.5 hours. The participant limit is 1,000 runners with their entry fees paid in full. Online registration is open until 29.05.2026, or in person on race day from 12:00 to 18:00 at Štrbské Pleso, provided the limit has not been reached. Distances range from 300 to 800 metres, with age-based categories. The start is on the main road between Hotel FIS and Hotel Patria. Registration takes place during race-pack collection, and refreshments and a medal are included in the entry fee.

name: Fatranský Vĺčko
price_range: 15 eur (dospelí), 5 eur (deti), +5 eur za jedlo na cieľovej stanici
