description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle race and trail run held in Brezno, Slovakia. Competitors must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a course leading to the top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, which stands 40 metres tall and offers beautiful views. The course runs mainly along forest paths, across meadows and through a stream, with very little asphalt, and includes steep climbs and descents. Alongside the sporting challenge, an entertainment programme for all age groups is also planned. The organiser is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., and the race director is Marek Janoštiak.
course_highlights: Forest paths, meadows, a stream and very little asphalt
450 m of elevation gain with challenging obstacles (crawling through mud, a slide, parallel bars, slackline, climbing, cargo net and more)
The top of Slovakia’s second-highest observation tower, standing 40 metres tall
additional: Online registration closes on 13.06.2026 at 23:55 or when the entry limit is reached. After this deadline, on-site registration is possible on race day if the limit has not been reached. Penalties for failing to complete obstacles are burpees (15 for Hobby, 20–30 for Open). Helping other competitors is allowed in Hobby and prohibited in Open. Refreshments are available on the course and at the finish (fruit and a drink). Children may compete only with the consent of a legal guardian. Categories are divided by age and course type. The event includes an obstacle race and trail run, registration closes on 13 June 2026, categories are available for children and juniors, and refreshments and an entertainment programme are included.

name: Grobský Runfest
location: Areál za MŠ a ZŠ Javorová Alej, Chorvátsky Grob, Slovakia
organizer: SBT Spid.com, s.r.o., Susedský Hi o.z., PavúčikSport Team o.z., obec Chorvátsky Grob
description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob, bringing together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children’s runs, cycling races, and a rich cultural and entertainment program, including a food zone and live music. The event supports community spirit and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant setting, with a range of activities for all visitors.
course_highlights: 5 km WeLive Run on flat asphalt
12 km Run for the Village Cup, 30% asphalt and 70% off-road, mostly flat
Children’s runs and cycling races divided by age group
additional: On-site registration for the 5 km: 16:00–17:45; results announcement at 19:15. On-site registration for the 12 km: Saturday 16:00–18:00, Sunday 10:00–11:15; results announcement Sunday at 13:00. The courses are mainly asphalt and off-road, with a flat profile. The festival also features a floorball tournament, a football cup, a cycling zone, a food zone, and a recovery zone. The program also includes live music and presentations by local organizations. The event includes a range of sports activities, concerts, children’s zones, refreshment stations, a recovery zone, and competitions for all age groups.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is Slovakia’s largest obstacle race, held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo. Runners tackle more than 20 obstacles on a course of approximately 5 km, and can choose from different formats, including a non-competitive Fitness format or a timed race. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments and watch strength competitions. The race is also suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and includes a medal, photos and a race video as souvenirs of the experience.
course_highlights: Approx. 5 km course with more than 20 obstacles
Obstacles adapted for children aged 8 and up
Held at the Divoká Voda complex in Čunovo, with the option to relax by the pool
additional: Participants can take on Tvrďák 5+ km solo or as part of a team (at least 3 people; mixed-gender teams are allowed). Fitness format (non-competitive, no timing, no penalty exercises, obstacles may be skipped) and Timed format (time measured; penalty exercises apply if an obstacle is not completed). After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments, try water sports and watch strength competitions from 14:00. Entry fees are non-refundable; entry can be transferred to another person or to the following year for a fee. The event also includes a children’s race, team or individual starts, and water activities and entertainment for all age groups after the race.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš
price_range: 15 € pre hlavnú trať, 3 € pre juniorov, 15 € pre Nordic Walking, zľavy pre seniorov
description: The Run Through the Streets of Veľký Krtíš is a traditional race organized by the Bežci VK civic association. It offers several categories, including children, hobby runners and Nordic Walking. The race takes place in Veľký Krtíš, with distances ranging from 3,000 m to the 11,000 m main race. The children’s race starts at 09:45, while the main race and Nordic Walking start at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers discounts for seniors over 60.
course_highlights: 11,000 m main race through the city streets
3,000 m hobby race
6,000 m Nordic Walking route
additional: A 50% discount on the entry fee is available for participants aged 60 and over. On-site registration is possible at least 30 minutes before the main race starts, at the increased entry fee of €17. The route includes city streets and asphalt roads. Online registration is open until 14 June 2025. The event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Moldavský pohár Bodvy
location: Hlavné námestie, Moldava nad Bodvou, Košice, Slovakia
description: The Bodva Moldavian Cup is an international road running, cycling and inline skating event held in Moldava nad Bodvou. The event offers various categories for runners, cyclists and inline skaters, with routes through the surrounding countryside and villages. It is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with the start and finish at Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also includes a mass run for health, open to the general public.
course_highlights: The running route follows the road between Moldava nad Bodvou and Jasov and back.
The cycling route passes through several villages, including Budulov, Janík and Turnianska Nová Ves.
The inline skating route is 17.5 km long and is part of the Slovak Inline Cup.
additional: Race registration is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the Secondary Vocational School of Agricultural Engineering. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three competitors in the men’s and women’s categories; all others receive medals. All competition categories have age limits, and competitors may register only for the category corresponding to their age. The event includes several categories, online registration and sponsor support.

name: Malofatranská stovka
description: Malá Fatra 100 is a mountain ultramarathon in the Malá Fatra range, offering demanding routes with significant climbs and descents. The race is intended for experienced runners in excellent physical condition and crosses the entire range, including Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra. The event is a registered ITRA member and serves as a qualifying race for other prestigious ultratrails. It is organized by Slovak Ultra Trail in cooperation with volunteers and partners.
course_highlights: The route crosses the entire Malá Fatra range (Krivánska Fatra and Lúčanská Fatra)
Significant climbs and descents, including exposed sections
Available routes: MF100 (107 km / 7300 m+), MF50 (56 km / 4400 m+), MF33 (35 km / 2600 m+)
additional: Insurance covering Mountain Rescue Service intervention is part of the mandatory equipment and can be ordered directly during registration. Functional and cotton T-shirts with an original print are available. Discounts on the entry fee may be available based on the ITRA Performance Index. Race check-in and the start take place in Terchová. Trail race through Malá Fatra with significant ascents and descents, exposure, and mountain terrain; registration details not specified.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
description: The Svätojánsky Run at Domaša is a traditional running race held at the Domaša Dobrá recreation centre. Runners can choose between two courses: a short 5 km route and a long 13 km route, which run mainly along forest roads and trails with varied elevation. The event is suitable for the general public, with categories by age and gender. Organisers provide refreshment stations, changing rooms, toilets and medical services. The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The 13 km long course has approximately 356 m of ascent and 314 m of descent
The 5 km short course follows a forest road and has 70 m of elevation gain
Refreshment stations are located at 5 km, 10 km and at the finish of the long course; refreshments are available at the finish of the short course
additional: The children's race is free of charge. The changing room, toilets and baggage storage are at the harbour by the Loď Bohémia. Every runner must wear their race number visibly attached to their chest. Medical services are provided by the organiser. The entry fee will be refunded in full for withdrawals made by 8 June. The race is held in accordance with the rules of athletics competitions and the event regulations. 13 km and 5 km courses, children's race, categories for men and women in various age groups, start from 09:45 to 10:15, car park by Bogárka, Domaša Dobrá recreation centre

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: BYS3T PARK, Záhorská Bystrica, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: The Run for Health in Záhorská Bystrica is a charity running event that combines sport with support for health and the community. It will take place on 27 June 2026 at BYS3T PARK, offering a chance to enjoy a great atmosphere and inspiring stories, while every participant contributes to a good cause. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and support for disadvantaged people. Run for Health was founded in 2023 and each year supports selected individuals or foundations through physical activity.
course_highlights: Takes place at BYS3T PARK in Záhorská Bystrica
The event combines running with support for the community
Open to all ages and fitness levels
additional: The event is charitable and supports disadvantaged people and organizations. Children, adults, and older people can take part by running, moving at a slower pace, or walking. The organizers offer the opportunity to volunteer and help run the event. The event takes place on park paths and streets in Záhorská Bystrica, with the option to participate as a runner, walker, or volunteer. A virtual participation option is also available.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run in Košice is a running event taking place on 27 June 2026 at Urbanova Tower on Hlavná Street. Women can choose from the 5 km, 10 km and 5 km Velvet Nordic Walking events. The event is exclusively for women and offers valuable prizes to winners in various categories. Times will be measured using the MyLaps system, and results will be published on the official websites.
course_highlights: Velvet Run 5 km and 10 km courses in central Košice, near Urbanova Tower
5 km Velvet Nordic Walking event
Race registration and start on Hlavná Street
additional: Online registration is open until 23 June 2026 or until capacity is reached. On-site registration is also available from 14:00, provided the technical and safety limits have not been reached. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00, and the event ends at 19:00. Pair competitions, “Mother and Daughter” and “Sisters,” are held in the 5 km and 10 km runs. Times are measured using the ChampionChip system by MyLaps. The event includes various categories for different age groups, with timing provided by the ChampionChip system; on-site registration is also available.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, Sabinov District, Prešov Region, Slovakia
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25,– € Po úhrade štartovného a následnom odhlásení sa z preteku si organizátor nárokuje na 50% z ceny štartovného.

description: Čergovský Umirak is a mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 metres of elevation gain, intended for trained runners. The race takes place at the Drienica recreation centre, with refreshments and additional activities available for families. The course follows a marked hiking trail, and runners must wear their race number visibly attached to their chest. Safety on the course is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service, and each participant starts at their own risk. After the last runners finish, results are announced and prizes are awarded to the top men and women.
course_highlights: Mountain race of approximately 30 km with around 1,000 m of elevation gain
Marked hiking trail in the Čergov region
Start and finish near Chata Ride pub in Drienica
additional: Mandatory equipment: a charged mobile phone, a water bottle with a minimum capacity of 0.5 l, and a space blanket in case of bad weather. A race briefing takes place at 8:30 at Chata Ride pub, covering the course and navigation. Refreshments are provided. Race numbers are non-transferable and must be visibly attached to the chest. Safety during the race is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service. The course is marked as a hiking trail; trail shoes are recommended. Organisers can be contacted by phone or email for registration.

name: Hámornický polmaratón
description: The Hámornický Half Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Spartak Medzev running club as part of the celebrations of Medzev City Days. The event includes the half marathon, the accompanying Hámornícka Desiatka run, and children’s Hámorníček categories, which are part of the children’s running league. The start is symbolically marked by striking a hammer against an anvil, giving the event a unique atmosphere. Runners can look forward to attractive performance T-shirts, medals with a modern design, and refreshments during the race. The course runs through a beautiful, deep valley, surrounded by natural beauty and the historic atmosphere of the town of Medzev.
course_highlights: The route runs through a beautiful, deep valley with natural springs and birdsong
Symbolic start marked by striking a hammer against an anvil
Accompanying races include the Hámornícka Desiatka and the Hámorníček children’s categories
additional: Participants receive attractive performance T-shirts and medals with a modern design. Children participate free of charge in 14 categories and receive a packet of sweets and juice at the finish. The event is supported by the city of Medzev and the village of Štós, and the organizers welcome support through 2% tax donations. The course also includes the football stadium; registration is available online and on site; categories are available for men, women, and seniors.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Futbalový štadión, Horné Orešany, Trnava, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: The Run through the Hornoorešanské Hills – František Hečko Memorial is a running race in Horné Orešany, featuring a 10,300-metre course with 100 metres of elevation gain. The course is half asphalt and half trail, making the race both interesting and challenging. The event is open to all age groups, from children aged 1 and up to seniors, with categories for men, women, juniors and local runners. It is organised by Bežecký klub Viktoria together with the Municipal Office in Horné Orešany. The children’s start is at 15:35 and the start for everyone else is at 17:00.
course_highlights: 10,300 m course with 100 m of elevation gain
Course surface: 50% asphalt, 50% trail
The route passes through the Hornoorešanské Hills, with beautiful views
additional: The children’s start is at 15:35, and the start for everyone else is at 17:00. Categories include all age groups, from children aged 1 and up, juniors, men and women in various age groups, as well as a local category for teams of three. The course is approximately 10.3 km long, split equally between asphalt and trail. Registration is available online or on site. Start times are 15:35 and 17:00.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava is a family running festival offering courses for all ages and ability levels. Participants can choose from 3, 5 and 10 km races, as well as children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres. The event takes place at two locations and offers a race pack with everything runners need. Alongside the races, there is a varied programme of activities, refreshments along the course and at the finish, medical and pacer services, and facilities with changing areas and baggage storage. The whole day is designed as an experience for runners and their families, with a raffle and the option to have personal details engraved on medals.
course_highlights: 3, 5 and 10 km courses for recreational and elite runners
Children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 metres
Refreshment stations along the course and at the finish, plus medical and pacer services
additional: Runners can follow pacers carrying flags to help them maintain their pace. After the run, they can have their finish time and name engraved on their medal. Showers, baggage storage and a varied programme of activities are available, including a children’s zone and a raffle with valuable prizes. 3, 5 and 10 km courses, children’s runs of 500 and 1,000 m, refreshments, showers, baggage storage, medals, photos, raffle, family atmosphere

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a trail race in the beautiful surroundings of the High Tatras, offering runners a unique experience of running on soft terrain in the fresh mountain air. The course passes through the Treetop Walk, Monkova Valley and the Spišská Magura ridge, with the start reached by cable car. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series, which combines sporting achievement with support for local families and charitable causes. Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and newcomers alike, offering a chance to enjoy mountain nature and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Treetop Walk
Views of the High Tatras and the Spišská Magura ridge
Start reached by cable car in Bachledova Valley
additional: The race is listed among UTMB Index Races and has an international points ranking. The course features a Conti Speed Section, where participants can win a tire voucher and a running shirt. Online preregistration and changes to the entry fee are available through a SportID profile or at the race venue. The event includes eco-friendly cups, water stations and various race categories, including children's races, and offers discounts when registering multiple participants.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu – nahoru
description: The 2026 Masters Mountain Running World Championships is a prestigious international mountain running event for masters, held in the picturesque setting of Janské Lázně. The races offer several challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing the endurance and strength of competitors from more than 30 countries. The event is organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until May 24, 2026, and runners can look forward to professional organization and sponsor support.
course_highlights: Uphill race: 7.79 km with 851 m of elevation gain
Long Distance race: 22.17 km with 1,332 m of elevation gain
Up/Downhill race: 8.95 km with 594 m of elevation gain
additional: Registration is open until 24 May 2026. Runners must be members of the Masters Association of the Czech Athletics Federation; otherwise, they will not be allowed to start. Start lists are updated 1–2 times a week. After registering and paying the entry fee, runners will receive a confirmation email. The organizers are TJ Maratonstav Úpice, under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. The race is intended for masters; registration details and precise course information are not specified.

name: Beh údolím Idy
location: Kultúrne stredisko, Železiarenská 9, Košice-Šaca, Košice, Slovakia
description: The Run through the Ida Valley is a traditional running race organized by the Košice-Šaca Borough and the Municipality of Malá Ida. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of the cultural center in Košice-Šaca and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories. The entry fee is symbolic, and local runners can enter for free. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: The race runs through the Ida Valley in Košice-Šaca
Cultural Center, Železiarenská 9, as the start and finish
A traditional event with a long history
additional: Local runners can enter for free. The organizers are the Košice-Šaca Borough and the Municipality of Malá Ida. Organizer contact: Mgr. Janka Jaššová, tel.: 055/726 08 11, 055/726 08 16. The course is not specified. Registration is by phone or email. The event takes place at the Cultural Center at Železiarenská 9.

name: Beh na Poludňový Grúň
organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: The Run to Poludňový Grúň is a mountain running race in the picturesque Vrátna Valley, in the Malá Fatra mountain range. The course passes through challenging mountain terrain, with beautiful views of peaks such as Poludňový Grúň, Stoh and Veľký Rozsutec. The race is ideal for nature lovers and mountain runners looking to experience a unique atmosphere and a challenge in the heart of Malá Fatra. The organizers warmly invite you to enjoy this sporting event in the beautiful surroundings of Terchová.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with an ascent to Poludňový Grúň (1,460 m)
Passage through Stohové sedlo and the area around Veľký Rozsutec
The route passes through Jánošíkove diery, with ladders and footbridges
additional: Chata na Grúni is the highest mountain chalet in Vrátna Valley and is suitable for hosting courses and events. There are two ski lifts nearby, with slopes featuring artificial snowmaking. The route passes through a national nature reserve with numerous waterfalls and bizarre rock formations. The race is part of regional sporting events; registration includes a fee and parking, and the start is at Vrátna Paseky at 10:00.

name: Na hoľu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné pri platbe na účet do 1.7.2026 vrátane občerstvenia a upomienkového predmetu

description: Na hoľu is an ITRA-certified vertical kilometer event held on Kráľova hoľa in the Horehronie region. Runners start from the village square in Šumiac, and the route follows the blue hiking trail directly to the summit of Kráľova hoľa. The event is a qualifying race for the 2024 Skyrunning World Championships and offers quality support, including refreshments and medical services. Registration is open until 1 July 2026, with a participant limit. The entry fee includes a commemorative item and refreshments.
course_highlights: A 5.2 km route with 1,035 m of elevation gain
Start at the village square in Šumiac; finish at the summit of Kráľova hoľa
The course is marked with colored ribbons on trees along the blue hiking trail
additional: Race check-in is from 7:00 to 9:30 behind the primary school building, or, in case of bad weather, inside the Šumiac municipal office. Competitors under 15 must be accompanied by a legal guardian. The organizers provide transport for dry clothing to the finish. Refreshments are available at Predné sedlo and at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes hiking gear and a bottle containing at least 0.5 l of fluids. Protests may be submitted by 13:00 with a deposit of EUR 50. The event also includes regional outdoor activities and emphasizes support for hiking and sport in the Horehronie region.

name: Špačinský trojuholník
organizer: Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach, Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Špačince
price_range: 10 € štandardne, 5 € pre miestnych, zadarmo pre obyvateľov
description: The Špačinský Triangle is a running race held in the village of Špačince in Trnava District. The race starts at 17:00 in the village centre, by the Primary School with Kindergarten. Men compete in an overall category regardless of age, and women aged 40 and over compete. The organisers are the Municipality of Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, the Primary School with Kindergarten in Špačince, and JDS Špačince. The entry fee is €10, except for village residents, who can enter for free.
course_highlights: Start in the centre of Špačince, by the Primary School with Kindergarten
Categories for men regardless of age and women aged 40 and over
Organised in cooperation with local institutions and the running club
additional: Village residents can enter for free. Men compete in an overall category regardless of age, while women are classified from age 40. The start is in the village centre, by the Primary School with Kindergarten. Course terrain details are not specified; the race takes place in the village centre. Registration is probably required.

name: Trail Relay Banská Štiavnica – Visegrád – štafety
location: Atletická dráha, Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: do 31.1.2026 60 eur / člen tímu resp. sólo bežec

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: od 1.2.2026 do 31.3.2026 80 eur / člen tímu resp. sólo bežec

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: aktuálne od 1.4.2026 do 15.5.2026 90 eur / člen tímu resp. sólo bežec

description: The Banská Štiavnica–Visegrád Trail Relay is a unique 220 km relay race connecting two historic royal towns through the natural beauty of the Štiavnica Mountains and Danube–Ipoly National Park. The race is open to teams of 3, teams of 4 to 8, and teams of 6, with categories for experienced runners and larger teams. The route runs mainly along hiking trails and through nature reserves, offering a chance to discover the region’s cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty in Slovakia and Hungary. The organizers emphasize building good-neighborly relations and promoting the region.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Štiavnica Mountains and Danube–Ipoly National Park
It passes historic and natural sites such as Drégely Castle, Burdov National Nature Reserve, Esztergom Basilica and the Danube Bend
220 km divided into 18 stages with varied ascents and descents
additional: The route is divided into 18 stages with varied ascents and descents, passing through nature reserves and historic sites. Categories include ULTRA for experienced runners and a solo category for individuals, introduced in 2025. Registration takes place online, where the team captain creates a team after registering. The race offers various categories, including ultra, mixed, Nordic walking and individual categories; registration is open from February to March 2026. The route follows hiking trails and natural paths, emphasizing the experience and connection between the two countries.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular 2-mile race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories, including children, juniors, women, men and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the race starts at 10:00. The event also includes a competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Cup, with runners scored according to their performances and participation in individual rounds.
course_highlights: Course distance: 2 miles (3.218 km); children’s race: approximately 200 m
The course runs through the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava
Check-in and registration are by the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place on site from 9:30. The race starts at 10:00. Categories: children (13 and under), juniors, women, men, female veterans and male veterans. The Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Cup competition awards points based on participation and performance. In the event of a tie, the best time adjusted by a coefficient and shoe size determine the winner. The races take place at Kuchajda, with on-site registration by the volleyball court; categories include children, juniors, women, men and veterans. The race is part of a series of 12 races in 2025.

name: Žaškovský minimaratón
description: The Žaškov Mini Marathon is a traditional running race that has been held in the village of Žaškov in Orava for 55 years. The course runs mainly along forest roads and village streets, covering approximately 12.4 km with around 600 m of elevation gain. Runners are warmly welcomed by local residents of all ages, creating a friendly, family atmosphere. The mini marathon is part of the Šípsko - Fatranské behy series and is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of Orava’s nature and the spirit of sport.
course_highlights: A 12.4 km course with approximately 600 m of elevation gain
Runs along forest roads and the streets of Žaškov
Part of the Šípsko - Fatranské behy series
additional: The course previously ran through Dierová; it was later changed because the footbridge over the Orava River was closed. Runners are welcomed by local residents, and spectators include people of all ages, including older residents. The race is part of a series of several running events in the region. The races include various distances from 100 m to 12 km, with categories for children, young people, and adults. The event also features historical results and photo galleries. The races take place in the village of Žaškov by the Orava River, with registration from 9:30 and the start from 11:00.

name: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom – Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča
location: Športovo-rekreačný areál Bejvoč, Kolonica, Snina, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 15€ pri registrácii a platbe na mieste

description: The Cyril and Methodius Run over Kolonický vrch – Jozef Chomanič Memorial is a running event held at the Bejvoč sports and recreation complex in Kolonica, Snina District. The race offers categories for children and adults, including several age groups for men and women. The children’s races start at 13:30 and the adults’ race at 15:00. The event is held in memory of Jozef Chomanič and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to test themselves in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Bejvoč sports and recreation complex in Kolonica
Several age categories for men and women, including children
Children start at 13:30; adults start at 15:00
additional: Categories: children; Men A (under 39), B (40–49), C (50–59), D (60+); Women E (under 39), F (40+); J. Chomanič Memorial for men and women. Contacts: Pavol A. Dubovský (var@kozmos.sk), Kamila Chomaničová (tel. 0902 587 389). Registration is available online or on-site. The race is part of a memorial event and offers various age categories.

name: Domašská desiatka na Eve
location: Domaša pri Vranove nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 18 € pre online prihlásených a pri zaplatení na účet

description: Domašská desiatka na Eve is a traditional running race held in the Domaša recreation area, Eva, near Vranov nad Topľou. The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses, which are part of the Vranov nad Topľou District Road Running Championships. Runners can enjoy a course with refreshment stations and, after finishing, receive a race pack with a medal, food and a drink. The organizers provide medical services. The race takes place in open traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Domaša recreation area, Eva
There are 3 refreshment stations on the 5 km course and 6 on the 10 km course
Vranov nad Topľou District Road Running Championships over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 7:00 to 9:45 in the Domaša recreation area, Eva, near Pizzeria Palermo. Each runner must wear their non-transferable race number attached to the chest. After the last runner finishes, at approximately 12:15, refreshments are available at the finish (food, a large Kofola or a large beer). Category winners receive prizes and symbolic trophies. The course is 90% asphalt and 10% unpaved. The race takes place on 5 July 2026. Registration is available online or on site for a higher price.

name: Nízkotatranská stíhačka
description: The Low Tatras Chase (NTS) is an individual ultra-trail race with a main 98 km course from Telgárt to Donovaly via the main ridge of the Low Tatras, and a half-distance course finishing at Čertovica. The race is a qualifying event for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc and is ITRA-certified. It is organised by the civic association Time Out - OZ in cooperation with STS HIKING and Slovak Ultratrail. NTS offers a challenging mountain course with beautiful views and challenges for experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: The 98.5 km main course follows the main ridge of the Low Tatras from Telgárt to Donovaly
The 49 km half-distance course finishes at the Čertovica mountain pass
Challenging mountain terrain with beautiful views and checkpoints
additional: Participant check-in takes place on Friday, 10 July 2026, from 18:00 to 22:00 at ZŠ Telgárt, where the briefing will also be held. The race starts on Saturday, 11 July 2026, at 06:00 in Telgárt. The organiser provides baggage transport (drop bags). The participant limit is 200. Qualification requirements must be met to enter the main course. Checkpoints and refreshments are provided during the race. NTS is part of Slovak Ultra Trail and is ITRA-certified. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners, with online registration available subject to meeting the qualification criteria. The event also includes a shorter 49 km course, and takes place on 11 and 12 July 2026.

name: Rozbehni Majerovce
description: Rozbehni Majerovce is a running event held in the village of Majerovce, Vranov nad Topľou District, in front of the Municipal Office. The races offer categories for children and adults, with main races of 5 and 10 km. The children’s races start at 09:15 and the main race at 10:15. Organizer Martin Folenta and the Municipality of Majerovce warmly invite runners of all ages to enjoy a pleasant day of sport.
course_highlights: The races take place in the village of Majerovce, in front of the Municipal Office
The main adult race distances are 5 km and 10 km
Separate categories for children, with their own start
additional: The children’s races start at 09:15, and the main race begins at 10:15. Categories are divided by age and gender, including men and women in different age groups. On-site registration is available for a higher entry fee. The races start at 09:15 and 10:15; the course likely follows local roads, and registration is available online and on-site.

name: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto
location: Námestie SNP Rajecké Teplice, Rajecké Teplice, Slovakia
description: Beh Rajeckou dolinou KL Auto is a running event in the picturesque setting of the Rajec Valley, offering a mix of paved and dirt roads. The route runs mostly along dirt roads, with approximately 20% paved surfaces, creating an enjoyable and varied running experience. The event is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere, attracting runners of all levels. The start is at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who is available for information and support.
course_highlights: The route is 20% paved roads and 80% dirt roads
Start at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice
Picturesque setting of the Rajec Valley
additional: The entry fee is €12 for online registration and €20 on site. The organizer is Ján Valúch Jr., who can be contacted by phone at 0904 255 310 or by email at valuch.jan@gmail.com. The event is part of a sports day in Rajecké Teplice, with a beautiful route and a great atmosphere.

name: Beh malý Caesar
location: Námestie SNP, Rajecké Teplice, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The St. Andrew’s Run and the Little Caesar Children’s Run are traditional events in Rajecké Teplice, bringing a sporting and family-friendly atmosphere to SNP Square. The St. Andrew’s Run is a 4.5 km road race with online registration, while the Little Caesar Children’s Run is for children aged 1 to 9 and is free of charge. The event also includes a competition for the most beautifully decorated children’s stroller, adding to the experience for participants and spectators alike. The event takes place in the afternoon, with check-in and the start on the square.
course_highlights: A 4.5 km road course for the St. Andrew’s Run
Children’s categories for ages 1–3, 4–6, and 7–9
A competition for the most beautifully decorated children’s stroller on the square
additional: Check-in for the St. Andrew’s Run is from 14:30 to 16:30, with the start at 17:00. Check-in for the Little Caesar Children’s Run starts at 14:00 in the lobby of the Municipal Office. Places in the children’s run are limited to 150. The event takes place at SNP Square in Rajecké Teplice. The children’s run is open to all age groups, registration is available online or on site, and the event is suitable for the whole family.

name: Bančanská desiatka
description: The Bančanská Ten is a traditional running race in the village of Banské, in Vranov nad Topľou District, held in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské. This popular sporting event has a long history and attracts a record number of participants each year. The race is known for its challenging uphill course and beautiful surroundings, and is organized by Športový klub Banské. In addition to the main race, uphill time trials and other accompanying events are held.
course_highlights: Uphill race in the village of Banské – Mláčky
Traditional start in front of the Cultural Centre in Banské
Challenging course profile, with a new course record of 14:35 min
additional: The event is organized by Športový klub Banské, which has a long tradition dating back to 1985. It is held regularly, and in 2025 the 30th edition of the Bančanská 10/5 will take place. The event also includes the JANTEX Banské–Mláčky uphill time trials, which have their own history and categories. The race includes 10 km and a 5 km relay; registration is available online or on site. There is also a varied accompanying programme, including a bouncy castle and performances.

name: Malý Štrbský maratón
organizer: Obec Štrba, Obec Liptovská Teplička, Športový klub Štrba
price_range: 20,- € to 25,- € depending on registration date, free for some categories
description: The Malý Štrbský Marathon is a traditional running race held every year on the second Sunday in July in the village of Štrba beneath the Tatras. Runners can choose between two main distances—31 km and 10 km—on an asphalt road between Štrba and Liptovská Teplička. The event is part of the Tatry v pohybe project and attracts runners from several countries. The atmosphere in the square in front of the Cultural Centre is always lively and full of sporting spirit. The organisers are the Municipality of Štrba, the Municipality of Liptovská Teplička and Športový klub Štrba.
course_highlights: 31 km route on a third-class asphalt road from Štrba to Liptovská Teplička and back
Refreshment stations at kilometres 8, 12, 16, 20, 25 and 28
10 km route, introduced in 2021
additional: The total participant limit is 500, with priority given to the 31 km race (limit of 200) and the 10 km race (limit of 300). The race takes place without road closures, so extra caution is required. Medical services are provided by Tatranská horská služba, NsP Poprad and the local Red Cross. Runners take part at their own risk. The organiser provides transport from selected train services from Tatranská Štrba. The event includes 48 km, 10 km and children’s races; it is part of the East Slovak Youth Running League; registration has set deadlines and age categories; Nordic Walking is also part of the event.

name: Kordícky Extrém
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Kordícky Extrém is a challenging mountain run through the picturesque surroundings of Kordíky in the Banská Bystrica District. The course is intended for runners seeking extreme challenges in nature, with significant elevation gain and technical sections. The event is part of the Marathon Tour series and offers a unique running experience in beautiful mountain scenery. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their endurance and courage in this extreme terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain setting with significant elevation gain
Technically challenging sections on natural trails
Picturesque views of the surroundings of Kordíky
additional: Multiple categories and registration options, including online and in person. The event is accompanied by a large social gathering with food and entertainment.

name: Mesciské pancaky
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Mestisko, okres Svidník, Slovakia
description: Mesciské Pancaky is a running event in Mestisko, Svidník District, offering 5 km and 10 km courses with no age restrictions for men or women. The course is mostly asphalt, with sections on grass and a dirt road, providing runners with varied terrain. The race starts at the football pitch in Mestisko. Registration is available online or at the event venue.
course_highlights: Surface: 60% asphalt, 20% grass, 20% dirt road
Two categories: 5 km and 10 km, with no age restrictions
Start at the football pitch in Mestisko
additional: The categories are open to men and women regardless of age. The start is at the football pitch in Mestisko. The course combines asphalt, grass and a dirt road. The event is open to all age groups, and registration is available online or at the venue.

name: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra
location: Hrabovo, Národný park Veľká Fatra, Slovakia
description: Behaj lesmi Veľká Fatra is a trail race in Veľká Fatra National Park, offering runners unforgettable views of the Low Tatras, forest singletrack trails and special forest roads. The routes pass through the UNESCO-listed site of Vlkolínec and also include a cable car and Sidorovo. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races, where runners earn points based on their performance and race distance. Three routes of varying distances and elevation gain are available, suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Unforgettable views of the Low Tatras
Forest singletrack trails and special forest roads
The route passes through the UNESCO-listed site of Vlkolínec
additional: The course includes 150-metre Conti Speed Sections marked with Continental flags. Runners can earn points toward the UTMB Index Races based on their performance and race distance. The routes have different elevation gains: 730 m over 18 km, 405 m over 11 km and 267 m over 5 km. The routes are mostly on soft natural surfaces. The race is part of a series supporting environmental and charitable projects, with details about registration, entry fees and accompanying activities available on the official website.

name: YOUNG RUN Nestlé
location: Námestie J. C. Hronského, Prievidza, Prievidza, Slovakia
description: YOUNG RUN Nestlé is a running event in Prievidza offering 21 km, 10 km and 5 km races. Competitors are divided into categories by age and gender, and children’s relay events are also available. The races start at J. C. Hronský Square, with different start times depending on the distance. The event is organised by YOUNG RUN, Nestlé and the City of Prievidza, providing a quality sporting experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: 21 km, 10 km and 5 km courses in the centre of Prievidza
Categories for different age groups, including juniors and veterans
Children’s relay races with circuits of 2 x 5 km and 2 x 2.5 km
additional: Race start times: 8:00 for 21 km, 8:15 for the TRUE circuit and relay, 9:20 for STARTIN, and 9:55 for children. Categories are divided by age and gender, with specific birth years. The organiser provides the contact telephone number +421915574850. The event also includes VIP zones, online timing, support for people with disabilities, and 600 participant medals.

name: Ipelský Beh
location: Lučenec - Kalonda, Hrádza na Ipli, Lučenec, Slovakia
description: Ipelský Beh is a running event held in Lučenec - Kalonda, on the embankment of the Ipeľ River. The course runs mainly on grass and includes a 100-metre section of a disused railway line. The race is open to various age categories for men, women and young people, including Nordic walking. The organizers, the city of Lučenec, the municipality of Kalonda and OZ-Novohrad, warmly invite runners of all levels to take part in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Course surface is mainly grass
A 100-metre section of a disused railway line
Location on the embankment of the Ipeľ River in Lučenec - Kalonda
additional: Online registration is available until 18.7.2025 at the reduced entry fee of €13. On-site entry is €18, subject to availability. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking for men and women. The organizer is Marian Duzbaba (tel.: 0907 146 181). The race is held in various categories, including Nordic walking, with online registration available and races on different courses, including a 10 km course and a 6.5 km asphalt course. The event is part of the region’s sports calendar and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Dobra Run a Dobrá dvojka
description: Dobra Run and Dobrá dvojka is a running event in Domaša, Vranov nad Topľou District, offering 7 km and 2 km courses. The race is suitable for various age groups of men and women, including children. It is organized by Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in different age groups. Entry fees are available online or on site, while places remain.
course_highlights: 7 km and 2 km courses suitable for various age groups
Men’s and women’s age categories for ages 18 and over
The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Domaša
additional: Entry fees can be paid online or on site, while places remain. Categories are divided by age and gender, including children’s categories. The event is organized by Matore s.r.o. Humenné and BAMM Bratislava. Contact person: Ing. Dušan Matanin, tel.: 0905 271 190. The race takes place in summer, with the option to register in advance or on site, and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Night city run Piešťany
description: Piešťany Night City RUN is a traditional night run held at Námestie Slobody in Piešťany. Participants can take part in the 10 km race, which runs through the city and offers the unique atmosphere of a night run under the auspices of the City of Piešťany. The event is open to various age categories, and all participants receive a commemorative medal. Electronic timing is provided, and the results are ceremonially announced in the evening after the run.
course_highlights: A night run through Piešťany with the atmosphere of running beneath streetlights
Start and finish at Námestie Slobody
Electronic timing provided by SunBell s.r.o.
additional: Registration takes place from 16:30 to 19:45 in the building of the School of Physiotherapy, Rehabilitation and Balneology. Parking is available at Aupak and at the Park-and-Ride Car Park on Nálepkova Street. The first 100 participants receive the lowest entry fee. After the race, there is a raffle and the ceremonial announcement of results at 21:45. Participants aged 15 and over may race independently; younger participants need the consent of a legal guardian. The event is open to all runners, including children, who can participate for free. A medal and refreshments are provided, and the use of a headlamp during the run is recommended.

name: Extrém maratón Košice – Furča
description: The Košice–Furča Extreme Marathon is a challenging running race organized by the O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Furča, where runners can enjoy the challenges of the course and the atmosphere of a traditional marathon. It is intended for endurance runners seeking a more extreme experience over the marathon distance. The organizers provide quality conditions and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Challenging course in the surroundings of Furča
Traditional marathon with an extreme character
Organized by the O5 Bežecký klub Furča Košice
additional: The marathon starts at 10:00. Information about course certification is available on the website. Registration for the 2026 Furča Marathon is closed. The course is intended for experienced runners; registration is possible until race day. The event includes an ultramarathon over challenging terrain with significant elevation gain.

name: Beh na chatu pod Chlebom, mem. J. Morgoša
organizer: BS TATRAN Turany, LK NÁDEJ Turany
description: The Run to the Chata pod Chlebom, J. Morgoš Memorial, is a mountain running race held in the areas of Turany, Šútovo and Zajacová. The course is 3.1 km long with an elevation gain of 680 metres and runs along mountain roads and trails. The race is part of the Turčianska Running League 2025 and is open to various age categories for men and women. The organizers are BS TATRAN Turany, the town of Turany and LK NÁDEJ Turany. The race offers a challenge for runners who enjoy demanding mountain terrain.
course_highlights: 3.1 km course with 680 m elevation gain
Mountain roads and trails
Race in the mountain areas of Turany - Šútovo - Zajacová
additional: Categories: Juniors, Junior Women, Men under 40, Men under 50, Men over 50, Men over 60, Men over 70, Women under 35, Women over 35, Women over 50. The race is part of the Turčianska Running League 2025. Mountain terrain, with registration available online or on site, and categories for different age groups.

name: Bear Foot Poľana
price_range: € 1 - € 40 (podľa vlny registrácie a dostupnosti na mieste)
description: BEAR FOOT POĽANA 2026 is a mountain race in the wild and unique Poľana Mountains, the highest and best-preserved volcano in Central Europe. The race offers two main courses: 24 km with 1,300+ metres of cumulative ascent and 10 km with 600+ metres of ascent. The course passes through popular hiking destinations such as Bystrô Waterfall, the Celtic hillfort of Kaľamárka and the summit of Predná Poľana, while runners enjoy the beauty of deep forests, mountain streams and pastures. The race is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association league and is limited to 150 runners per course.
course_highlights: 24 km course with 1,300+ m of cumulative ascent, passing Bystrô Waterfall and the Celtic hillfort of Kaľamárka
10 km course with 600+ m of ascent, starting and finishing at Horský hotel Poľana
The course combines hiking trails, forest roads and mountain meadows
additional: Race check-in is open from 7:30 to 9:30; late registration is not possible. Bells or small bells must be used throughout the entire course. There are three refreshment stations at 4.4 km, 10 km and 15 km. The entry fee includes refreshments during and after the race, a unique race bib, a participant pack and timing. The limit is 150 runners per course. The race includes a 24 km course with more than 1,300 m of ascent, is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League, has limited registration and takes place on 1 August 2026.

name: Porubska 11-ka
description: Porúbska 11-ka is a running race held in the village of Porúbka in Bardejov District. It features gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain at an elevation of 196 m. The course passes through the Carpathian region, offering a combination of flat sections and hills, ideal for runners looking for an enjoyable run surrounded by nature. The race is organized by the municipality of Porúbka and is part of local sporting activities with a tradition and a strong community spirit. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Gently rolling, hilly to flat terrain
Elevation: 196 m
The route passes through the Carpathian region
additional: The race takes place on August 1, 2026; registration is available via Google Forms; the routes run through the countryside around Porúbka; the event is supported by the local community and a passion for sport.

name: Island Gladiator Slovakia
description: Island Gladiator Slovakia is an OCR race that will test your strength, endurance and determination in Slovakia’s authentic natural environment. The course runs through meadows, forests, streams and hills, with various technical sections and obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing and carrying weights. The race is open to men and women, beginners and experienced athletes, with a 3-hour time limit. Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a medal, a race pack and electronic timekeeping. Island Gladiator is not just a competition, but a challenge to overcome yourself and become a stronger gladiator.
course_highlights: The course runs through meadows, forests, streams and hills
Technical sections with obstacles such as walls, crawling, pulling, balancing and carrying weights
A 3-hour time limit to complete the course
additional: Every participant receives an official T-shirt, a unique medal, electronic timekeeping, a race pack with a surprise from the partners, refreshments and food at the finish or on the course. Failing to complete an obstacle means a penalty of 20 burpees or a penalty lap. Outside assistance is allowed only with the organizers’ consent. The race starts at 09:00 in timed waves. Registration is available through their website, and early-bird discounts are also available.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 8. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2 Mile Run is a regular running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race covers 2 miles (3.218 km), with categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on site from 9:30, and the race starts at 10:00. The event is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward a perpetual trophy based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.218 km) course
Registration and start by the volleyball court at the Kuchajda complex
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30. The competition is for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy, with points awarded based on performances and participation. In the event of a tie on points, the best time decides, followed by shoe size. Children have a separate category with a shorter course of approximately 200 m. The race takes place on a public road in Kuchajda; registration is also available on site, and the start is scheduled for 10:00. The event also includes a children’s category with shorter distances.

name: Malý Kavečianský maratón
organizer: TJ Mladosť Kavečany a MÚ MČ Košice - Kavečany
price_range: 21 km: 15,- € online, 20,- € na mieste; 7 km: 12,- € online, 17,- € na mieste; zadarmo pre ženy nad 60 rokov a mužov nad 70 rokov
description: The Malý Kavečianský Marathon is a running event in Kavečany near Košice, offering 21 km and 7 km routes, as well as children’s races. The race starts at the football stadium and is open to a wide range of categories, from children to veterans. It is organized by TJ Mladosť Kavečany together with the Košice-Kavečany Municipal District. The event is suitable for runners of different ages and ability levels, with affordable entry fees and online registration available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the football stadium in Kavečany
21 km and 7 km routes suitable for different age groups
Children’s races start at 9:10
additional: Women over 60 and men over 70 can enter for free. Categories include children’s, pupils’, youth, overall, and age-group categories for men and women. Children’s races start at 9:10. The route includes town streets and the football stadium; online registration is open until 1.8.2025; all categories start at 9:00.

name: Východniarska

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatok za štart jedného účastníka je 70 EUR

description: Východniarska is a mountain ultra trail and long-distance hike for individuals, following on from the popular Východniarska Stovka. The route runs through the eastern part of the Slovak Ore Mountains, mostly across the Volovské Mountains, and offers a challenging 85 km run with +4200 m of elevation gain. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak, with a 22-hour time limit. The event is open to the public for participants aged 18 and over, and requires registration and payment of the entry fee.
course_highlights: 85 km route with +4200 m of elevation gain
Crossing the Volovské Mountains in the Slovak Ore Mountains
Checkpoints and aid stations along the route, with time limits
additional: Race-pack collection is on Thursday in Košice from 16:00 to 20:00, and on Friday, 7 August 2026, from 18:00 to 23:00 at Kaštieľ hotela Biela dáma Čierny rytier. Before the start, participants can sleep in the gym at the Primary School in Kluknava; bring your own sleeping mat and sleeping bag. A drop bag can be sent to the aid station at Vyšný Klátov (56 km). Drop bags must be handed in on race morning by 8:30 at the gym of the Primary School in Kluknava. Kluknava is accessible by train and bus; arriving by train in Margecany and taking a bus from there to Kluknava is recommended. The course is 85 km long, with a 22-hour time limit. Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, GPS device and personal cup, among other items. Drop bags can be sent to the 56 km point. The start is in Kluknava and the finish in Kysak. Participants can sleep in the gym, and travel to Kluknava is possible by train or bus.

name: Hámorská dvadsiatka
location: Obecný úrad Remetské Hámre, Remetské Hámre, Slovakia
description: Hámorská dvadsiatka is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre. Despite the cancellation of the last two editions due to the Covid-19 pandemic, the organizers are looking forward to bringing the event back and welcoming a large turnout of runners. The race takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains, which offer attractive routes for sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route passes through the natural surroundings of the Vihorlat Mountains
Beautiful views and tourist attractions in the area
Organized by the municipality of Remetské Hámre, with a long-standing tradition

name: Rajecký maratón
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajec Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held in the picturesque surroundings of Rajec and the surrounding area. Runners can expect a challenging course with elevation gain and beautiful natural scenery that will test their endurance and fitness. The event has a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere, reflected in its side events and the hospitality at the finish. In addition to the marathon, a half marathon, relay, cross duathlon, and the popular Rajec Borošovec are also held. The Borošovec is a cross-country classic with more than 200 meters of elevation gain.
course_highlights: A course with more than 200 meters of elevation gain
The Rajec Borošovec cross-country classic, 14.1 km long
Natural scenery in Rajec and the surrounding area
additional: The Rajec Borošovec is part of the events that kick off the running season in the Rajec Valley. After the races, participants are served goulash and homemade cakes. The Rajec Borošovec course is dry and fast, with possible obstacles such as fallen trees. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and also attracts younger runners and juniors.

name: Rajecký In-line polmaratón
description: The Rajecký In-line Half Marathon is a competitive inline skating race held in Rajec at SNP Square. The course runs from Rajec to the village of Čičmany and back, with the finish at the marathon turnaround point in Čičmany. Skaters must wear a helmet throughout the race and return their rented timing chips at the finish. The organizer provides refreshments, changing rooms and showers, as well as free transport back to Rajec for inline skaters. The final finish straight is reserved for runners, so participants must follow the organizer’s rules.
course_highlights: The course runs from Rajec to Čičmany and back
The race is held in the right-hand lane
The final finish straight on the square in Rajec is reserved for runners
additional: Skaters must wear a helmet during the race and attach their race number to their right thigh. Rented timing chips must be returned at the finish. Refreshments (sandwiches) are provided at the square in Rajec upon presentation of the race number. Changing rooms and showers are in the gym on Lipová Street. A minibus for transporting personal belongings will be at the start area from 8:00 to 8:30. Inline skaters must take the free bus back from Čičmany to Rajec and must not enter the start and finish area designated for runners, or they risk disqualification. The race is limited to 120 participants; registration depends on the payment date and includes different fees depending on the registration period.

name: Rajecká štafeta
description: The Rajecká Relay is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec and held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is a relay race that forms part of the Rajecký Marathon and gives athletes the opportunity to compete in teams. The organizer provides bib numbers, timekeeping, and full support for participants during the race. The event is suitable for runners of different ability levels and promotes community spirit and enthusiasm for sport in the region.
course_highlights: Relay categories for men, women, and mixed teams
Held at SNP Square in Rajec, in the scenic surroundings of Žilina
Registration is subject to a fee, with prices ranging from 90 to 120 euros depending on the registration date
additional: The organizer processes participants’ personal data in accordance with the GDPR and personal data protection legislation. Registration takes place online via the organizer’s website. Participants receive their bib numbers at check-in, and their results are published on the official websites and sports portals. Relay race; registration fees increase closer to the event date; terrain details not specified.

name: Rajecký detský beh
location: Námestie SNP, Rajec, Žilina District, Slovakia
description: The Rajecký Children’s Run is a running event organized by Maratón klub Rajec, held at SNP Square in Rajec. It is aimed at children and underage runners, with an emphasis on safety and responsibility: a parent or legal guardian must sign for them to participate. The event is part of a wider running program in Rajec and gives young runners the opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a race in a pleasant urban setting.
course_highlights: The race takes place at SNP Square in Rajec
For children and underage runners
Safety is supported by a parent or legal guardian’s signature
additional: Children and underage participants must bring a signed declaration from a parent or legal guardian. Participation will not be permitted without it.

name: Beh na Kráľovu studňu
location: Motorest Javorina Lenartov, Lenartov, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: The Run to Kráľova studňa is a traditional uphill race held in the picturesque village of Lenartov, near the historic Kráľova studňa, a meeting place of three kings. The course passes through beautiful natural surroundings and offers a unique mountain-running experience, rich in history and views. The event is part of the local running league and attracts runners from across the region. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere and welcome all participants, regardless of ability.
course_highlights: An uphill race in mountainous terrain around Kráľova studňa
A historic meeting place of the Hungarian and Polish kings
Beautiful views and natural scenery around Lenartov
additional: The race is part of the East Slovak Uphill Running League. The event has a long tradition: the 14th edition was held in 2025 and the 13th in 2024. The atmosphere is friendly, and all runners are welcome, including the oldest participants. Refreshments and a cultural program are provided nearby after the race. The course includes asphalt, forest and mountain sections; registration is available online or on site. The event is part of the 2025 Easterners’ Uphill Running League.

name: Chminianskonovovesský beh
location: Futbalové ihrisko OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves, Chminianska Nová Ves, Prešov, Slovakia
organizer: ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný a obec Chminianska Nova Ves
description: The Chminianska Nová Ves Run is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and ThLic. Mgr. Pavol Uličný. The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football field in the Prešov District and offers categories for men, women, and youth across different age groups. It is a community sporting event that promotes an active lifestyle and enthusiasm for sport in the region.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the OŠK Chminianska Nová Ves football field
Categories for men, women, and youth, grouped by age
Organized by the municipality of Chminianska Nová Ves and Pavol Uličný
additional: The race takes place on August 15, 2026, with the start at 18:00. Registration is on site. Refreshments and food will be provided after the race.

name: Runica Nevoľné
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom, Slovakia
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Runica Nevoľné is a running event held at the football pitch in Nevoľné, Žiar nad Hronom District. The race offers a unique experience in the heart of Slovakia, where runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organization. The course is suitable for runners of different levels, and the event is part of the Marathon Tour running series. The organizers welcome all runners who want to enjoy a sporting experience in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: The course runs around the football pitch in Nevoľné
Pleasant surroundings in Žiar nad Hronom District
Part of the Marathon Tour running series
additional: Registration is available online and in person. The event takes place at the football pitch in Nevoľné and also includes a mountain trail and a children's run.

name: Štafetový beh 345 km od Tatier k Dunaju Jasná – Bratislava
location: Demänovská dolina, Jasná, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilina, Slovakia
description: The Tatras to the Danube Relay is the largest relay race in Slovakia, with a course length of 345 km. Teams of 6 or 9 to 12 members start in Jasná in the Low Tatras and run nonstop through day and night, finishing on the Danube embankment in Bratislava. The course is predominantly paved, with approximately 3,990 metres of elevation gain and 4,870 metres of descent. Runners complete 36 stages of varying length and difficulty; in a 12-member team, each runner completes three stages. The race challenges team spirit and endurance amid Slovakia’s beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Course length: 346 km, with approximately +3,990 m of elevation gain and -4,870 m of descent
95% of the course is paved, on class II and III roads
36 stages, 7 to 12 km long, with varying levels of difficulty
additional: Teams may have 6 or 9 to 12 members. In a 12-member team, each runner completes 3 stages, with 8–10 hours between stages, covering approximately 30 km in total over two days. The organizer provides detailed stage information, including maps, elevation profiles and written descriptions for runners and support vehicles. The team captain registers as a user and represents the entire team. The race runs nonstop, day and night. The course is 345 km, starts in Demänovská Valley, is a nonstop team relay, and takes place in August 2026. Registration is divided by category and deadline, with different fees.

name: Jazerný maratón
description: The Jazerný Marathon is a running challenge held in Košice, in the Nad Jazerom neighbourhood, offering distances from 5 to 42 km. The race follows a 2.5 km stretch along the Hornád River embankment, with a high-quality asphalt surface and minimal elevation gain, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event has a 15-year history and is ideal for anyone looking for a fast and enjoyable run in nature close to the city. The organisers welcome all runners who want to test themselves over different distances.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop along the Hornád embankment
High-quality asphalt surface
Minimal elevation gain, ideal for a fast run
additional: Choose a distance from 5 km up to the full marathon distance of 42 km. The course runs along the embankment with minimal elevation gain, allowing for a fast and comfortable run. The event takes place on 16 August 2026. Online registration is available, and the race is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Cestou Grófa Júliusa Andrássyho
description: The Run Along the Route of Count Julius Andrássy takes place in Trebišov near the Municipal Cultural Centre and offers various categories, including running, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race. The start is scheduled for August 21, 2026, at 16:15 for children and 16:25 for the main category. The event is suitable for all ages, including children up to 7 years old and older children up to 13 years old. The organizer is Ing. Michal Majcher, who ensures a pleasant atmosphere and well-organized races.
course_highlights: Start and finish near the Municipal Cultural Centre in Trebišov
Several categories, including running, walking, cycling, and Nordic walking
A virtual race as a new option for participants unable to attend in person
additional: The entry fee is paid on site. Categories include children up to 7 years old, children aged 8–13, the main category, a summer walk, cycling, Nordic walking, and a virtual race, with the option to purchase a medal. The event includes several categories, including children’s and virtual races. Registration is available on site, and the course is located around the cultural centre in Trebišov.

name: Rusínska 100 a 66
description: Rusínska 100 and 66 is a late-summer ultrarun and long-distance hike starting and finishing in the town of Stropkov. The routes run through the Ondavská Highlands in Zemplín County and continue into Šariš County via the town of Svidník, crossing the region of Rusyn villages and following the border with Poland. The R100 route partly passes through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area. The event is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League, is ITRA-certified, and is included in the ITRA National League. It is organised by o.z. Klub bežcov Stropkov, which provides warm hospitality and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Routes run through the Ondavská Highlands and the northern part of the Low Beskids
Passage through the Eastern Carpathians Protected Landscape Area
A region with historic religious buildings, lookout towers and cultural monuments
additional: The event takes place on 23–24 August 2025. Rusínska 100 and 66 are part of the 11th edition of the Slovak Ultratrail League. The routes are intended for ultrarunners and long-distance hikers and pass through challenging terrain rich in history and natural beauty. The organisers and volunteers provide warm hospitality and quality support for participants. The routes run mainly along forest and trail paths, with several sections of asphalt; registration is open from 1 May to 20 September 2025; the event highlights the region’s natural beauty and historic landmarks.

name: Hradný gaštanový beh Modrý Kameň
location: Park pred vstupom do Hradu Modrý Kameň, Modrý Kameň, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Modrý Kameň v spolupráci s občianskym združením Bežci VK

description: The Modrý Kameň Castle Chestnut Run is a running event held in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle. The race offers various categories, including a 5 km fun run for children and juniors, a 10 km main race for adults, and 5 km Nordic walking. The course follows asphalt, meadows, forest trails and field roads, providing a varied and enjoyable running experience. The event is organized by the Town of Modrý Kameň in cooperation with the Bežci VK civic association. The children’s start is at 10:00, and the adults’ start is at 11:00.
course_highlights: The course follows asphalt, meadows, forest trails and field roads
The event takes place in the park in front of the entrance to Modrý Kameň Castle
Various categories, including fun runs, junior races and Nordic walking
additional: A 50% discount on the entry fee is available for participants aged 60 and over. On-site registration is available at least 30 minutes before the start of the main race and Nordic walking, with an additional €17 entry fee. The course includes asphalt, meadows, forest trails and field roads; categories are available for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; starts are at 10:00 and 11:00.

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Čachtice Half Marathon is a traditional half-marathon race taking place on 22 August 2026 in the village of Čachtice. The course runs mainly on asphalt along the streets of Čachtice to Višňové and Hrachovište, with a short section on a forest road. The course is gently undulating, with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 metres. The start is in the square in Čachtice, and the finish is in the grounds of Čachtice Primary School. Refreshment stations are provided at several points along the course.
course_highlights: Asphalt surface with a short section on a forest road
Gently undulating course with a maximum elevation gain of up to 90 m
Refreshments at 6 km, 10.5 km, 12 km, 15 km and at the finish
additional: The maximum number of half-marathon runners is 250; the relay is limited to 10 teams. The relay is a separate category for teams of 3–4 runners. Race-day registration takes place from 06:30 to 08:30 in the grounds of Čachtice Primary School. Cash prizes are awarded for 1st–3rd place in the categories, and a raffle is held based on race numbers. Online registration is available until 20 August 2025. The maximum number of participants is 250, and the race has several checkpoints with refreshments.

name: Forbaský beh pomoci
location: areál Ščava, Forbasy, okres Stará Ľubovňa, Slovakia
description: The Forbasy Charity Run is a charitable running race held at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy, Stará Ľubovňa District. This event has a voluntary entry fee and supports helping others and solidarity. Runners can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere while contributing to a good cause. The organizer is Valer Kuffa, who is available to provide information and support to participants.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Ščava grounds in Forbasy
Charity run with a voluntary entry fee
Pleasant atmosphere and support for a good cause
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary contribution; details at https://www.behpomoci.sk/fbp-2025/dobrovo%C4%BEn%C3%BD-pr%C3%ADspevok. Organizer: Valer Kuffa, tel.: +421 949 765 543. Race categories for different age groups; registration via voluntary donation.
