description: Lukačovská 5 is a running race held at the football pitch in Lukačovce, Humenné District. The event features a 5 km main race and children’s races, with categories for men and women, as well as a non-competitive Nordic Walking category. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality race organization. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km race in the pleasant surroundings of the football pitch in Lukačovce
Categories for men and women, plus a non-competitive Nordic Walking category
Main race limited to 80 participants
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00 and the main race at 11:00. The main race is limited to 80 participants. The organizer is the Municipality of Lukačovce, represented by Ing. Martin Sabol, Mayor. Contacts: Ing. Martin Sabol (Race Director, tel.: 0948 922 600) and Adrián Turik (tel.: 0948 228 212). The event also includes children’s categories. Registration is available online or on site, and the surface is probably flat, suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Harhovská desiatka
price_range: 10 € za hlavnú trať, 5 € za 3,5 km pretek
description: Harhovská desiatka is a running event in Spišský Hrhov, offering a 10 km course and a shorter 3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners. The race is divided into several age categories for men and women, including a special category for residents of the municipality of Spišský Hrhov. The event is organized by the municipality of Spišský Hrhov, and the start is in front of the Municipal Office. The entry fee is paid at registration and is €10 for the 10 km course and €5 for the 3.5 km course.
course_highlights: 10 km course for advanced runners
3.5 km course for recreational and beginner runners
Start in front of the Municipal Office in Spišský Hrhov
additional: The entry fee is paid at registration on race day. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a category for residents of Spišský Hrhov. The 10 km course is certified by the Slovak Athletic Federation. The race takes place in summer, and registration is available online and on site.

name: Brezovský letný beh
location: Športové ihrisko, Rimavské Brezovo, Bardejov, Slovakia
description: Brezov Health Run is a traditional running race in the village of Brezov, Bardejov District, offering a route along paved roads, dirt roads and forest roads. The race is open to men and women, including youth aged up to 15 and over 15. The organizers have prepared two registration categories with a large and a small package, allowing participants to take part in this sporting event in pleasant surroundings by the Municipal Office in Brezov. The race is suitable for runners of various age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Course surface: paved road, dirt road, forest road
Start location: by the Municipal Office in Brezov
Categories: men/women, youth aged up to 15 and over 15
additional: The course includes paved, rural and forest roads; the race is open to men, women and youth; registration is subject to a fee

name: Behaj lesmi Čičmany
price_range: €17 - €24 per race, discounts for multiple registrations
description: Behaj lesmi Čičmany is a running race set in the picturesque Slovak folk village of Čičmany. The course winds through the Strážov Mountains, with beautiful scenery, untouched forests, and expansive meadows. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, giving it international recognition and ranking. Choose from several distances, including the 20 km long course with 718 m of elevation gain, the 11 km Lesnícka course with 380 m of elevation gain, and a short 5 km course. The race also features a special Conti Speed Section, where the fastest runners can win valuable prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Strážov Mountains, with up to 718 m of elevation gain on the 20 km distance
The race takes place in the authentic Slovak folk village of Čičmany, known for its painted wooden houses
The course includes a 150-metre Conti Speed Section, with prizes for the fastest runners
additional: Participants can transfer their registration and change their entry fee online through their SportID profile. The course features a Conti Speed Section with prizes for the fastest runners. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, allowing participants to earn points toward the international trail-running rankings. The race is included in the UTMB Index, GPX files are available to download, categories are offered for different age groups, and registration is online.

name: Minimaratón
location: Atletický štadión na Štiavničkách, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT OZ, Minimaratón OZ
description: The Minimathon is a unique running event exclusively for families with children, held at the Štiavničky athletics stadium in Banská Bystrica. The event offers various age categories, from the youngest runners to older children, including mothers with strollers. The course is tailored to the age groups, with 400 m and 200 m loops. Alongside the sporting experience, there is an accompanying programme featuring activities for children and opportunities to meet athletes. Every participant receives a commemorative race bib, a medal and refreshments after finishing.
course_highlights: Course for children born in 2011–2020 and mothers with strollers – 400 m loop
Shortened 200 m course for children under 5
SNP Athletics Stadium in Štiavničky – a beautiful track and setting
additional: Online registration is available until 22.8.2026; in person on 21.8.2026 at Europa SC and on 23.8.2026 at the stadium from 8:00. The entry fee is non-refundable and cannot be transferred to the following year. Refreshments and medical services are provided after the finish. There will be no bag storage or changing rooms. At 11:50, a prize draw for valuable prizes will be held for everyone who finishes. Terrain: athletics stadium; online and in-person registration; medals and prizes for participants; 11th anniversary edition; accompanying programme including an aircraft flyover and family activities

name: Beh na boso Tatry
location: Golfový rezort Black Stork, Veľká Lomnica, Slovakia
description: Beh na boso Tatry is a running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort in Veľká Lomnica. Participants can choose between non-competitive runs for children and adults and a competitive 5 km run. The course follows mown grass and runs over paths and pebbles, giving it a cross-country character. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers a pleasant atmosphere in the Tatras. It is organised by OZ Beh na boso Tatry, which ensures the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The course follows mown grass
Sections over paths and carpet-covered pebbles
A cross-country course in the surroundings of the Black Stork Golf Resort
additional: The non-competitive runs start at 9:30, and the competitive 5 km run starts at 10:30. Categories are divided by age and gender. The non-competitive runs are 250 m for children up to 12 years old and 1 km for children and adults. The course includes mown grass, paths, pebbles and cross-country terrain. Registration is also available on site. The event supports charitable activities and offers refreshments and activities for children.

description: Sports Club Rohals warmly invites you to the 16th edition of the Run Through Novoveská Huta, taking place in Novoveská Huta. Adults can take on a new 12.2 km course to Vojtechova samota and back, the same for women and men. A 5 km course is also available for those who prefer a shorter distance. Children and young runners will compete on shorter courses through the streets of Huta, grouped by age category. After the race, participants can refuel with goulash; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest.
course_highlights: The new adult course goes to Vojtechova samota (Šadroň) and back
The adult course is 12.2 km and is the same for women and men
Short courses for children through the streets of Novoveská Huta, grouped by age category
additional: Registration for school-age participants is from 11:30 to 12:45, and for juniors and adults until 14:45. Participants may start in only one category. Goulash will be provided after the race; children can enjoy a small theatre performance, and adults will be entertained by the band 3násť ciest. Adult categories compete for points in the Spišská Nová Ves District Running League. 12.2 km and 5 km courses, categories for different age groups, registration on the day of the event, activities for children and adults.

name: Draždiak Run

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Draždiak Run is a running event held in Bratislava, in the Veľký Draždiak area of Petržalka. Participants can expect routes along gravel and hiking paths, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The event includes children’s races, 5 km races for adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog. It is organised by the Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which provides a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: Surface: gravel path and hiking trail
Start location: beach by the Barracuda buffet, Veľký Draždiak, Petržalka
Races for children, adults, Nordic walking, and a family run with a dog
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00. Categories include a children’s race, a 5 km race for men and women in different age categories, 5 km Nordic walking, and a 1.8 km family run with a dog. The entry fee for children is lower than for adults. Online registration is available until 21 August at a discounted price, followed by more expensive online registration until 4 September 2025, and finally on-site registration at the highest price, if capacity has not been reached. Online registration until 21 August 2026; start at 10:00. The route includes gravel, grass, and asphalt sections, with various categories including the family run and Nordic walking.

name: Beh pod Sninským kameňom
location: Rekreačná oblasť Sninske rybníky, Snina, Slovakia
description: The Run Beneath Sninský kameň is a running event in the Sninské rybníky recreational area in Snina, offering races for children and adults. The courses run on asphalt and unpaved roads, with children’s distances ranging from 50 to 600 metres depending on age. The main race starts at 16:30 and is divided into men’s and women’s age groups. The event is organised by BehajmeSpolu o.z. in cooperation with the city of Snina. The entry fee is €15 for online registration and €20 on site.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt and unpaved roads (10%)
Sninské rybníky recreational area – OMW Snina
Multiple age categories, from children to seniors
additional: The children’s categories are scheduled to start at 15:00, and the main category at 16:30. Categories are divided in detail by age and gender, including juniors and several men’s and women’s age groups. The event includes children’s races from 50 m to 600 m and a 6,000 m main race. The children’s start is also listed as 15:30, and the main race as 16:30.

name: Z Ľubotína na hrad Plaveč
description: The Run from Ľubotín to Plaveč Castle is a traditional running race that starts in the village of Ľubotín, by the multifunctional building. The race offers categories for men, women, juniors, Nordic walking, and a 4 km hobby run. The main race starts at 17:30, and the children’s categories start at 16:30. The organizers are the municipalities of Ľubotín and Plaveč, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The race is ideal for those who want to run in beautiful surroundings, finishing at Plaveč Castle.
course_highlights: Start in Ľubotín by the multifunctional building
Finish at the historic Plaveč Castle
A route suitable for hobby runners and Nordic walkers
additional: The children’s categories start at 16:30, and the main category starts at 17:30. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic walking and a 4 km hobby run on an asphalt road. Residents of Ľubotín and Plaveč, women over 60, and men over 70 can enter for free. A discounted €20 entry package is available for participants who also take part in the Jastrabské Vŕšky Run 2025. The event includes categories for different age groups, including juniors and Nordic walking, with online and on-site registration and discounts available for early registration. The program also includes a children’s run and races on an asphalt course.

name: Marathon Chopok
description: The Chopok Marathon is a challenging mountain race in the beautiful Low Tatras, testing your abilities on a variety of surfaces and terrain. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 7:00 from Srdiečko and finishing on Chopok at an elevation of 2,004 m above sea level. There are two main courses: the 43 km SkyMarathon Chopok with 2,600 m of elevation gain, and the shorter 21 km Sky Race Jasná Trail with 1,400 m of elevation gain. Relay teams are also available on the long course. The route runs along both the southern and northern sides of Chopok, including the main ridge, and offers beautiful views and varied terrain.
course_highlights: A 43 km course with 2,600 m of elevation gain through the Low Tatras on the southern and northern sides of Chopok
Crossing the main ridge over varied surfaces that make footwear choice important
Finish on Chopok at an elevation of 2,004 m above sea level, with the option of a quick cable-car ride
additional: The long course offers a relay option for teams of four or fewer, with legs of approximately 10–11 km. The race is included in the Slovak Skyrunning Association’s 2026 calendar. The courses are unchanged from previous editions, allowing participants to compare performances. Spectators can watch runners from several points along the course. A trail race with relay-team options; starts at 07:00 and 10:00; part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association’s calendar; the route runs from Srdiečko to Chopok and back.

name: Kokava Trail
location: Kokava nad Rimavicou, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Kokava Trail is a certified trail race starting and finishing in Kokava nad Rimavicou, with routes through the Veporské vrchy and Stolické vrchy mountain ranges. There are two distances: the main course is 78 km with +3330 m of elevation gain and an 18-hour time limit; the shorter Pasiečky Trail is 23 km with +1200 m of elevation gain and a 7-hour limit. The varied route consists of 45% meadows, 45% forest trails and 10% asphalt. It has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. Runners will find six aid stations along the course. Winners in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories receive medals and prizes during the awards ceremony at the cultural centre.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: 45% meadow, 45% forest and 10% asphalt
+3330 m of elevation gain on the 78 km main course
6 aid stations along the course
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a thermal blanket, a headlamp with fresh batteries, a charged mobile phone with an activated SIM card, a GPS device with the race route (a power bank is mandatory when navigating by phone), a reflective vest or bands, at least 1.5 l of fluids, a personal cup or wide-mouth bottle, ID and a clearly visible race number. The first three finishers in the Men, Women, Men 50+ and Women 50+ categories are awarded. The route has no difficult technical sections, but includes several steeper descents and climbs. There are 6 aid stations along the course. Two distances: 78 km and 23 km; mandatory equipment; certified course; mountain terrain; online registration; part of the Slovak Ultra Trail League

name: Prešov Running Series 3. kolo
description: The 3rd round of the Prešov Running Series is part of a series of running events taking place in Prešov during 2026. The event is open to all ages and running abilities, from beginners to professionals. The courses are designed to bring the community together, promote a healthy lifestyle and make running enjoyable. The entry fee includes timing, a medal, refreshments and an accompanying programme. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can run for free.
course_highlights: Courses for runners of different abilities, from beginners to professionals
An event on Hlavná Street in Prešov with a community atmosphere
An accompanying programme and refreshments for all participants
additional: The entry fee includes a bib with a chip, timing, a medal, refreshments, an accompanying programme, medical services, race organisation and photographs. On-site registration is possible subject to capacity, but early online registration is recommended. Participants are advised to collect their race bibs the day before at OC Novum. Children who are members of the Prešov Running Team can take part for free after paying the annual membership fee. The series includes three races at different locations in Prešov, with themes from fantasy, history and sport; registration is compulsory; maps, medals and children’s categories are available; a raffle is also part of the event.

name: 6 hodinovka pod Šarišským hradom
description: The 6-hour race beneath Šariš Castle is an endurance running event held in Veľký Šariš, Prešov District. The race is open to both individual runners and relay teams, with categories divided by age and gender. The entry fee is the same for all runners, and the event offers a chance to test your endurance in a six-hour run in the beautiful surroundings beneath the castle. The organizers, Gejza Sabanoš and Ondrej Fedor, ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The race takes place around historic Šariš Castle, with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape
The event offers different categories, including relay races
A six-hour endurance challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race includes various categories and relay options. The course is set around the castle, but details about the terrain are not specified.

name: Ozorovská dvanastka
description: Ozorovská Dvanástka is a running race held in Malé Ozorovce, offering courses for both children and adults. The race is organized by OZ Zorovčan in cooperation with the municipality of Veľké Ozorovce. Runners can compete in the 6 km and 12 km races, with categories based on age and gender. The children’s race starts at 9:00 and the adults’ race at 10:00. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a welcoming atmosphere near the cultural centre.
course_highlights: The course runs through Malé Ozorovce, with parking in front of the cultural centre
Two main distances: 12 km and 6 km, with categories based on age and gender
Children’s race starts at 9:00; adults’ race starts at 10:00
additional: Race categories include children’s categories and age groups for men and women in the 12 km race (Men A up to 39, B 40–49, C 50 and older; Women F up to 39, G 40–49, H) and a 6 km race for men and women. The race takes place on 5 September 2026, with starts at 9:00 and 10:00. The course includes local roads. Registration is available online or on site.

name: Horský kros Gerlach
description: The Gerlach Mountain Cross is a traditional uphill mountain race that starts in the village of Gerlachov and runs through the Velická Valley to the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel. The course is 8,400 metres long with an elevation gain of 879 metres, and runners tackle a rocky trail and sections of asphalt road. The event is suited to runners who enjoy challenging mountain terrain and beautiful views of the High Tatras. The race also includes children’s runs, and participants can purchase an entry option that includes original Gerlach Mountain Cross socks.
course_highlights: 8,400 m course with an elevation gain of 879 m
Rocky trail and sections of asphalt road
Finish in front of the Sliezsky dom mountain hotel
additional: The maximum capacity is 200 runners. The time limit at the Velický Bridge (5.7 km) is 1:30. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish, along with transport of belongings to the finish and a post-race meal. The children’s races (100–500 m) are not timed; every child receives a medal and a sweet. Entry with HKG socks is available for €7. The race takes place in mountain terrain. Registration is available at the municipal office, and children’s races are also included.

description: Run for the Tatras is a running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Štrbské Pleso in the High Tatras, below the Tatras Tower observation tower. The races offer a children’s start at 14:00 and an adults’ start at 16:00. The course follows natural terrain along the lakeshore and cross-country ski trails. Categories are divided by age and gender, allowing runners of different age groups to take part. The race takes place at the FK Veľaty sports field and offers courses of various lengths for men and women aged 15 and over, with children’s races held directly on the football pitch. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, voluntary entry fee in the form of a donation, and refreshments. Volunteers assist runners throughout the day, and results are timed, with winners announced and prizes awarded.

Children’s races on the FK Veľaty football pitch
Changing rooms, showers, and toilets at the starting venue

Children run immediately after the main races start. The course includes forest, asphalt, and gravel sections; the races are open to all age groups; registration is available online or on site; refreshments and commemorative items are provided.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 9. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava is a regular 2-mile running race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava. The race is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men and veterans, who are divided into categories. Registration takes place on site by the volleyball court from 9:30, and the start is at 10:00. The event is part of a race series in which runners earn points toward the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team Perpetual Trophy based on their performance and age.

The course is at the Kuchajda swimming pool complex in Bratislava

name: Dukelský beh mieru
description: The Dukla Peace Run is one of the oldest and most significant running events in Slovakia, held every year on the first Sunday in September. The course runs from Dukla to the centre of Svidník and is 19 kilometres long, descending from 479 m above sea level at the start to 244 m above sea level at the finish. Runners follow a historic route associated with the Carpathian-Dukla Operation, commemorating the victims and the struggle for peace in 1944–1945. The event has a rich history and deep emotional significance, bringing together competitive runners and amateurs.
course_highlights: A 19 km course from Dukla to Svidník
Start at 479 m above sea level, finish at 244 m above sea level
A historic route associated with the Carpathian-Dukla Operation
additional: Registration for 2026 is still being prepared. The course is known for its historical significance and the challenge it poses to runners following the route once traversed by soldiers during the Carpathian-Dukla Operation. The event also features accompanying running categories such as the Great Run for Health and the Small Run for Health. The course is approximately 19 km long, starting at Dukla Pass and finishing in Svidník’s pedestrian zone. The event also includes short races and inline skating races; online registration is open until August 2025.

Runners can expect a commemorative medal, a race number, refreshments and an accompanying program.

Electronic timing with chip technology

description: Behaj lesmi Topoľčianky is a night trail race in the beautiful wine-growing region of Topoľčianky, taking place on 12 September 2026. Runners can enjoy routes passing by Topoľčianky Castle and Hrušov Castle, with forest trails and an atmosphere under the stars. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the international UTMB Index, adding to its prestige. There are two main distances—11 km and 22 km—and the course also features the Conti Speed Section, where runners can win a valuable prize.

The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere, with refreshments along the course.
course_highlights: The course runs through challenging mountain terrain
Various categories for adults and children
Races with a choice of distance and start times
additional: The children’s categories start at 11:00. After 16.9.2025, entry fees for all packages are €5 higher both online and on site. Packages include different combinations of a medal, promotional pack, raffle tickets, refreshments along the course, lunch, and a technical T-shirt. Trail setting, various categories, registration from €4 to €25, starts at 11:00 and 13:00

name: Bešeňovský charitatívny beh pre MAPENZI
organizer: Občianske združenie MAPENZI by Generation of love, Obec Bešeňov
description: The Bešeňov Charity Run for MAPENZI is a running event organized by the civic association MAPENZI by Generation of love and the municipality of Bešeňov. The race takes place at the football field in Bešeňov and offers 10 km and 5 km categories, children’s races, and a 2 km recreational run. The children’s races start at 15:00 and the main race at 16:00. The event is charitable and suitable for the general public, including different age groups.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km routes for men and women in different age categories
Children’s races starting at 15:00
2 km recreational run
additional: The children’s races start at 15:00 and the main race starts at 16:00. The organizers provide contact details for four responsible persons, including their phone numbers. The event is charitable and organized in cooperation with the municipality of Bešeňov. It includes a charity run in support of MAPENZI; registration is available online and on site, and the course passes through the football field in Bešeňov.

name: Olšavský pohár – Memoriál Júliusa Kažimíra
organizer: Obec Ruskov and Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Ruskov

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 € pre prihlásených a vyplatených účastníkov najneskôr do 15.9.2025

description: The Olšavský Cup – Július Kažimír Memorial is a running race held in the village of Ruskov, in the Košice-okolie District. The race offers two main courses, 16.8 km and 9.7 km long, with the start in front of the Municipal Office. Men, women, and children can compete in various age categories. The organizers are the Municipality of Ruskov and the Ruskov Volunteer Fire Brigade, in cooperation with neighboring villages. The race is suitable for a wide range of participants, including seniors and children, who can enter for free.
course_highlights: Two courses: 16.8 km and 9.7 km
Start in front of the Municipal Office in Ruskov
Categories for men, women, and children by age
additional: Children’s categories start at 13:00 and adults at 14:00. Men over 70, women over 60, and children can enter for free. The race takes place on 20 September 2026; registration is available on site; course conditions are not specified.

name: Beh Tokajskými vinicami
location: Oddychové centrum, Čerhov, Trebišov District, Slovakia
description: The Run Through the Tokaj Vineyards is a traditional running race held in the village of Čerhov in the Trebišov District. The course winds through the picturesque Tokaj vineyards, offering beautiful natural scenery and a pleasant setting for runners of all ages. The event is suitable for both amateur and experienced runners who want to enjoy a day of sport outdoors and discover the unique Tokaj region. It is organized by the municipality of Čerhov, which ensures a welcoming atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Tokaj vineyards, with beautiful views
Natural surroundings with moderate elevation gain
A combination of paved and forest roads
additional: The event takes place at the Recreation Centre in Čerhov. A course map is available on the municipality’s website. No specific start times or wave assignments are provided. Registration information is available on a separate page. No entry fees or race categories are listed.

name: Karpaty Run – Bratislava Trail Run
location: Malokarpatské Námestie 1, Bratislava - Lamač, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Karpaty Run - Bratislava Trail Run is the largest trail running festival in the Little Carpathians, offering routes of varying lengths and difficulty for runners and hikers. The race takes place in pleasant natural surroundings, with an emphasis on nature conservation and a healthy lifestyle. The routes run mainly along forest roads and trails, with minimal asphalt, and are suitable for intermediate to advanced runners. The organizer is the Hojta civic association, which promotes sport and ecological values.
course_highlights: The routes run 65% along forest roads and 33–35% on forest trails
Elevation gain ranges from 80 m to 876 m, depending on the race distance
Aid stations are available at several points along the course, depending on the race distance
additional: The start is 700 m from Malokarpatské Square in Lamač, with a transfer 20 minutes before the start. There is no time limit for most routes, except for the longest ones, which have limits of 5 or 7 hours. Aid stations are available along the course depending on the race distance. Refreshments can be purchased at Biely Kríž. The race takes place on 3 October 2026. Registration is available through the official website. Race categories include various age groups. Most distances have no time limit.

name: Horský beh Pačanským chotárom
location: Pača, Rožňava District, Košice Region, Slovakia
description: The Pačanský Chotár Mountain Run is a running event in the village of Pača, offering two main courses: a more challenging 13.5 km main race with 492 m of elevation gain, and a shorter 6.3 km hobby race with 203 m of elevation gain. The routes combine paved and forest roads, with beautiful views and refreshment stations along the way. Runners start and finish in front of the cultural centre in Pača, and the organizers provide route navigation and markings. The event is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners and offers a sporting atmosphere with refreshments and a raffle.
course_highlights: Main race: 13.5 km with 492 m of elevation gain; 40% paved road and 60% forest road
Hobby race: 6.3 km with 203 m of elevation gain, combining paved and forest roads
Refreshment stations along the route and panoramic views of the Pačanský Chotár
additional: Race-day registration is from 8:30 to 9:45 in front of the cultural centre in Pača. Children’s races are free, with a medal for every participant and prizes for the top three in each category. The race pack includes a chipped race number, a commemorative headband, a medal, nutritional supplements, and entry into the raffle. Refreshments after the finish include goulash, beer, or Kofola. 13.5 km and 6.3 km routes, scenic forest and mountain terrain, online registration, prizes for top finishers, scenic views, mountain trail, mountain race

name: Rybnícka 10-ka a 5-ka
location: Futbalový štadión, Rybník, Rybník, Levice, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Rybník, ZŠ s MŠ Rybník
description: Rybník 10K and 5K is a running event held at the football stadium in the village of Rybník, Levice District. Races are held over two distances—5 km and 10 km—with various age categories for men and women. The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 11:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including secondary school students and seniors, who receive a discounted entry fee. The organizers provide a welcoming atmosphere and quality facilities for runners.
course_highlights: The course runs around the football stadium in Rybník
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Categories for children, women, and men across different age groups
additional: The children’s race starts at 9:00, and the adults’ race at 11:00. The discounted entry fee is €10 for secondary school students aged up to 18 and seniors over 65. The race is open to all age groups, including children, with the option to register online or on site. The event also offers sporting activities at the football stadium.

name: Behaj lesmi Devín
description: Behaj lesmi Devín is a unique trail race near Bratislava, offering a route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and Devínska Kobyla. The routes follow the historic Amber Road and pass through flowering wild garlic avenues, making the run an unforgettable experience. The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, providing an international points ranking. You can compete on the short 12 km route or the 22 km half marathon; both routes feature a marked Conti Speed Section with a valuable prize.
course_highlights: Route with views of the confluence of the Danube and Morava rivers and Devínska Kobyla
Historic trade route, the Amber Road, and wild garlic avenues
Conti Speed Section—a speed segment marked over 150 metres
additional: The race is part of the Behaj lesmi series. The routes are marked, and refreshment stations are located along the course. The Conti Speed Section competition offers the chance to win a tyre-purchase voucher and a running shirt. The race is included in the UTMB Index Races, allowing participants to earn an international points ranking. The course passes through wooded areas and along the historic Amber Road. Medals, participant gifts, photographs, and medical services are available.

name: S Ankou za život
description: The Run With Anka for Life is a charity event held in Košice by St. Elizabeth’s Cathedral. The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds from the entry fees go to the Oáza – Hope for a New Life facility. The event is organized by the Anka Kolesárová Pastoral Centre in Vysoká nad Uhom. Runners can combine their athletic effort with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: Charitable event, with proceeds supporting social projects
Running relay in Košice and the surrounding area
An event bringing the community together to support life
additional: The entry fee is a voluntary contribution, and all proceeds go to the Oáza – Hope for a New Life charitable facility. The event supports life and charity; registration is available by making a voluntary contribution.

name: Hutčanská 5 s vierou – beh srdcom i telom
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, 0 € pre deti 8-17 rokov a niektoré vekové skupiny
description: The Run with Heart and Soul in Nižná Hutka is an annual running event offering a 5 km course for experienced runners and a fun 500 m route for the youngest participants. Alongside the sporting experience, the programme includes spiritual reflection, refreshments, a panel discussion and musical entertainment. The event creates a welcoming community atmosphere and encourages both competition and the joy of running.
course_highlights: 5 km course for experienced runners
Fun 500 m route for children
Goulash refreshments for runners
additional: Registration is available online and in person, with a higher fee for in-person registration. Race numbers, safety pins and the participant list will be prepared. After the run, there will be an awards ceremony, thanks, a raffle and a concert by the band Kalap. The event includes spiritual activities, refreshments, entertainment and age-based categories, with different entry fees.

name: Mariatálsky štvanec
description: Mariatálsky štvanec is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Little Carpathians, offering a range of disciplines for recreational and competitive runners. The event takes place in the village of Marianka and has a family-friendly atmosphere, culminating in a beautiful sunset. You can compete in the 6 km, 10 km and 15 km races, in three-person teams in the 3×6 km relay, or in the children’s Beh Záhoráčik races. The start and finish are at the football field, and the races are run according to the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation.
course_highlights: The courses run through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Little Carpathians
A family-friendly atmosphere with the children’s Beh Záhoráčik races
A beautiful sunset marks the highlight of the event
additional: Race-day registration and bib collection are available at the TUI branch in the BORY MALL shopping centre. The number of adult participants is limited to 500, and the number of children to 400. There is no limit on the number of teams. Time limits are 1 hour for 6 km, 1 hour 30 minutes for 10 km, 2 hours for 15 km and 1 hour 30 minutes for the 3×6 km team race. The event includes several courses, categories for adults and children, and relays; online and on-site registration; chip timing; refreshments and medals. The total participant limit is 900.

name: MTBIKER Kylof Ľubietová
description: MTHIKER Kylof Ľubietová is a running race that brings together history, nature and a great atmosphere in the picturesque heart of Slovakia. There are three races: a 4.3 km hobby race for beginners and young runners aged 13 and over, a 10 km main race for competitive and recreational runners, and 850 m children’s races for children aged 6 to 12. The course features climbs and beautiful views of the Low Tatras. Runners can compete for cash prizes and valuable prizes. After the finish, participants can enjoy traditional granadír and receive an original medal as part of the Marathon Tour.
course_highlights: 4.3 km hobby course with a scenic loop and a climb
10 km course with views of the Low Tatras and a mining trail
850 m children’s races in the centre of Ľubietová
additional: The children’s races start from 9:30, with start times determined by age category; the hobby race starts at 10:40 and the main race at 10:30. Every participant receives an original Marathon Tour medal. Granadír is served at the finish. The fastest runners receive vouchers and a trophy, while the overall 10 km winners also receive cash prizes. Everyone who finishes is entered into a draw for experience prizes such as a parachute jump or a sightseeing flight. Trail running, registration, family event, historical themes, beautiful views

name: Gréta Run
location: Koliba Gréta, Liptovská Sielnica, okres L. Mikuláš, Slovakia
description: Gréta Run is a traditional running race in the picturesque surroundings of Kvačianska Valley and Liptovská Sielnica, offering courses of various lengths for children and adults. The race follows the yellow hiking trail and the embankment, finishing at Koliba Gréta, where refreshments and a cultural programme await participants. The event also includes a rich programme of activities for families and children. It is organised by the Liptov Olympic Club, which provides quality technical and medical services.
course_highlights: 7.4 km course from Kvačianska Valley along the yellow trail to Koliba Gréta
15 km course from Koliba Gréta through Kvačianska Valley and Prosiecka Valley and back to Koliba Gréta
3 km course along the embankment to Liptovská Sielnica and back
additional: The first 200 registered participants will receive a race pack with goulash, spaghetti, a T-shirt and a medal. Runners in the 7.4 km race will be transported to the start by bus at 15:30. After the race, goulash and the results announcement will take place at Stodola Gréta, followed by a concert. Changing rooms and toilets are available at Koliba Gréta. The organiser is not responsible for personal belongings or baggage. Discounted accommodation is available on site. Course sections run from Kvačianska Valley and Koliba Gréta; registration is available online or on site. The entry fee includes goulash, a medal, refreshments and other services. The race offers several categories, including children’s and veterans’ categories, with prizes for the winners.

description: Šamorín Running League 2026 – Round 5 is a running event organized by 3klub Šamorín in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. The race takes place in the pleasant surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park in Šamorín and is open to various age groups, from preschoolers to adults. The children’s categories start at 10:00, and the main race begins at 10:30. The event offers a chance to take part in the league and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a community setting.
course_highlights: Races in the natural surroundings of Pomlé Forest Park
Categories for children and adults
Children’s races start at 10:00; the main race starts at 10:30
additional: Categories: Preschoolers (0–6 years), Younger pupils (7–10 years), Older pupils (11–15 years), Adults (women, men). The event is organized by 3klub Šamorín o.z. in cooperation with the town of Šamorín. Organizer contact: Juraj Nagy, tel.: 0905 984 190. Routes on paved and forest paths; categories from preschoolers to adults; no performance or age limit.

name: Jarabský polmaratón
description: The Jarabský Half Marathon is a unique mountain trail race in the Low Tatras, covering 22.1 km. It offers a challenging course full of climbs, descents, and technical terrain. The race is for trail-running and active-outdoor enthusiasts, who can enjoy beautiful views and the atmosphere of a running community ranging from professionals to recreational athletes. The event has been held since 2015 and embodies the spirit of a friendly running gathering, “Go Around Jarabá Your Way.” In 2025, it is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League, underscoring its quality and challenge.
course_highlights: The course runs through unspoiled nature, forests, and mountain trails
Challenging trail terrain with climbs and descents
Beautiful views of the central ridge of the Low Tatras
additional: The course features true Sky Race elements and has been part of the Slovak Skyrunning League since 2025. The race is for a broad community of runners, from professionals to recreational athletes. In the past, the course has been adjusted several times depending on the weather; its current length is 22.1 km. The event has a friendly atmosphere and grew out of an informal, untimed running gathering. A challenging mountain trail with 1,240 m of elevation gain, online registration, aid stations, course marking, medical support, and technologies to improve the experience.

name: U.S.Steel Family Run – Minimaratón
description: The U. S. Steel Family Run - Mini-Marathon is a running event in Košice that is part of the traditional International Peace Marathon. Runners of all ages are welcome, with no age limit. The event follows the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletics Association, and the organizers ensure thorough preparation and organization. The start and finish are located on Hlavná Street in Košice, making for an attractive city run.
course_highlights: The course runs through the center of Košice along Hlavná Street
The event is suitable for all ages, with no age limit
Organized according to the rules of World Athletics and the Slovak Athletics Association
additional: It is not possible to transfer a start entry to the following year. A start entry may be transferred to a new participant under certain conditions. Registration and payment of the entry fee are checked online through the runner's account. Registration is open to everyone interested, and participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and the chance to take part in a short but dynamic run in the heart of Košice.

name: Medzinárodný maratón mieru
description: The International Peace Marathon in Košice is a traditional running celebration held on 4 October 2026 on Hlavná Street. Organized by the Košice Marathon Club, it offers a marathon, half marathon and other events, with the start and finish located in the city centre. The event is known for its long history and high-quality organization, including the Slovak Half Marathon Championships. Runners can expect professional timekeeping and a rich accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Hlavná Street, between DoubleTree by Hilton and the Dargov department store
The Slovak Half Marathon Championships are part of the event
The course is certified according to World Athletics and Slovak Athletics Association rules
additional: The start and finish are on Hlavná Street in Košice. The organizer provides professional timekeeping. The Slovak Half Marathon Championships are also part of the event. Age groups and special categories for relay teams and handbikes are available. Registration is available online, and payment can be made by card, Google Pay, Apple Pay and registration code. The event includes various categories, including the marathon, half marathon, relay and inline events, with the option to register online and change the start or event within the specified deadlines.

name: Javornícka stovka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Poplatok za štart jedného účastníka je 79 EUR.

description: Javornícka stovka is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance hike held in the Javorníky region. Runners cross challenging mountain terrain with several checkpoints and time limits. The event is intended for experienced runners seeking a challenge in beautiful natural surroundings. The start and registration are in Čadca, and the finish is in Lysá pod Makytou. The organizers emphasize safety, mandatory equipment, and medical assistance along the entire route.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in the Javorníky with several checkpoints
Finish in Lysá pod Makytou
A generous 27-hour time limit, with several intermediate cut-off times
additional: Participant registration takes place at the House of Culture in Čadca on Matičné námestie on Friday evening and Saturday morning. The mass start is in Čadca at 07:00. The organizers provide baggage transport and drop bags at checkpoint K4. Medical assistance and safety are provided during the event. Accommodation is available in Čadca; participants can spend the night in the gym of an elementary school, where quiet hours are observed. The course consists of 80% forest roads, 5% asphalt, and 15% meadows. Mandatory equipment includes a headlamp, reflective elements, hydration, and a first-aid kit. Registration closed on 26 September 2025.

description: GARMIN Run through the Súľov Rocks is a traditional running race set in the beautiful surroundings of the Súľov Rocks, offering three courses of varying lengths and difficulty. Runners make their way through scenic countryside, with views of rock formations and ridge trails. Aid stations are also provided along the course. The event is suitable for a wide range of participants, including children, who have separate categories and start times. It is organized by the Slovak Cycling Club CYKLO TOUR Súľov - Hradná, which provides thorough preparation and support for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes through the scenic Súľov Rocks, with views of rock formations and ridge trails
Up to 850 metres of elevation gain on the longest, 17 km course
Three aid stations along the course, plus separate children’s categories with their own starts

Registration is valid only after the entry fee has been paid. In-person registration and payment are available on the day before the race starts, provided the participation limit has not been reached. Children’s category starts take place between the main race starts. The course includes forest trails and short asphalt sections. Registration is available through the official websites. The event is known for its beautiful scenery and atmosphere.

name: Grand Prix – Cabaj-Čápor
price_range: 10 € online, 15 € na mieste, zadarmo pre deti a niektoré kategórie
description: The Grand Prix Cabaj-Čápor is a traditional cross-country race in beautiful natural surroundings, held in the village of Cabaj-Čápor, starting at Salaš Cabaj. Runners can choose from several distances, including 10 km, 3 km and children’s races of 600 m and 1,000 m. The event is suitable for anyone who wants to enjoy sport in nature, whether to compete or simply for the pleasure of running. Registration is open and participant numbers are limited, so it is advisable to sign up early.

10 km and 3 km races, plus children’s races of 600 m and 1,000 m
Start at Salaš Cabaj
additional: Race check-in begins at 9:00. Participant numbers are limited. Participants in the main and hobby races receive a finisher’s award. The event takes place on 10 October 2026. Online registration is available, and the race is suitable for all age groups and ability levels.

The race takes place at the grounds of the 2nd Primary School at J. Švermu 6 and consists of a 400-metre children’s run and a 3-kilometre main run. The event is suitable for families and runners who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and sporting activities in a pleasant setting. The organizers provide refreshments and commemorative items for participants.
course_highlights: 400 m children’s run for children up to 9 years old
3 km main run consisting of 3 laps of 900 m each
Start and finish at the grounds of the 2nd Primary School, J. Švermu 6, Michalovce

name: Beh Myšľou

description: The Vyšná Myšľa Run is a running event organised by the Vyšná Myšľa Municipal Running Club and the Municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The race takes place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa, in Košice-okolie District. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. Men and women can compete in various age categories, including a 2 x 3 km relay for pairs. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere for running in the village.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football field in Vyšná Myšľa
2 x 3 km relay for pairs
Multiple age categories for men and women
additional: Entry fees are waived for Men E, Women I, members of BKO Vyšná Myšľa, residents of Vyšná Myšľa and children. The children’s races start at 14:00 and the adults’ races at 16:00. Race distances range from 350 m to 8 km. Registration is available online or on site, and the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Beh za zdravie – Kuchajda
description: Run for Health - Kuchajda is a charity running event taking place on October 11, 2026, at Kuchajda in Bratislava. The event combines sport with support for health and the community, aiming to help disadvantaged people and organizations through physical activity. Participants can run, jog at an easy pace, or walk, in a wonderful atmosphere filled with inspiring stories and solidarity. Run for Health is open to all ages and fitness levels, while also supporting charity projects with a real impact.
course_highlights: Running event at Kuchajda in Bratislava
Supporting health and the community through sport
An opportunity to take part regardless of age or fitness level
additional: The event is a charity fundraiser supporting disadvantaged people and organizations. Children, adults, and older people can take part by running, jogging at an easy pace, or walking. The organizers offer the opportunity to volunteer and contribute to the success of the event. The event takes place at Kuchajda in Bratislava and supports health and socially disadvantaged groups. Registration details are not specified.

description: The Run Through the Streets of Krompachy is a traditional running race in the town of Krompachy, offering categories for children, youth, juniors, men and women in various age groups. The race takes place in front of the municipal office building and is organized by the Town of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Krompachy. The starts are split between the children’s categories and youth at 9:30 and adults at 11:00. The entry fee is a symbolic €5, except for pupils, youth athletes and runners over 60. The race is suitable for the general public and supports sporting life in the region.
course_highlights: The race runs through the streets of Krompachy
Start and finish in front of the municipal office building
Categories for all age groups, from children to seniors

The event is organized by the Town of Krompachy and the Culture and Sports Commission of the Municipal Council in Krompachy. The event takes place in October, with various categories and starts from 9:00; registration is possible by contacting the organizer. The course is likely urban and on roads.
